This is an incremental UX effort rather than a single fix; individual message improvements are welcome.

title: RPATHs to external libraries that aren't in the default library search path
rationale_ja: 外部依存の絶対パス共有ライブラリのディレクトリを自動でRPATHに追加し、インストール時には depfixer がビルド専用dirのみ除去してインストールrpathを保持する。インストール後にrpathが消える問題は解消済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:1862 rpaths_for_non_system_absolute_shared_libraries(); scripts/depfixer.py:808 fix_rpath (preserves install rpath, removes only build-only dirs)
draft_comment: Meson now adds RPATH entries for the directories of absolute-path external shared libraries, and the install-time rpath fixer only strips build-only directories while preserving the install rpath (see build.py rpaths_for_non_system_absolute_shared_libraries and depfixer.fix_rpath). The disappearing-rpath-on-install behaviour you reported should be resolved. Closing as fixed; reopen with a current reproducer if it persists.

title: ERROR: 'gtkdoc-scangobj' failed with status 1
rationale_ja: gtkdoc --rebuild-types による .types ファイル欠落エラー。gtkdochelper は --rebuild-types 時に生成した module.types を scangobj に渡すよう処理があるが、報告はPython2時代のgtk-docと古い。gtk-doc自体が非推奨化しており、現行での再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/gtkdochelper.py:141-146 (--rebuild-types uses generated module.types, --types=); modules/gnome.py:1530-1534
draft_comment: The gtkdoc helper handles `--rebuild-types` by generating and passing a `<module>.types` file to scangobj. This report is from the Python-2 gtk-doc era, and gtk-doc itself is now largely superseded by gi-docgen/hotdoc. Could you confirm whether this still reproduces with a current Meson and gtk-doc? Without an updated reproducer we'll close as stale.

title: RFE: add possibility to get output of vcs_tag() without configuring file
rationale_ja: vcs_tag は依然 input/output ファイルが必須で、バージョン文字列を直接変数に取得する手段はない。configure時にgitを実行しない設計方針との兼ね合いがあり設計議論が必要なため残す。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/vcs_tag.yaml (input/output required:true); mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:2086-2138 requires input template
implementation_hint: vcs_tag deliberately defers running the VCS command to build time via a custom_target, so exposing the value as a configure-time string conflicts with that design (and with reproducible reconfiguration). Options: a separate configure-time helper that runs the vcs command eagerly (with the reliability caveats), or better docs for the configuration_data + @VCS_TAG@ pattern shown in the issue.

title: Suggestion: add function unreliable_glob
rationale_ja: globは信頼性の問題からmesonが意図的に避けている機能で、'unreliable_glob' 提案も実装されておらず、メンテナ方針としてFAQでスクリプトによる回避策を案内する立場が一貫している。方針上のwontfix。
evidence: No glob/unreliable_glob function in mesonbuild (grep no match); FAQ.md documents the anti-globbing stance and script workaround
draft_comment: Meson intentionally does not provide file globbing, for the well-known reliability reasons (added/removed files aren't detected without a manual reconfigure), and this 'unreliable_glob' proposal was never adopted. The recommended approach remains explicit file lists, or the run_command/script pattern documented in the FAQ for those who accept the tradeoffs. Closing as wontfix per the project's long-standing position; the FAQ workaround covers the use case.

title: New method on python module: find_installation().get_shebang()
rationale_ja: PythonInstallation に get_shebang 相当のメソッドは未実装。プラットフォーム別の推奨shebangを返す小規模な機能追加として有効。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:157-398 method decorators (extension_module, dependency, install_sources, get_install_dir, language_version, has_path, get_path, has_variable, get_variable, path) - no get_shebang
implementation_hint: Add a get_shebang() method to PythonInstallation returning the platform-appropriate shebang (/usr/bin/env python3 on Linux/macOS/Windows-py-launcher, pythonX.Y on BSDs). Since install-time shebang rewriting for python.install_sources may already cover many cases, first check whether this is still needed vs documenting the existing behavior.

title: Dist doesn't respect meson configuration
rationale_ja: meson dist は create_cmdline_args() でビルドディレクトリに保存されたコマンドラインオプション(read_cmd_line_file)を読み込み、tarballの再構成時に渡すため、設定済みオプションを尊重するようになった。
evidence: mesonbuild/mdist.py:361-368 create_cmdline_args (read_cmd_line_file(bld_root), format_cmd_line_options), :348 used in check_dist
draft_comment: This is resolved: `meson dist` now reads the options that were configured in your build directory (`create_cmdline_args()` -> `read_cmd_line_file()` from `meson-private/cmd_line.txt`) and passes them to the `meson setup` it runs for the dist test build (`mesonbuild/mdist.py`). So the dist build honours your configured options -- e.g. a feature disabled via `-Dopt=false` stays disabled during dist -- instead of falling back to defaults. Closing as fixed.
verify_signal_ja: 実質最終コメントは2018-08(nirbheek『meson distに-Dを渡せるようにするのが簡単』等)。2026-03の更新はラベル操作のみでコメント数は7のまま増えていない。
verify_reason_ja: mdist.py の check_dist は create_cmdline_args(bld_root) でビルドディレクトリ保存済みのコマンドラインオプション(meson-private/cmd_line.txt を read_cmd_line_file 経由で)を読み込み、dist テストビルドの meson setup にそのまま渡す(:348,361-368)。よって『distがデフォルトオプションで構成される』という報告の中核が解消され、無効化した依存はdist時も無効のまま扱われる。

title: Using builtin targets as dependency for run_target
rationale_ja: run_target の depends は BuildTarget/CustomTarget/CustomTargetIndex/Program のみ受理し、all/install/uninstall/test のようなビルトインのメタターゲットはDSLで参照可能なオブジェクトではないため depends に渡せない。カスタムinstall/uninstall順序制御の要望として残す。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/type_checking.py:275-281 DEPENDS_KW accepts only BuildTarget/CustomTarget/CustomTargetIndex/Program; builtin meta-targets not addressable
implementation_hint: Supporting depends on builtin meta-targets (all/install/uninstall) would require exposing them as referenceable objects and teaching the backend to order run_target after them. This is a non-trivial design change to how meta-targets are modeled; alternatively provide dedicated install/uninstall hook mechanisms.

title: Meson has_link_argument doesn't work for --version-script on FreeBSD
rationale_ja: has_link_argument は実行ファイルをリンクして引数を検証するため、FreeBSDのGNU BFD ldでは --version-script が共有ライブラリリンク時しか使えず誤検出する。FreeBSD固有/version-script用の -shared 付きテストなどの特別処理はコードベースに見当たらず未対応。
evidence: No is_freebsd handling in clike.py and no version-script concept in mesonbuild (agent A: NOT FOUND)
implementation_hint: has_link_argument links a small executable; for linker flags that only apply when producing a shared object (like --version-script on GNU BFD ld on FreeBSD), consider allowing the check to build a shared library, or add a has_link_argument variant/mode that links a shared object. Must degrade gracefully on compilers that don't understand -shared.

title: Allow passing multiple FeatureOptions to required:
rationale_ja: extract_required_kwarg は単一の Feature または bool のみ受理し、複数の FeatureOption のリストによるAND評価は未実装。提案されたセマンティクス(特に enabled & auto -> auto)を含めて実装する価値のある機能。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreterobjects.py:79-94 extract_required_kwarg (only Feature or bool, else raises 'must be boolean or a feature option')
implementation_hint: Extend extract_required_kwarg to accept a list of FeatureOptions/bools and AND them with the truth table in the issue (notably enabled & auto -> auto). Touches interpreterobjects.extract_required_kwarg and every caller that passes required (dependency/find_library/find_program/subproject etc.); add FeatureNew gating and tests.

title: Run a no-op check after each project test
rationale_ja: テストは meson.build を touch して再生成→再ビルドまで行うが、'何も再ビルドされないこと' のアサーションはまだTBDのまま。回帰(不要な再リンク)検出のためのアサーション追加は小規模で有効。
evidence: run_project_tests.py:753-762 (force_regenerate + build_step, line 762 comment '# TBD: assert nothing gets built after the regenerate?')
implementation_hint: In run_project_tests.py after force_regenerate()+build_step(), capture ninja's output (e.g. `ninja -n` dry-run or parse the build step output) and assert that no targets were rebuilt, failing the test if any were. The touch+rebuild scaffolding already exists; only the no-op assertion (the existing TBD comment) is missing.

title: Don't add private dependencies to Requires.private when --default-library=shared
rationale_ja: pkgconfigは requires_private/libraries_private/dataonly で私的エントリを制御できるが、--default-library=shared 時に内部依存の Requires.private 自動追加を抑止する専用トグルはない。細粒度制御の要望として残す。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py:681-683 (libraries_private/requires_private kwargs), :667 dataonly, :269-304 _add_lib_dependencies auto-promotion; no shared-specific suppression toggle
implementation_hint: Consider an option to omit auto-added Requires.private/Libs.private for internal dependencies when the target is built as a shared library (their symbols aren't exposed). Users can already set requires_private/libraries_private explicitly and use dataonly, but there's no automatic 'shared => drop transitive private requires' behavior. Needs care to not break static-link consumers.

title: Add a test case for building gobject-introspection with AddressSanitizer
rationale_ja: gobject-introspection を AddressSanitizer でビルドするCIテストケース追加の要望。CI整備タスクで、現行CIに該当テストがあるか不明確。設計/CI判断が必要なため残す。
evidence: none (CI task; no direct evidence of such a test case; references PR #3955)
implementation_hint: Add a CI job/test that builds gobject-introspection (or the g-i test project) with b_sanitize=address to catch ASAN-related regressions, following up on PR #3955. Verify whether meson's current CI already exercises b_sanitize before adding.

title: ARM Compiler cross tests in Meson CI
rationale_ja: Windows CI上でKeil/ARMCC/ARMCLANGのクロステストを追加する提案。CIインフラとプロプライエタリツールのライセンスに依存する運用課題で、コード修正では解決しない。現行CIにarmcc/armclangのテストは見当たらない。
evidence: No armcc/armclang cross tests found in CI config (grep of .github/, run_project_tests.py)

title: gnome.gtkdoc integration breaks when ASAN is enabled
rationale_ja: gtkdocのASAN連携不具合。gnomeモジュールは現在b_sanitizeを認識し-lasan等をldflagsに付与する処理を持つ(gnome.py:940付近)。2018年の報告で詳細再現手順が乏しいため、最新版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:940-953 handles b_sanitize (adds -lasan for gtkdoc)
draft_comment: Thanks for the report. The gnome module now has explicit sanitizer handling for gtkdoc targets (it detects `b_sanitize` and adds the appropriate runtime libraries such as `-lasan`). This is a very old issue with limited reproduction detail. Could you confirm whether this still reproduces with a current release of Meson? If we don't hear back, we'll close this as stale, but please reopen with a minimal reproducer if it persists.

title: Provide 'rename' capability for installing executables and libraries
rationale_ja: ビルドターゲットのインストール時リネームは未実装。install_dataには`rename`があるがexecutable()/library()にはない。name_prefix/name_suffixはビルド時ファイル名のみを制御し、multilibでの用途は完全には満たさない。有効な機能要望として残す。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml (only name_prefix/name_suffix); install_data.yaml:63 has rename but not for targets
implementation_hint: Add an install-time rename mechanism for build targets. Currently only name_prefix/name_suffix exist (build-time filename). Could add an `install_rename` kwarg on executable()/library(), wiring through to the install data (minstall.py) similar to how install_data's rename works.

title: Tests in run_project_tests.py don't run `meson install` when using the VS backends
rationale_ja: 内部テストインフラ(run_project_tests.py)がVSバックエンドでinstallテストを実行しない件。現行のテストランナーはinstall検証ロジックを備えており、当時の状況は古い。メンテナ向けに再確認が必要。
evidence: run_project_tests.py has install validation (InstalledFile, install=4 test phases)
draft_comment: This is an old note about our internal test runner. `run_project_tests.py` has since been substantially reworked and does exercise install validation across backends. Is this still an actionable gap on current master? If there's no longer a concrete missing case, we'll close it.

title: Regression: meson no longer defaults to needs_exe_wrapper: false for 32-bit on 64-bit builds of the same architecture
rationale_ja: machine_info_can_run()がx86_64ホスト上のx86(およびmips64/mips)を実行可能と明示的に判定し、この場合exe_wrapper不要とする。ドキュストリングも『64bit上で32bitバイナリはほぼ常に実行可能』と記載。回帰は修正済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:761-779 machine_info_can_run() returns True for x86_64->x86 and mips64->mips; used by Environment.need_exe_wrapper (environment.py:578)
draft_comment: This regression is fixed. `machine_info_can_run()` (`mesonbuild/envconfig.py`) now explicitly treats an x86 host binary as runnable on an x86_64 build machine (and likewise mips on mips64) when the OS matches, and `Environment.need_exe_wrapper()` uses it, so Meson again defaults to not needing an exe wrapper for a same-architecture 32-on-64 build. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you still see the wrapper being required in that case.
verify_signal_ja: コメントゼロ、2018年報告のまま。異論なし。
verify_reason_ja: envconfig.py:761-779 の machine_info_can_run() は同一OS前提で x86_64 ホスト上の x86(および mips64 上の mips)を実行可能と明示的に判定し、environment.py:585 の need_exe_wrapper() がこれを使って exe wrapper 不要と判断する。報告の32-on-64同一アーキ回帰は修正済み。

title: Decoding issue.
rationale_ja: gtkdochelperでのUnicodeDecodeError(gtk-doc出力の非UTF-8バイト)。当時のトレースバック行番号は現行コードと一致せず、gtkdochelper/Popen_safe周りは書き換えられている。meson 0.47時代の報告で再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/gtkdochelper.py rewritten; Popen_safe now in utils/universal.py:1940 with locale-aware encoding
draft_comment: Thanks for the report. The gtkdoc helper and our subprocess handling (`Popen_safe`) have been substantially rewritten since 0.47. This originated from non-UTF-8 output produced by gtk-doc itself. Could you check whether this still reproduces on a current Meson release? Without an updated reproducer we'll close this as stale.

title: Document the generic linker argument syntax.
rationale_ja: Mesonがサポートするクラシックなldスタイルのリンカ引数サブセット(-L, -lfoo等)を翻訳する仕様のドキュメント化要望。現状Adding-arguments.mdに包括的な記述は見当たらず、ドキュメント課題として有効。
evidence: docs/markdown/Adding-arguments.md lacks a documented ld-syntax translation table
implementation_hint: Add a docs section (e.g. in Adding-arguments.md or Reference-tables.md) documenting the subset of classic ld syntax Meson translates to native toolchains: -L/dir, /path/lib.so, /path/lib.a, -lname. Source of truth is the compiler/linker mixins' args conversion methods.

title: Document the generic C style compiler argument syntax.
rationale_ja: gccスタイルのコンパイラ引数(-DFOO=1等)や特別扱いされる引数(-mms-bitfields, -pthread)の翻訳仕様のドキュメント化要望。ドキュメント課題として依然有効。
evidence: No comprehensive compiler-arg translation doc found under docs/markdown/
implementation_hint: Document the generic gcc-style compiler-arg subset Meson understands/translates (e.g. -DSOMETHING=1) and specially handled flags (-mms-bitfields, -pthread), pointing to native_args_to_unix/unix_args_to_native in the compiler mixins.

title: Modules are global to all subprojects and references to the Interpreter are never updated
rationale_ja: モジュールAPIが再設計され、各メソッド呼び出しごとに現在のInterpreter/subprojectを反映したModuleStateが渡される。ModuleStateはstate.subproject等を保持し、古いインタプリタ参照によるバグは解消されている。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/__init__.py:28 ModuleState is constructed per-call with interpreter.subproject/subdir; modules use state.* instead of a cached interpreter
draft_comment: This has been addressed by the module API redesign. Module methods now receive a `ModuleState` object constructed fresh for each invocation, carrying the current interpreter's `subproject`, `subdir`, environment, etc. Modules are expected to use `state` (or `state._interpreter`) rather than caching a reference from `initialize()`, so the stale-interpreter-across-subprojects problem no longer applies. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you find a module still caching a stale interpreter.

title: QDoc integration
rationale_ja: Qtのqdocによるドキュメント生成をqtモジュールに統合する要望。現行qtモジュールにqdocサポートは見当たらない。clangバックエンドでのinclude path受け渡し等の設計が必要な有効な機能要望。
evidence: No 'qdoc' handling in mesonbuild/modules/qt.py or _qt.py
implementation_hint: Add a qdoc method to the qt module that takes a config.qdocconf and produces a run target, passing include paths (from dependencies/include_directories) on the qdoc command line so the clang backend can resolve headers.

title: Meson can't find the resource compiler when using clang in MSVC ABI mode
rationale_ja: windowsモジュールのrc検出はコンパイラidではなくリンカid(link/lld-link)を基準に変更された。MSVC ABIのclang(MSリンカ使用時)ではrc.exe/llvm-rcが見つかる。当初のmsvc-id限定の問題は解消。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/windows.py:84 selects rc/llvm-rc vs windres based on comp.linker.id in {'link','lld-link'} (not compiler id)
draft_comment: This should be resolved. The windows module now selects the resource compiler based on the linker in use (`link`/`lld-link` -> rc.exe/llvm-rc, otherwise windres) rather than requiring the compiler id to be `msvc`. So clang in MSVC ABI mode (using an MS-compatible linker) will now find the resource compiler. Closing as fixed; please reopen with details if a specific clang configuration still fails to locate it.

title: gnome.generate_gir should support dependency objects
rationale_ja: gnome.generate_girは現在dependenciesキーワードを受け付け、依存オブジェクトからincludeパス等を導出できる(gnome.py内でDependency/Internal依存を処理)。非標準prefixのgirファイル解決の課題は緩和されている。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py generate_gir accepts dependencies (List[Dependency]) and processes them (deps handling in _get_gir_dep / generate_gir)
draft_comment: `gnome.generate_gir()` now accepts a `dependencies` keyword taking dependency objects, and derives the necessary include/search paths from them. This covers the use case of passing the library's `dependency()` in rather than hand-building include_directories from pkg-config prefixes. Closing as implemented; please reopen if a specific non-default-prefix scenario still fails.

title: Can't change name_suffix/prefix for only static library in both_libraries()
rationale_ja: both_libraries()はname_prefix/name_suffixを共有・静的の両ターゲットに同一のkwargsとして渡すため、静的ライブラリのみに別の接頭辞/接尾辞を指定できない。設計上の制約であり有効な要望として残す。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:3512 build_both_libraries passes the same kwargs (incl. name_prefix/name_suffix) to both SharedLibrary and StaticLibrary targets
implementation_hint: Allow per-target naming in both_libraries(), e.g. accept dict-valued name_prefix/name_suffix like {'shared': ..., 'static': ...} or add static_name_prefix/static_name_suffix (and shared_ variants), splitting them before building each target in build_both_libraries.

title: Missing LINGUAS environment variable behaviour semantics for /usr/share/locale translation installation
rationale_ja: i18n.gettext()はLINGUASファイル(configure時)から言語を読むが、ビルド/インストール時のLINGUAS環境変数(merge_fileがgettext経由で尊重するもの)は反映せず、常に全言語の.moをインストールする。挙動の不一致は依然有効。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/i18n.py:428 uses read_linguas() at configure time; .mo CustomTargets always built/installed for all languages regardless of LINGUAS env var; scripts/gettext.py reads the LINGUAS file only
implementation_hint: Make i18n.gettext honor the LINGUAS environment variable at install time (or a meson option) to filter which .mo files are installed, matching i18n.merge_file behavior. Likely requires filtering the generated .mo install targets based on env at install time, or a configure-time option to select languages.

title: Add support for runstatedir
rationale_ja: autotools互換のrunstatedir(通常/run)組み込みオプションが未実装。options.pyにsharedstatedir等はあるがrunstatedirは存在しない。good first issueラベル通り小規模で実装可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/options.py:670 defines sharedstatedir etc. but grep finds no 'runstatedir' anywhere in the tree
implementation_hint: Add a builtin directory option `runstatedir` (default derived from localstatedir, e.g. localstatedir/run, with /usr -> /run mapping) in mesonbuild/options.py alongside sharedstatedir, including the BUILTIN_DIR_NOPREFIX-style prefix mapping and docs in Builtin-options.md.

title: Support whole-archive directives in pkg-config files
rationale_ja: pkg-configの-Wl,--whole-archive,-lfoo,--no-whole-archive形式で-lfooが認識されず-L/-l順序が崩れる回帰。pkgconfigの_search_libsは2018年以降大幅に書き換えられており、当時のバグが残るか要再現確認。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py:392 _search_libs rewritten; no explicit comma-joined -Wl,--whole-archive,-l splitting found but link-arg handling changed substantially
draft_comment: The pkg-config library/link-argument parsing (`_search_libs`) has been substantially rewritten since this was filed. Could you confirm whether the `-Wl,--whole-archive,-lseastar,--no-whole-archive` ordering problem still reproduces with a current Meson release? If you can attach the failing `pkg-config --libs` output we can add a targeted test; otherwise we'll close this as stale.

title: ERROR: Can not use target js_embed as generator
rationale_ja: Emscriptenクロスビルドでネイティブ生成ツールをgeneratorに使えなかった問題。Emscriptenは0.54.0で一級のツールチェーンとしてサポートされ(mixin+wasmテスト)、native:trueでビルドマシン実行ファイルを生成する仕組みも整備済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/emscripten.py exists; test cases/wasm; Release-notes-for-0.54.0.md mentions emscripten support
draft_comment: Emscripten is now a first-class supported toolchain in Meson (see the emscripten compiler mixin and the wasm test cases, added around 0.54.0). Build-machine executables used as generators should be declared with `native: true` and are built with the native compiler, which resolves the 'cannot use as a generator' error for cross builds. Closing as fixed; if you still hit this with a current release, please reopen with a minimal reproducer and your cross file.

title: Cannot override qt programs
rationale_ja: qtモジュールはツール検出にstate.find_program()を用い、これはprogram_from_overridesを経由するためoverride_find_program()で上書きしたuic/moc/rccが尊重される。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/_qt.py:264 uses state.find_program(); interpreter program_lookup checks program_from_overrides (interpreter.py:1813)
draft_comment: The Qt module now resolves its tools via `state.find_program()`, which honors `override_find_program()`. So overriding `uic`/`moc`/`rcc` before importing/using the qt module works. Closing as fixed; please reopen if a specific override still isn't picked up.

title: meson wrap does not consider subproject_dir option
rationale_ja: meson subprojects/wrapツールはproject()のsubproject_dirオプションを尊重するようになった。msubprojects.pyでextract_subproject_dir()を取得しResolverに渡す。
evidence: mesonbuild/msubprojects.py:730 uses intr.extract_subproject_dir() or 'subprojects'; wraptool uses mesonlib.get_subproject_dir()
draft_comment: This is resolved: the wrap / subprojects tooling no longer hardcodes `subprojects`. `wraptool` uses `mesonlib.get_subproject_dir()`, which introspects the root `meson.build` and extracts the `subproject_dir` kwarg from `project()` (falling back to `subprojects` only when it isn't set), and `mesonbuild/msubprojects.py` uses `extract_subproject_dir()` the same way. So `meson wrap` now honours a custom `subproject_dir` such as `libs`. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you still see it defaulting to `subprojects` with a custom directory.
verify_signal_ja: コメントゼロ、2018年報告のまま。異論なし。
verify_reason_ja: wraptool の各コマンドは mesonlib.get_subproject_dir()(universal.py:2749-2766)を使い、これは root meson.build を introspection で解析して project() の subproject_dir kwarg を抽出(未指定時のみ 'subprojects' にフォールバック)する。msubprojects.py:730 も extract_subproject_dir() を利用。よって meson wrap がカスタム subproject_dir を尊重するようになっている。

title: Mixed PIC due to helper libraries
rationale_ja: static_library()に`pic`キーワード(bool, since 0.36.0)が存在し、b_staticpicとは独立してPICを制御できる。ヘルパー静的ライブラリのPICをdefault_libraryに応じて明示制御できるため、報告の課題は解決手段が用意されている。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/static_library.yaml:10-17 documents pic bool kwarg (independent of b_staticpic)
draft_comment: The supported way to handle this is the `pic` keyword on `static_library()`, which overrides the global `b_staticpic` when set explicitly (see `Build.BuildTarget._extract_pic_pie` in `mesonbuild/build.py`: an explicit `pic:` value wins over the option). For your bitdepth helper libraries you can pass `pic: get_option('default_library') != 'static'` (or simply `pic: false` if they're never linked into a shared lib), which also covers the `both` case since it follows `default_library`. No dedicated automatic mechanism beyond this was added, so this is the intended approach. Closing on that basis -- please reopen if a concrete case still can't be expressed with the `pic` kwarg.
verify_signal_ja: コメントゼロ、2018年報告のまま放置。メンテナの反応なし。
verify_reason_ja: static_library() の pic kwarg(since 0.36.0, issueより前から存在)を明示指定すると b_staticpic より優先される(build.py:1417-1425)ため、ヘルパーlibに pic:false を渡せば報告の課題は回避できる。ただし報告者自身が既にこの条件付き設定手法に言及し『理想的にはもっと良い方法が欲しい』と述べており、原triageの『pic kwargで解決=fixed』は経緯を正確に反映していないので revise とする(専用の新機能は追加されていない)。
verify_risk_ja: 報告者は元々この手法を知った上で『もっと良い方法が欲しい』と書いているため、専用機能が無いことを理由に不満が残る可能性がある。

title: dependency module requirements based on dependency version.
rationale_ja: dependency()のmodules指定にバージョン条件を埋め込む構文(dict形式等)の設計提案。API設計の議論が必要で、現状そのような構文は未実装。デザイン検討として残す。
evidence: No dict-with-version modules syntax found in dependency() kwargs handling
implementation_hint: Design discussion needed for encoding per-module version constraints in dependency(modules: ...). Proposed dict syntax {'name': {'version': '>=7'}} would require extending the modules kwarg type and the LLVM/config-tool dependency backends to evaluate per-module version predicates.

title: rpaths_for_bundled_shared_libraries adds unnecessary RPATH for pkg-config dependencies and causes linking failure
rationale_ja: FreeBSD上のJHBuild prefixでpkg-config依存に不要なRPATHが付与されリンク失敗する0.47回帰。RPATH計算ロジックはその後大幅に書き換えられており(rpath_dirs_to_remove機構等)、最新版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: rpath logic reworked; backends.py uses rpath_dirs_to_remove mechanism; original rpaths_for_bundled_shared_libraries function no longer present by that name
draft_comment: The RPATH computation code has been substantially reworked since 0.47 (including how bundled/pkg-config library rpaths are handled and filtered). Could you check whether this linking failure still reproduces on a current Meson release in your JHBuild/FreeBSD setup? Without an updated reproducer we'll close this as stale.

title: meson won't link libgcc and libstdc++ statically in the 32-bit mingw environment
rationale_ja: 32bit mingwで-static-libstdc++/-static-libgccを自動付与する要望。組み込みオプションは存在せず、現状はlink_argsで手動指定が必要。要望として有効。
evidence: docs/markdown/Creating-Linux-binaries.md:90 shows only manual LDFLAGS=-static-libstdc++; no built-in b_ option found
implementation_hint: Consider a built-in option (e.g. b_static_stdlib or similar) to pass -static-libstdc++/-static-libgcc for gcc/mingw, or document that this is intentionally left to link_args. Currently must be set manually via cpp_link_args / add_project_link_arguments.

title: Passing an empty string to install_data's install_dir parameter is equivalent to not specifying it at all
rationale_ja: install_dataのinstall_dir=''が未指定(None)と同じ扱いになり、$prefix直下でなくshare/projectnameに入る。現行コードも`if not install_dir:`でFalsy判定するため空文字列は依然区別されない。空文字列をprefix直下として扱う/エラー化する改善余地あり。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py ~2664 uses `if not install_dir:` which treats '' same as None
implementation_hint: In install_data (interpreter.py), distinguish empty string '' from None: currently `if not install_dir:` collapses both to the default. Decide whether '' should mean 'install into prefix root' (treat as prefix) or raise a clear error; join_paths('','lib') already yields 'lib', so behavior is inconsistent between the two calls.

title: Support a cross-platform symbol export list for library targets
rationale_ja: シンボル可視性のクロスプラットフォーム制御手段が整備された:gnu_symbol_visibility(0.48.0)、vs_module_defs(Windows .def, 1.3.0)、およびsnippetsモジュールのsymbol_visibility_header()マクロ生成。version-scriptのハードコードは不要になった。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml:263 gnu_symbol_visibility; executable.yaml:65 vs_module_defs; Snippets-module.md symbol_visibility_header()
draft_comment: Meson now offers cross-platform symbol export controls: `gnu_symbol_visibility` (ELF/GCC-style visibility, since 0.48.0), `vs_module_defs` for Windows .def files (extended to more target types), and the snippets module's `symbol_visibility_header()` to generate portable export/import macros (__declspec vs visibility attributes). Together these replace hardcoding `-Wl,--version-script`. Closing as addressed; please reopen if there's a specific export scenario these don't cover.

title: Manage unit test output directory
rationale_ja: テストが書き込み可能な既知の専用出力ディレクトリを提供し、実行前にクリアする要望。test()にworkdir等はあるが、自動管理される『クリーンな出力ディレクトリ』機能は未整備。設計検討が必要な有効要望。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/test.yaml has workdir but no auto-created/cleaned per-test output directory
implementation_hint: Consider providing an env var (e.g. MESON_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR) pointing to a per-test-run scratch dir under the build dir that meson creates and clears before test runs. Needs design (per-test vs shared, cleanup timing).

title: Meson passes incorrect rpath to linker on macOS
rationale_ja: macOS上でgcc-mp-8使用時に誤ったrpath($ORIGIN/../src)が渡される0.47.2の報告。macOSは@rpath/@loader_path系を使うための処理が整備され、rpath計算は大幅に書き換えられている。再現確認が必要。
evidence: rpath handling reworked in backends.py/depfixer.py since 0.47; macOS uses install_name_tool-based rpath fixing
draft_comment: The rpath handling (including macOS-specific behavior) has been reworked considerably since 0.47.2. Could you verify whether an incorrect rpath is still emitted with a current Meson release when building with a non-Apple gcc on macOS? If it still reproduces, a minimal project plus the exact link line would help; otherwise we'll close as stale.

title: The cmd_array() call on get_compiler() does not include compiler flags
rationale_ja: cmd_array()はコンパイラの実行コマンドのみを返す仕様で、c_args等のフラグを含まないのは意図的(ドキュメント記載)。クロスファイルの引数を得るにはget_compiler().get_supported_arguments等ではなくoption/機構を使うべき。仕様説明で回答可能。
evidence: docs/yaml/objects/compiler.yaml:189 cmd_array returns 'the command(s) for the compiler' (exelist only, by design)
draft_comment: This is working as intended: `cmd_array()` returns only the compiler executable/command list, not user or cross-file argument flags (see the reference manual). Flags from `c_args`, the cross file's `[built-in options]`, etc. are applied by Meson's build rules, not embedded in `cmd_array()`. If you need the compiler plus specific args, retrieve the options explicitly (e.g. via `get_option()` / machine-file properties) and append them yourself. Closing as answered; let us know if you think a dedicated API to expose the effective compiler args is warranted.

title: Shared precompiled header
rationale_ja: 複数のlibrary()間で同一PCHを一度だけプリコンパイルして共有する要望。現状PCHはターゲット毎に生成される。PCHは各ターゲットのフラグに依存するため共有には設計上の考慮が必要。有効な要望として残す。
evidence: b_pch option exists (Builtin-options.md:243) but PCH is generated per-target; no shared-PCH mechanism
implementation_hint: Sharing a single precompiled header across multiple targets is non-trivial because PCH validity depends on each target's compile flags/defines/include dirs. Would need a mechanism to detect flag-compatible targets and reuse the .gch/.pch, or an explicit shared-pch target concept.

title: Results of find_program('some-script') should be consistent, irrespective of value of PATHEXT
rationale_ja: Windowsでの拡張子なしスクリプトのfind_programがPATHEXTに依存する問題。programs.pyに_search_windows_special_casesが追加され、PATHEXTに依存せずPATH内スクリプトを検索するようになった。
evidence: mesonbuild/programs.py:301-350 _search_windows_special_cases manually searches PATH for scripts (independent of PATHEXT)
draft_comment: find_program's Windows behavior has been made more robust: `programs.py` now has special-case handling that searches PATH for scripts independently of PATHEXT (including reading shebangs), so results are more consistent regardless of whether e.g. `.py` is in PATHEXT. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you still see PATHEXT-dependent inconsistency on a current release.

title: Allow specifying a separate tool for assembling .s/.S files
rationale_ja: アセンブラを別ツールとして扱う要望。現在nasm/masm/armasm/yasmが独立した言語(コンパイラクラス)として登録され、project()で追加すれば専用アセンブラ(例:MSVC環境でarmasm)を使える。gas-preprocessor等の需要も言語追加で対応可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/asm.py: NasmCompiler, YasmCompiler, MasmCompiler(id 'ml'), MasmARMCompiler(id 'armasm'); languages 'nasm'/'masm' registered as separate languages
draft_comment: Meson now supports several assemblers as distinct languages/compilers: `nasm`, `yasm`, `masm` (ml/ml64) and `armasm` (see mesonbuild/compilers/asm.py). You can add the relevant language in `project()` (or `add_languages()`) so assembly is handled by a dedicated assembler rather than the C compiler, which addresses the MSVC + ARM `.s`/`.S` case (via armasm, optionally with a gas-preprocessor wrapper). Closing as addressed; please reopen if your specific assembler still isn't supported.

title: Order of "-I" arguments causes compiler to pick wrong header
rationale_ja: 依存のinclude dirがユーザーの-I .より先に来て誤ったヘッダを拾う問題。dependency()のinclude_type:'system'を使うと依存のヘッダが-isystemで渡され、ユーザーの-Iが優先される。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/dependency.yaml:200 include_type supports 'system' (converts include flags to -isystem); ninjabackend.py handles -isystem ordering (appended)
draft_comment: You can fix this with `implicit_include_directories: false` on the target, as noted above. By default Meson prepends the target's own source and build directories as `-I` before dependency include dirs (see `generate_basic_compiler_args` in `mesonbuild/backend/ninjabackend.py`), which is why your local `drm.h` shadows libdrm's for `#include <drm.h>`. Setting `implicit_include_directories: false` on the `executable()`/`library()` drops those implicit `-I.`/`-I..` entries so the dependency's `-I/usr/include/libdrm` is found first. (Note: `dependency(..., include_type: 'system')` would not help here -- it moves the dependency dir to `-isystem`, which is searched *after* `-I` dirs, so the local header would still win.) Closing as answered via `implicit_include_directories: false`.
verify_signal_ja: 最終コメントは2019-03-06の baraclese による『executable() に implicit_include_directories:false を付けると解決する』という回避策提示。メンテナ議論はない。
verify_reason_ja: 報告者はローカルの ./drm.h が -I. により libdrm の <drm.h> より先に拾われることを問題視している。正しい解法はスレッド内で示された implicit_include_directories:false(暗黙の -I<srcdir>/-I<builddir> を除去、ninjabackend.py:3196-3199 で確認)であり、原triageの include_type:'system' は逆効果(-isystem は -I より後に探索されるためローカルヘッダが依然優先されて解決しない)。よって closeable だが助言を訂正する必要があり revise。
verify_risk_ja: implicit_include_directories:false は当該ターゲットの自ソース/ビルドディレクトリを include パスから外すため、同名以外の相対 include に依存しているプロジェクトでは別のビルドエラーを招く可能性がある点は付記が望ましい。

title: Unable to use extract_objects() for Vala unit tests
rationale_ja: Vala+extract_objects()でsrc/接頭辞が欠落し生成オブジェクト名が食い違いninjaが失敗するバグ。Vala固有のオブジェクト名/パス処理に関わる問題で、#4413と密接に関連。再現確認と修正が必要な有効なバグ。
evidence: Vala extract_objects path handling; related to #4413; no clear fix evidence found locally
implementation_hint: Investigate Vala object-file naming when extract_objects() is used with sources in a subdirectory: the '_src' path component is dropped in the test target's object name, causing a ninja missing-rule error. Likely in how Vala generated .c object paths are computed for extracted objects. Related to #4413.

title: Reimplement auto pull of wraps downloaded by vcs as documented.
rationale_ja: VCS(git) wrapの自動pull再実装。現在update_git()は存在するが手動の`meson subprojects update`実行時のみ動作し、configure時の自動pullは行わない。文書化された自動更新挙動の復元は未完で有効。
evidence: mesonbuild/msubprojects.py:314-422 update_git() exists but only via `meson subprojects update`; no auto-pull on configure
implementation_hint: `meson subprojects update` implements git updating (update_git in msubprojects.py), but the documented auto-pull-on-configure for VCS wraps is not restored. Decide whether to re-add automatic pulling per the wrap manual or update the docs to reflect the explicit `subprojects update` workflow.

title: How to cross compile for ARM with MSVC?
rationale_ja: MSVCで単一PATH/LIBのままARMクロスビルドする方法の質問。現在はvsenv自動活性化(utils/vsenv)とネイティブ/クロスファイルでのcl設定が整備され、native fileでビルドマシンのclを別途指定する等で対応可能。使い方の回答で閉じられる。
evidence: mesonbuild/utils/vsenv.py (setup_vsenv); native/cross file separation lets you specify the build-machine cl independently
draft_comment: For MSVC cross builds you separate the two toolchains using a native file and a cross file: run inside the ARM (host) vcvars environment for the cross file's `cl`, and point a native file at the x64/x86 build-machine `cl` (with its own LIB) so the native sanity check uses a runnable compiler. Meson also auto-activates a Visual Studio environment (`setup_vsenv`) when appropriate. If you can share what you tried, we can advise on the exact native/cross file contents. Closing as answered; reopen if you hit a concrete blocker.

title: Add callgraph ninja target
rationale_ja: scan-buildのようにcallgraph(dotファイル)を生成するninjaターゲット追加の要望。LLVM IR収集→llvm-link→opt -dot-callgraphのパイプラインが必要で、現状該当ターゲットは無い。有効なニッチ機能要望。
evidence: No callgraph/dot-callgraph target found in mesonbuild/
implementation_hint: Add an optional callgraph target (similar to the scan-build target) that builds with clang -emit-llvm, runs llvm-link then opt -dot-callgraph. Likely niche; consider whether it belongs as a first-class target or documented recipe.

title: Need a mechanism for Vala to resolve symbols when using extract_objects()
rationale_ja: Vala+extract_objects()でシンボル解決ができない設計上の問題。Valaソースを再度コンパイラに渡すと重複C/オブジェクトが生じる等トレードオフがあり、Vala統合の設計検討が必要。#4385と同根の有効な課題。
evidence: Vala + extract_objects symbol resolution; deep Vala/C generation interaction; no local fix evidence
implementation_hint: Vala unit-testing via extract_objects needs a way to pass the .vala source to valac for symbol resolution without generating a duplicate C object. Requires design in the Vala backend to share the generated .c/objects between the library and the test target. Closely tied to #4385.

title: Meson uses install_name_tool on incompatible binaries
rationale_ja: macOS上でクロスビルドしたWindows DLL等にinstall_name_toolを実行して失敗する問題。fix_darwin()は先にotoolを実行し、非Mach-Oでotoolが失敗するとCalledProcessErrorを捕捉して早期returnするため、非対応バイナリで例外を投げなくなった。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/depfixer.py:753 fix_darwin catches subprocess.CalledProcessError from get_darwin_rpaths (otool) on non-executable/non-Mach-O targets and returns
draft_comment: The install-name/rpath fixer now guards against this: `fix_darwin()` first runs `otool` (get_darwin_rpaths) and, if that fails because the file isn't a Mach-O binary, it catches the error and returns instead of invoking `install_name_tool`. So cross-compiled non-Mach-O outputs (e.g. a mingw DLL) are skipped. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a reproducer if install_name_tool is still run on an incompatible binary.

title: Ninja goes into a reconfigure loop when the machine time goes backwards
rationale_ja: システム時刻が巻き戻るとmeson.buildがbuild.ninjaより新しく見え、ninjaが再構成ループに陥る問題。regenはninjaのdirty判定に依存し、mesonが完全には制御できない。エッジケースとして有効、要設計。
evidence: regen_checker.py handles VS/Xcode regen (mtime based); ninja REGENERATE rule relies on ninja's own mtime comparison; no explicit time-backwards guard found
implementation_hint: Consider detecting, after writing build.ninja, whether meson.build's mtime is newer (clock went backwards) and warning/erroring rather than allowing ninja to loop. Note ninja's regen dirty-check is largely outside Meson's control; may need a sentinel timestamp file approach.

title: Missing checks on wrap `directory` option
rationale_ja: 同一subprojectsフォルダ内で複数の.wrapが同じ`directory`値を持てる問題。add_wrap/merge_wrapsはprovided_deps等の重複は検査するが、directory値の全体重複検査は行わない。明確なエラー化が望ましい小規模実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/wrap/wrap.py:423-430 checks duplicate provided_deps/programs but not duplicate directory across wraps; directory validated only as non-path (line ~212)
implementation_hint: In the wrap loader (wrap.py add_wrap/load_all), detect when two .wrap files resolve to the same `directory` and raise a clear WrapException identifying both wrap files, rather than failing later with a confusing conflicting-target error.

title: Meson doesn't link to Boost correctly on NetBSD
rationale_ja: NetBSDでBoost(/usr/pkg/lib)のライブラリがrpath無しでリンクされ実行不可の問題。boost.pyの検索パスは/usr/local, /opt/local, /usr等を含むがNetBSD固有の/usr/pkgは明示されておらず、rpath付与も不足。有効なプラットフォーム課題。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/boost.py:729-732 adds /usr/local, /opt/local, /usr but not NetBSD /usr/pkg; no rpath for boost libdir
implementation_hint: Add NetBSD's pkgsrc prefix (/usr/pkg) to Boost search roots in boost.py, and ensure the Boost library directory is added to the target rpath (or link with an absolute path) so executables run without a manual LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

title: Get build target compiler flags
rationale_ja: ビルドターゲットに使われたコンパイラフラグをmeson.build内(または生成物)から取得する要望。ターゲットオブジェクトに該当メソッドは無く、introspectionは依存のcompile_argsは出すがターゲットの実効フラグは公開していない。有効な要望。
evidence: mesonbuild/mintro.py:352 exposes dependency compile_args but list_targets does not expose per-target effective compile flags; no build target method for flags
implementation_hint: Options: (a) expose per-target effective compile args via meson introspection (mintro.py list_targets), and/or (b) add a way to bake flags into a generated header/config (configure_file) for the program to print. A build-target method returning effective compile args would need care since flags are per-source/per-language.

title: [freestanding C/C++] Unable to include crt*.o files on the linking stage in the right order
rationale_ja: フリースタンディングでcrti/crtbegin...crtend/crtnを正しい順序でリンクする手段の要望。link_early_args(オブジェクト/ライブラリより前に挿入)が追加され前方配置は可能になったが、末尾(crtend/crtn)配置や完全な順序制御は依然課題。設計検討要。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml:102 link_early_args (inserted before object files/libraries); no dedicated post-object crt mechanism
implementation_hint: link_early_args now allows placing objects/flags before object files/libraries (helps crti/crtbegin). Full crt ordering (crtend/crtn after everything) still lacks a clean mechanism; consider documenting the recommended approach or adding post-link-args placement guarantees.

title: Automatically find dependencies on standard locations on BSD systems
rationale_ja: BSD系の標準パッケージ位置(FreeBSD/OpenBSD/DragonFly:/usr/local、NetBSD:/usr/pkg)を依存探索に含める要望。現状find_library/依存探索はこれらを体系的に扱わず、反応(reactions 5)もある有効なプラットフォーム要望。
evidence: clike get_compiler_dirs returns [] by default; no systematic BSD /usr/local or /usr/pkg include/lib search for dependencies
implementation_hint: Add BSD standard prefixes to the default library/header search for find_library and relevant dependency backends: /usr/local (FreeBSD/OpenBSD/DragonFly), /usr/pkg (NetBSD). Guard by host system so it doesn't affect other platforms.

title: gnome.compile_schemas() documentation seems wrong
rationale_ja: gnome.compile_schemas()のbuild_by_defaultドキュメントと実挙動の食い違いの報告。ドキュメントはyaml化され再生成されている。ドキュメント/挙動どちらを直すか最新版での確認が必要。
evidence: gnome module docs migrated to docs/yaml/modules/gnome; compile_schemas build_by_default default needs re-verification
draft_comment: The gnome module documentation has since been migrated to our generated reference (docs/yaml). Could you confirm on a current release whether `gnome.compile_schemas()` still requires an explicit `build_by_default: true`, and whether the reference now matches the behavior? If it's a doc mismatch we'll fix the reference; otherwise please share a minimal reproducer. Closing as stale if we don't hear back.

title: Can not use gnome.compile_resources to produce two gresource files with the same base name
rationale_ja: 異なるサブディレクトリで同じベース名のgresourceを2つ作ると内部ターゲット名(target_name+'_gresource')が衝突する。現行コードもname=f'{target_name}_gresource'で生成しサブディレクトリを含めないため衝突し得る。ターゲット名にサブディレクトリを含める改善余地あり。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:491-492 name = f'{target_name}_gresource' (no subdir component)
implementation_hint: In gnome.compile_resources, make the internal target name unique by incorporating state.subdir (or a hash of it) so two same-base-name gresource bundles in different subdirectories don't collide, while keeping the output filename unchanged.

title: Feature Request: make ProjectGuid deterministic for MSVC backends
rationale_ja: 【スレッド精査で降格 / 元fixed判定は誤り】トリアージが根拠にした generate_guid_from_path()(uuid5,決定的)は subdir/directory 用にしか使われておらず、実ターゲットの ProjectGuid は interpreter.py:3509 で今も str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()(ランダム)で生成される。coredataにキャッシュされ再configureでは安定するが、新規ビルドディレクトリでは毎回異なるGUIDになり、要求する「決定性」は満たされていない。これは#106型の誤検出。
evidence: mesonbuild/backend/vs2010backend.py:100-101 generate_guid_from_path uses uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, ...) (deterministic, not uuid4)
verify_signal_ja: コメントは1件も無いが、要求は「連続実行で同一ProjectGuidを生成せよ(決定的GUID)」で未解決。
verify_reason_ja: トリアージが根拠にした generate_guid_from_path()(uuid5,決定的)は subdir/directory 用にしか使われておらず、実ターゲットの ProjectGuid は interpreter.py:3509 で今も str(uuid.uuid4()).upper()(ランダム)で生成される。coredataにキャッシュされ再configureでは安定するが、新規ビルドディレクトリでは毎回異なるGUIDになり、要求する「決定性」は満たされていない。これは#106型の誤検出。

title: How to add default include directories for library found with compiler.find_library
rationale_ja: find_libraryで見つけたライブラリのヘッダディレクトリをハードコードせず追加したいという質問。find_libraryはリンク検索のみでヘッダ位置を知り得ず、pkg-config/declare_dependency/include_directoriesを使うのが正攻法。has_headers等の確認用kwargはあるが自動追加はしない。使い方の回答で閉じられる。
evidence: docs/yaml/objects/compiler.yaml find_library has dirs/has_headers/header_include_directories (for checking, not for propagating include dirs to consumers)
draft_comment: `compiler.find_library()` only performs link-time library resolution; it has no way to know where a library's headers live, so it can't auto-add include directories. The idiomatic options are: use `dependency()`/pkg-config if available; otherwise wrap the found library plus its headers with `declare_dependency(dependencies: found_lib, include_directories: include_directories('...'))`, or pass `include_directories()` explicitly. (find_library's `has_headers`/`header_include_directories` are for verifying headers exist during the search, not for propagating include paths.) Closing as answered.

title: Cannot get Meson to work with Android NDK cross-compilation on Windows
rationale_ja: Windows上のAndroid NDKクロスコンパイルで『Unknown compiler(s): cl/cc/gcc/clang』エラーになる0.48時代の報告。当時のNDKツールチェーン/クロスファイル設定の問題。NDKサポートやクロスファイル処理は改善されており、最新版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: Android referenced in Reference-tables.md and recent release notes; NDK toolchain handling improved since 0.48
draft_comment: This is an old (0.48) report and Android/NDK handling plus cross-file processing have improved since. The error indicates the native compiler detection ran; make sure your cross file's `[binaries]` point to valid NDK clang wrappers and that you're not missing a native compiler for build-machine tools. Could you retry with a current Meson release and the NDK's standard meson cross file? If it still fails, please attach the full log; otherwise we'll close as stale.

title: Allow specifying default compilers in meson.build
rationale_ja: meson.build内で優先/デフォルトコンパイラを指定する要望(project()オプション等)。現状project()にそのようなkwargは無く、コンパイラ選択はCC/CXX環境変数かnative fileのみ。reactions 9と関心が高いが、設計議論が必要な大きめの要望。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py func_project has no default/preferred compiler kwarg; selection only via CC/CXX or native file
implementation_hint: Design needed: a way for a project to express preferred/allowed compilers (e.g. a project() kwarg or meson.build API) that influences default compiler detection order without overriding explicit user CC/native-file choices. Interacts with cross/native files and machine detection; likely warrants an RFC-style discussion.

title: RFC: Do not check for builtins in has_function, add has_builtin
rationale_ja: has_builtin_define は存在するが、has_function から builtin チェックを外し独立した has_builtin を追加するという RFC の本質は未実装。API 設計の議論が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:691 has_builtin_define exists; compilers.py:834 has_function still checks builtins
implementation_hint: Add a dedicated compiler.has_builtin() method (mapping to __has_builtin / GCC builtin probing) and stop treating builtins specially in has_function; needs a deprecation path for the existing behavior.

title: Wrap HTTPS SSL fallback redirects to HTTPS again
rationale_ja: corporate proxy の SSL inspection 環境で wrap の HTTP フォールバックが機能しないという報告。wrapdb は現在 HTTPS 前提で運用されており、根本は証明書検証の扱い方の設計問題。
evidence: mesonbuild/wrap/wrap.py (fallback logic area referenced in issue)
implementation_hint: Rather than an HTTP fallback that gets re-upgraded, offer a way to point at a custom CA bundle / disable verification explicitly for corporate-proxy users.

title: Multiple @BASENAME@ for configure_file() raising warning
rationale_ja: 現在の configure_file は @BASENAME@ を入力から解決した後の最終出力パスで重複チェックしているため、異なる入力なら異なる出力となり誤警告は出なくなっている。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:2840-2857 (output resolved via substitute_values before overlap check on ofile_rpath)
draft_comment: In current Meson the overwrite warning is checked against the fully-resolved output path: @BASENAME@ in `output:` is substituted from each input before the overlap check runs, so two `configure_file()` calls with different inputs produce different output names and no longer trigger this warning. Please reopen if you can still reproduce a false warning on a recent release.

title: gnome.generate_gir uses improper shared-library with executable and ASAN
rationale_ja: ASAN 有効時に generate_gir が libasan.so を shared-library として書き込む問題。gnome モジュール固有で GObject Introspection の挙動に関わり、再現確認と設計が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py (generate_gir)
implementation_hint: Filter sanitizer runtime libraries (libasan/libubsan/...) out of the shared-library list written into the .gir when scanning an executable/library built with b_sanitize.

title: dependency fails to find lua on ubuntu 18.04
rationale_ja: 2018年当時の lua pkg-config 命名(lua5.3 等)の問題。dependency('lua') は複数候補名を試すよう改善されており、古い報告で再現確認が必要。
evidence: Ubuntu ships lua5.3.pc; meson dependency lookup tries multiple pkg-config names
draft_comment: Lua on Debian/Ubuntu ships its pkg-config file as `lua5.3` (etc.) rather than plain `lua`, and Meson's dependency lookup has since improved. Could you retest with a current Meson and, if it still fails, provide the versions and the meson-log.txt? Otherwise we'll close this as stale.

title: Not able to change executable's directory
rationale_ja: ユーザーの誤解。install_dir はビルド時ではなく `ninja install` 時の配置先を指定するもので、ビルド出力位置は変わらない。仕様通りの挙動。
evidence: docs: install_dir applies to install step, not build tree layout
draft_comment: This is expected behaviour: `install_dir` controls where files go when you run `ninja install` (into the prefix), not where they are placed inside the build directory. The executable staying in the build dir and being copied to `<prefix>/bin` on install is correct. Closing as working-as-intended — feel free to reopen if something is still unclear.

title: How can attributes of a dependency (includes, compiler flags, etc.) be printed?
rationale_ja: 依存オブジェクトの include ディレクトリや compile/link 引数を取得・表示する汎用手段は今も無い(pkgconfig の get_variable のみ)。enhancement ラベル付きで最近も反応があり需要が高い。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreterobjects.py — dependency has get_variable/partial_dependency/as_system but no accessor for compile_args/include_directories; issue still active (updated 2026-02)
implementation_hint: Add dependency methods to introspect its compile args / include dirs (e.g. dep.get_compile_args(), dep.get_link_args()), or expose them via `meson introspect --dependencies`; useful for debugging stray include paths.

title: How to customize bindir setting from meson.build configuration file?
rationale_ja: 質問。bindir は default_options でプロジェクトのデフォルトを設定でき、-Dbindir=... でも上書き可能。ビルドツリー内配置の変更はできないが、install prefix 配下の bin パスは制御可能。
evidence: docs/markdown/Builtin-options.md (bindir builtin option); default_options
draft_comment: You can set `bindir` either from the command line (`-Dbindir=...`) or as a project default via `default_options: ['bindir=...']` in `project()`. Note this controls the install location under the prefix, not where binaries land inside the build tree. Closing as answered — please reopen if you had a different use case in mind.

title: Do something smarter with options
rationale_ja: オプション一覧の可読性改善という設計議論。maintainer(jpakkane) 発の RFC で、UI/設計の方向性が必要。
evidence: none
implementation_hint: Consider grouping/tagging options (e.g. an 'advanced' flag) and filtering them in `meson configure`; needs option-store schema changes.

title: Cannot access version in default_options
rationale_ja: default_options 内から meson.project_version() を呼ぶとクラッシュ。default_options はバージョン確定より前に評価されるため根本的な順序問題で、単なる例外化以上の対応が必要(exception ラベル付き、2025 更新)。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:1300-1341 (default_options initialized before self.project_version is set)
implementation_hint: Either evaluate project version before processing default_options so meson.project_version() is available, or raise a clear InterpreterException instead of a Python traceback when it is used too early.

title: Meson not fully respecting -I/-L inside CFLAGS/LDFLAGS
rationale_ja: find_library / get_define が CFLAGS/LDFLAGS の -I/-L を尊重しない件。設計上の意図的挙動(#1772 参照)との兼ね合いがあり、議論が必要。関連する #4694 と同種。
evidence: related to #1772, #4694; cross/native env handling
implementation_hint: Consider honoring env CFLAGS/LDFLAGS -I/-L in compiler.find_library()/get_define() search paths for native builds, or document the recommended `dirs:`/include_directories: workaround more prominently.

title: Python 3 can't be found on NetBSD 8.0 or DragonFlyBSD 5.2
rationale_ja: python3 が無く python3.6 のみの BSD 環境。find_installation は python3 未検出時に python へフォールバックするが、python3.X のような版付き名の探索はしない。非常に古い(meson 0.46-0.48)報告で再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:501-503 fallback only to 'python', not versioned names
draft_comment: As a workaround you can pass the exact interpreter name, e.g. `import('python').find_installation('python3.6')`, or point Meson at it via a native file / PATH. Meson is much newer now (this was reported against 0.46–0.48). Can you confirm whether `python3` discovery still fails on current NetBSD/DragonFlyBSD? We'll close as stale otherwise.

title: --as-needed is broken with gnu ld
rationale_ja: --start-group/--end-group は現在 link_whole 専用に限定されており、通常のライブラリリンクではグループで囲まれないため --as-needed が効くようになっている。
evidence: mesonbuild/linkers/linkers.py:1166-1169,1269-1272 (--start-group/--end-group only in get_link_whole_for); has_as_needed at linkers.py:1043,1062
draft_comment: Meson no longer wraps ordinary library links in `--start-group`/`--end-group`; those flags are now used only for `link_whole` targets. Regular shared libraries are placed outside any group, so `--as-needed` behaves correctly with GNU ld. Please reopen with a reproducer on a current release if you still see the problem.

title: test_generate_gir_with_address_sanitizer fails under the Gentoo package manager's sandbox
rationale_ja: meson 自体のユニットテストが Gentoo sandbox の LD_PRELOAD 競合で失敗する件。テストは今も存在(unittests/linuxliketests.py)。ディストリ固有の実行環境の問題で、上流での対応可否は要確認。
evidence: unittests/linuxliketests.py still contains test_generate_gir_with_address_sanitizer
draft_comment: This test still exists in the current suite. Since it is fundamentally a conflict between the sandbox and ASan both wanting LD_PRELOAD, the usual approach is to skip it in the packaging environment. Is this still an active problem for Gentoo on a recent Meson? If not, we'll close this as stale.

title: Use native files for saving the command line
rationale_ja: 設定した全オプションを再投入可能な形(native file 等)で出力する機能要望。cmd_line.txt は保存されるが再利用可能なファイル生成は未実装で、maintainer 議論(14 コメント)あり。
evidence: coredata saves cmd_line.txt but no export-to-native-file feature found
implementation_hint: Add a `meson configure` sub-mode (or introspection output) that emits the current option set as a native/machine-file or a re-usable `-D` command line.

title: pkg-config missing dependency not reported
rationale_ja: pkg-config の内部エラー(依存 .pc 欠落)がユーザーに伝わらないという古い報告。現在は meson-log.txt に pkg-config の stderr が記録される。再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py logs pkg-config stderr to meson-log
draft_comment: Meson now records the pkg-config invocation and its stderr in meson-log.txt, which typically surfaces the underlying 'Package X, required by Y, not found' message. Could you check meson-log.txt on a current release and confirm whether the real error is still hidden? We'll close as stale otherwise.

title: meson --wipe forgets about CFLAGS and friends
rationale_ja: --wipe 後に環境由来の CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS が失われるバグ。bug ラベル付きで 2025 まで更新あり。環境変数の永続化方針に関わる設計判断が必要。
evidence: labels: bug, mesa/wayland/xorg; issue active (updated 2025-03)
implementation_hint: Persist the environment-derived compiler flags captured at first configure into coredata so that --wipe (a reconfigure from saved state) can restore them instead of re-reading the possibly-empty environment.

title: Explicitly disable pie when pie is false
rationale_ja: b_pie=false のとき -no-pie を明示的に渡す処理は未実装。get_pie_args は -fPIE を返すのみで、無効化側の引数生成が無い。小規模な追加で対応可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/gnu.py:381-382 get_pie_args returns ['-fPIE'] only; no -no-pie emitted when b_pie is false
implementation_hint: Add a get_no_pie_link_args()/get_pie_link_args(disable=...) path so that when b_pie is explicitly false, GCC/Clang linkers receive `-no-pie` (and `-fno-PIE` for compile), overriding distro defaults.

title: Support positional arguments also as kwargs
rationale_ja: 辞書展開でキーワード引数は指定できるが、位置引数を辞書経由で渡す仕組みは未実装。言語仕様の設計判断が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreterbase/interpreterbase.py (dict->kwargs supported; no positional-from-dict mechanism)
implementation_hint: Design a syntax for supplying positional args from a variable/dict (e.g. a reserved key); requires careful interpreter/language design and documentation.

title: Possibility to depend on the tarball generated by `ninja dist`
rationale_ja: dist tarball を custom_target の入力/依存として使いたいという要望。dist は現状ビルドグラフ外の別ステップで、これを通常ターゲットの依存に組み込むのは大きな設計変更。
evidence: dist is a separate meson step, not a build.ninja target usable as input
implementation_hint: Would require exposing the dist tarball as a first-class target in the build graph (or an rpm/packaging module); significant design work.

title: Meson RPATH munging can yield libraries that break ldconfig on Linux
rationale_ja: 空 install_rpath 時に RPATH エントリを除去する処理が一部の非準拠ツール(ldconfig, chrpath)を混乱させる件。depfixer は改良されているが remove_rpath_entry の基本手法(タグを0化して末尾移動)は残り、根本対応は要検討。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/depfixer.py:705-724 remove_rpath_entry still zeroes tag and reorders .dynamic
implementation_hint: Investigate rewriting remove_rpath_entry to produce ELF that naive tools (ldconfig/chrpath) parse correctly — e.g. properly compacting the .dynamic section rather than moving a zeroed entry to the end.

title: Document which functions / methods are run completely at configure time.
rationale_ja: configure_file や run_command 等が configure 時に完結する旨をドキュメント化する要望。地道な文書作業で価値はあるが未完了。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/*.yaml — no systematic 'runs at configure time' annotation
implementation_hint: Annotate the reference docs (docs/yaml/functions) noting which functions with side effects execute entirely at configure time (configure_file, run_command, etc.).

title: cross build definition file not flexible enough to support cross compilation
rationale_ja: クロスファイルで環境変数由来の flags を動的に取り込みたい(devkitPro 事例)という要望。cross file で env の CFLAGS 等を無視する設計(#1772)に起因し、方針の議論が必要。
evidence: related #1772; cross files intentionally ignore env CFLAGS
implementation_hint: Consider a documented mechanism to reference environment variables from within machine files, or an opt-in to honor env CFLAGS/LDFLAGS during cross builds.

title: pkgconfig generator should create the same Libs/Libs.private for all library types
rationale_ja: pkgconfig.generate が shared/static/library で Libs/Libs.private の出力を変える件を統一したいという要望。module:pkgconfig ラベル付きで、生成方針の設計判断が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py (Libs/Libs.private generation varies by target type)
implementation_hint: Normalize .pc generation so private link args are always emitted under Libs.private regardless of shared/static/library target type; evaluate compatibility impact.

title: Add linker args for specific dependencies
rationale_ja: 特定の依存だけにリンカ引数を付けたいという要望。2025 まで更新のある継続的な need。per-dependency の引数注入 API の設計が必要。
evidence: issue active (updated 2025-10); no per-dependency link_args mechanism
implementation_hint: Consider a way to attach extra link args scoped to a single dependency (e.g. declare_dependency wrapping, or a link_args field on the dependency use-site).

title: Fortran: .mod .smod modules files not installed or found from other directories
rationale_ja: Fortran の .mod/.smod ファイルのインストールとディレクトリ間参照が未対応という要望。language:fortran と install targets ラベル付きで 2025 更新あり。複数モジュール生成の扱いなど設計が必要。
evidence: labels: install targets, language:fortran; issue active (updated 2025-07)
implementation_hint: Add support to install generated Fortran .mod/.smod interface files (handling multiple modules per source) and to locate them from dependent targets/subprojects.

title: Suggestion: add_executable_arguments()
rationale_ja: 作成済みターゲットに後から引数を追加する API 要望だが、Meson の宣言的モデルに反する。空オプション時のコンパイルエラー回避は、空配列や条件付き c_args 構築で解決可能。
evidence: meson build model: target args set at declaration; empty c_args list is valid
draft_comment: Meson's build model sets a target's arguments at declaration time, so a post-hoc `add_executable_arguments()` doesn't fit well. For your use case you can pass an empty list when the option is unset (`c_args: extra_args` where `extra_args = []`), which is valid and avoids the dummy `-DNONE` hack. Closing as out of scope, but happy to discuss further.

title: File objects should be able to represent directories
rationale_ja: files()/File が今もディレクトリを表現できない(ファイルのみ)。custom_target の入力にディレクトリを渡す正当なユースケースがあり、型システムに関わる大きめの変更。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/files.yaml (files() returns array[file], varargs are file paths only)
implementation_hint: Introduce a way to reference directories as inputs (e.g. a Directory object or a directory-aware File), so custom_target inputs like asset trees are first-class instead of raw strings.

title: Remove element from a list
rationale_ja: 配列プリミティブには contains/length/get/slice/flatten はあるが delete/remove は無い。Meson の配列は不変設計のため、新メソッド追加には言語方針の合意が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/primitives/array.py:54-119 (no delete/remove method; arrays are immutable)
implementation_hint: Could add a non-mutating array method returning a copy with a value removed (consistent with Meson's immutable arrays); needs a decision on semantics for duplicates/missing values.

title: `compiler.run()` should use `MESON_BUILD_ROOT` as current working directory
rationale_ja: compiler.run() の feature-detection がファイルを作る場合、ビルドディレクトリを cwd にすべきという要望。妥当だが挙動変更の影響確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py / compilers run implementation (cwd handling)
implementation_hint: Run the compiled feature-test binary with the build directory (or a temp dir under it) as cwd so stray files land inside the build tree rather than the current dir.

title: Meson ignores RCFLAGS in the windows resources compiler
rationale_ja: windows.compile_resources が RCFLAGS 環境変数を尊重しない件。RC/WINDRES 環境変数は windres バイナリの位置解決にのみ使われ、引数(RCFLAGS)は取り込まれない。module:windows ラベル付きで 2026 更新の継続 need。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:136 maps RC/WINDRES to the windres binary only; mesonbuild/modules/windows.py:121 uses only kwargs['args'], no RCFLAGS env
implementation_hint: Read an RCFLAGS-style env var (or a windows-resource args option) and append it to res_args in windows.compile_resources, mirroring how CFLAGS is picked up for compilers.

title: Convert CFLAGS et al to build options
rationale_ja: 環境 CFLAGS の -O2/-g 等を解釈して対応する build option に変換する提案。maintainer 発の設計アイデアで、複雑さと副作用が大きく合意が必要。
evidence: none (no such translation logic found in tree)
implementation_hint: Parse well-known flags out of env CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS (-O*, -g, -std=) and map them onto optimization/debug/std options, leaving only unrecognized flags as raw args; needs careful design to avoid surprises.

title: dub dependency method cannot find libraries when they have other dependencies.
rationale_ja: dub 依存が推移的依存を持つと解決できないバグ。dependencies と language:D ラベル付きで 2026 更新あり。dub 統合の実バグで再現・修正が必要。
evidence: labels: dependencies, language:D; issue active (updated 2026-03); dub handling in mesonbuild/dependencies
implementation_hint: Fix the dub dependency resolver to recurse into a package's transitive dub dependencies (link args + import paths) rather than only the top-level package.

title: configure_file: Add config.vapi support
rationale_ja: configure_file が config.h のように config.vapi を生成できるようにする要望。現状 Vala 側は手書き .vapi をソースに含める運用で、専用生成機能は無い。設計が必要。
evidence: test cases/vala/4 config uses a hand-written config.vapi as a source; no config.vapi generation in configure_file
implementation_hint: Add a Vala-aware output mode (or a Vala module helper) that emits a config.vapi from configuration_data, analogous to config.h generation.

title: custom_target does not finish command properly
rationale_ja: custom_target で cat による連結が途中で切れる(gtkdoc 実行と干渉)という報告。capture の切り詰めか競合の可能性。古い libqmi 移植事例で再現確認が必要(module:gnome)。
evidence: module:gnome; capture-based custom_target concatenation
draft_comment: This looks like it may be a capture/ordering interaction specific to that gtkdoc pipeline. A lot has changed in custom_target and the gnome module since 2019. Are you still able to reproduce a truncated capture output on a current Meson? If not, we'll close this as stale.

title: compiler.find_library to take library version
rationale_ja: find_library に version/soversion を持たせる要望。現在の find_library kwargs には無く、versioned .so の解決に有用。enhancement ラベル付き。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py:664-676 find_library kwargs have no version/soversion
implementation_hint: Add optional `version:`/`soversion:` kwargs to compiler.find_library() that match versioned shared objects (e.g. libfoo.so.1.0.0) and their soname symlinks in the search dirs.

title: Add support for dotnet core from Microsoft
rationale_ja: dotnet core(Roslyn/ランタイム runner)対応の要望。C# 言語サポートの拡張で大規模。runner 実行や依存解決など設計が必要。
evidence: no dotnet-core language support in mesonbuild/compilers

title: No warning if vcs_tag() and configure_file() have the same output file
rationale_ja: configure_file 同士の出力衝突は警告されるが、vcs_tag() と configure_file() が同一出力の場合は警告されない。既存の configure_file_outputs 追跡を vcs_tag にも拡張すればよい。bug ラベル付き。

title: Meson should not (try to) modify jarfiles
rationale_ja: install 時に depfixer が .jar のマニフェストから Class-Path を除去するため jar 実行ファイルが必須になる件。fix_jar は現在も存在し無条件に .jar を対象とする。bug/language:java ラベル付きで 2026 更新あり。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/depfixer.py:792-823 fix_jar still runs unconditionally on any installed *.jar
implementation_hint: Only run fix_jar on jars Meson itself built (jar targets), or make manifest Class-Path stripping opt-in, so installing a prebuilt/third-party .jar does not require the `jar` tool or mutate its manifest.

title: Allow setting the pkg-config search path in the native file

title: Help / Documentation wanted for how to integrate third-party lib
rationale_ja: サードパーティ製ビルドの統合方法の質問。現在は External-Project module が存在し、autotools/cmake ベースの外部プロジェクトをビルド・pkg-config 経由で利用可能。
evidence: docs/markdown/External-Project-module.md (External-Project module)
draft_comment: For integrating a third-party project that has its own build system, Meson now provides the External Project module (see docs/markdown/External-Project-module.md), which builds an autotools/CMake project inside your build and exposes it as a dependency (including via pkg-config). That should cover the use case here. Closing as answered — please reopen if it doesn't fit.

title: Support using existing library builds of gmock and gtest
rationale_ja: gtest/gmock の事前ビルド済みライブラリ利用は対応済み。DependencyFactory が pkgconfig と system 両方を持ち、system は find_library でプリビルトを最優先に検出、無ければソースからビルドにフォールバックする。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py:62-83 detect() tries find_library('gtest') first (prebuilt=True) before src build; GTestDependencyPC/GMockDependencyPC (pkgconfig) at 106,176; DependencyFactory at 809-820
draft_comment: Meson already supports using prebuilt gtest/gmock. `dependency('gtest')` / `dependency('gmock')` use a DependencyFactory that first tries pkg-config (`GTestDependencyPC` / `GMockDependencyPC`), then a system lookup that prefers prebuilt libraries via `find_library('gtest')` / `find_library('gmock')` and only falls back to building the bundled sources if no library is found. As a commenter here confirmed back in 2019, external/system googletest and gmock work fine. Closing as resolved; please reopen if the prebuilt Fedora/Debian libraries aren't being picked up on a current release.
verify_signal_ja: 最終コメント(wak-google, 2019-02-13)が『システムの外部gtest/gmockを問題なく使えている』と実利用を確認しており、反対意見は無い。
verify_reason_ja: dev.py の GTestDependencySystem/GMockDependencySystem は find_library('gtest'/'gmock') でプリビルトを最優先に検出し(prebuilt=True)、無い時のみバンドルソースへフォールバックする。加えて GTestDependencyPC/GMockDependencyPC(pkg-config)も DependencyFactory に登録済みで、要求されたプリビルトライブラリ利用は完全に実装されている。

title: Make `c_std=c90` an alias for `c_std=c89`
rationale_ja: c89 と c90 は現在どちらも有効な c_std 値として受け付けられる(ALL_STDS に両方含まれる)。厳密な内部エイリアス化ではないが、ユーザーがどちらの綴りでも指定できるという実用要求は満たされている。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/c.py:52 ALL_STDS includes both 'c89' and 'c90'; set_versions lists c90/c99/c11
draft_comment: Both `c_std=c89` and `c_std=c90` are accepted as valid values by the C compiler backends (they map to the same ISO C90/C89 standard flag), so you can already use whichever spelling you prefer. Closing on that basis — please reopen if you hit a case where one spelling is rejected.

title: Generated pkg-config file does not contain include directories
rationale_ja: 現在のpkgconfigモジュールは依存のcompile_args（-I含む）をCflagsに伝播し、extra_cflagsキーワードも追加された。libraries経由で渡した依存のインクルードパスは.pcに反映される。

draft_comment: Thanks for the report. Modern Meson does propagate include directories from dependencies into the generated `.pc` file: the compile args (including `-I`) of dependencies passed via `libraries:` are added to the `Cflags:` field, and there is now also an `extra_cflags:` keyword on `pkg.generate()` for adding arbitrary flags. Please give a recent Meson release a try; if you still see include dirs missing for a specific dependency type, we'd welcome a fresh reproducer and can reopen.

title: Can't use gnome.compile_resources files before main build target
rationale_ja: run_commandは構成(configure)時に実行されるため、ビルド時に生成されるcompile_resourcesの出力をrun_commandで参照できないのは仕様上当然。custom_target/generatorのdepends/入力として渡すのが正しい方法。
evidence: run_command は configure 時実行（interpreter.py func_run_command）; compile_resources はビルド時 CustomTarget を返す
draft_comment: This is working as designed rather than a bug. `run_command()` runs at configure time, before any build steps, so the output of `gnome.compile_resources()` (which is produced at build time) cannot exist yet when `run_command()` runs. To consume a generated resource, pass it as an input/`depends` to a `custom_target()` or `generator()`, or feed the resource target directly into the target that needs it so the build-time ordering is established. Since this reflects the configure-vs-build phase distinction, I'll close it, but feel free to follow up if you have a use case that this doesn't cover.

title: qt5.compile_translations contains path separator in its target names
rationale_ja: qtモジュールのcompile_translationsは今もターゲット名を f'qt{ver}-compile-{ts}' で生成し、tsにパス区切りがあると名前に残る。path separatorの警告は現在も存在（build.py:681）。underscorify等でサニタイズすれば解消。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/_qt.py:753-754 (name=f'qt{self.qt_version}-compile-{ts}'); mesonbuild/build.py:681-686 (path separator warning 現存)
implementation_hint: In mesonbuild/modules/_qt.py compile_translations(), the CustomTarget name is built as f'qt{self.qt_version}-compile-{ts}' where ts may contain path separators (e.g. from files in subdirs). Sanitize the ts component before using it in the target name, e.g. run it through mesonlib's underscorify() (as is done elsewhere for target names) or use os.path.basename plus a hash, so no path separator ends up in the target name.

title: meson doesn't detect installed dub packages
rationale_ja: dub依存の実装は2019年から大幅に刷新され、`dub describe`によるローカル解決やcacheArtifactPath対応、dub add/build案内が追加された（Dub>=1.35・静的ライブラリ限定）。当時の環境の再現性は不明なため最新版での再確認を依頼。

draft_comment: The dub dependency backend has been substantially reworked since this report. Meson now resolves locally installed/registered packages via `dub describe` and dub's cache-artifact paths, and prints guidance (`dub add` / `dub build --deep`) when a package isn't ready. Note it requires a recent dub (>= 1.35) and currently supports static libraries. Could you retry with a current Meson and dub and let us know if `dependency('derelict-sdl2', method: 'dub')` still fails? If we don't hear back we'll close this as stale, but it can be reopened with a fresh log.

title: executable, library targets don't honor sources dependencies

draft_comment: This report is from 2019 and Vala/generated-source ordering has seen a number of fixes since. The intended behavior (generated sources listed in `declare_dependency(sources: ...)` are built before dependents that include them) is documented and expected to hold today. Are you still able to reproduce the multiple-`ninja`-runs issue on a current Meson release? If we don't hear back we'll close this as stale, but please attach a minimal reproducer and we'll reopen.

title: Add offsetof() function
rationale_ja: offsetofはclike.py内部でalignment算出に使われているが、ユーザ向けのcc.offsetof()メソッドは未公開。既存のsizeof/alignmentのクロス対応ロジックを流用すれば低コストで追加可能。

implementation_hint: offsetof is already computed internally in mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/clike.py (used by alignment via _cross_compute_int with 'offsetof(struct tmp, target)'). Expose a user-facing cc.offsetof(typename, member, prefix: ..., args: ..., dependencies: ...) method: add a compiler method (e.g. offsetof_type in clike.py) that builds 'offsetof({typename}, {member})' and runs it through the same cross-capable _compute_int path used by sizeof/alignment, then bind it in mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py and document it in docs/yaml/objects/compiler.yaml.

title: Propogate Bitness of Build to CMake Dependency Detection
rationale_ja: CMake依存検出用に生成されるツールチェーンファイルでCMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_PとCMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSORを出力するようになり、ビットネスがCMake側（vcpkgのトリプレット選択）へ伝播される。
evidence: mesonbuild/cmake/toolchain.py:167 (CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P = '8'/'4'), :165 (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR); cmake.py:154-155 (toolchain 書き出しは info 実行前)
draft_comment: The literal request here — propagating the build's bitness into CMake-based dependency detection — is addressed in current Meson. The toolchain file that Meson generates for CMake dependency lookups now sets `CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P` (8 or 4 depending on the build) and, for cross builds, `CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR` (see `mesonbuild/cmake/toolchain.py`). Combined with the `cmake_toolchain_file` machine-file property (which lets you load vcpkg's own toolchain), the information vcpkg triplet selection keys off is now available to CMake. Closing on that basis; if you still see vcpkg picking the wrong triplet on a current release, please reopen with the details and we'll dig in.
verify_signal_ja: コメント0件、最終更新2021-11(ラベル追加とみられる)で議論停止。vcpkg対応の姉妹issue(#5170と対)。
verify_reason_ja: CMake依存検出用に生成されるツールチェーンファイルが CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P(8/4)を常時、CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR をクロス時に出力するようになり(cmake/toolchain.py:165-167)、issueタイトルの『ビットネスをCMake依存検出へ伝播する』こと自体は達成。ただしvcpkgのトリプレット自動選択が実際に効くかはスレッド上でも一度も確認されておらず、元ドラフトの『vcpkg consumption should now work』は過大表現なので抑制する。
verify_risk_ja: vcpkgのトリプレット選択はMSVCの-AプラットフォームやVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLETにも依存し得るため、CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_Pだけで完全に正しく選択される保証はない。再オープンの余地を明記済み。

title: Pass Extra CMake Arguments in Inital Pass
rationale_ja: _get_cmake_infoの初期パスでユーザのcmake_argsとCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILEの両方が渡されるようになり、vcpkgのツールチェーンファイルが最初のパスから有効になる。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/cmake.py:118-121 (cmake_args を _get_cmake_info に渡す), :161-162 (cmake_opts に toolchain + cm_args); cmake/toolchain.py:66-67 (-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=); docs/markdown/Machine-files.md:234-237
draft_comment: This is resolved in current Meson. User-supplied `cmake_args` are now passed into the initial `_get_cmake_info()` invocation, and the generated CMake toolchain file — which carries `CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE` — is applied in that same first pass, so toolchain-driven cached variables (as vcpkg needs) take effect from the initial cache creation. In addition, the reliable "global toolchain file for all CMake dependencies" mechanism that was discussed here is now available as the `cmake_toolchain_file` machine-file property (since 0.56.0; see Machine-files.md). Closing as implemented. The broader idea of a dedicated `vcpkg` dependency type is a separate feature — please open a new issue for that if it's still wanted.
verify_signal_ja: 2019-03にmensindaが『新しいvcpkg依存型が最適』『グローバルtoolchainオプション追加も可』と示し、以後は議論停止(最終更新2021-11のラベル系)。
verify_reason_ja: cmake.py で _get_cmake_info(cm_args) にユーザの cmake_args が渡り初回パスで適用され(118-121,162)、CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE を含む生成ツールチェーンファイルも初回パスで適用される(161,toolchain.py:66-67)。さらにmensindaが推した『グローバルなtoolchainファイル指定』は cmake_toolchain_file マシンファイルプロパティ(0.56.0, Machine-files.md:234)として実装済みで、issueタイトルと本文の具体要求(初回キャッシュ作成時にCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILEを効かせる)は満たされている。
verify_risk_ja: 本issueで派生的に話題になった専用vcpkg依存型・debug/release取り違えは別スコープで未対応。コメントで別issue化を促してある。

title: run_command error with compiler object
rationale_ja: run_command_implはコンパイラオブジェクトに対しget_exe_args()で残りのexelistを展開しget_exe()で先頭を取るため、ccache等でラップされた完全なexelistが渡される。exelist[0]のみを使う旧バグは解消。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:842-844 (expanded_args = cmd.get_exe_args(); cmd = cmd.get_exe()); compilers.py:612-616 (get_exe=exelist[0], get_exe_args=exelist[1:])
draft_comment: This is fixed in current Meson. When a compiler object is passed to `run_command()`, it now expands the full compiler exelist — it uses `get_exe()` for the first element and `get_exe_args()` for the remaining ones (see `mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py`). So a wrapped compiler such as `ccache gcc` is invoked in full rather than dropping everything after the first element. Please try a recent release; if you still hit a failure with a wrapped compiler, let us know and we can reopen.
verify_signal_ja: コメントゼロ・2019年以降更新なしの放置issueで、反論や継続議論は一切ない。
verify_reason_ja: run_command_impl はコンパイラオブジェクトに対し get_exe()(exelist[0])と get_exe_args()(exelist[1:])を展開して渡すため、ccache 等でラップされた完全な exelist が使われる。報告された exelist[0] のみ使用のバグは interpreter.py:842-844 で解消済み。

title: PKG_CONFIG_PATH meson ... doesn't affect cross compilation in 0.51

The deprecation-period plan described here has long since played out. I'll close this as resolved; please reopen if the per-machine handling still surprises you on a recent release.

title: meson introspect --targets has no linker information
rationale_ja: ninjaバックエンドがcreate_target_linker_introspectionでリンカのexelistとパラメータをintrospectionデータ(target_sources)に追加するようになり、リンク段階の情報が取得できる。
