draft_comment: Linker information is now available in the target introspection data. The Ninja backend emits a linker block — the linker command/exelist plus the link parameters — alongside the per-language compile blocks, and this is surfaced in the `target_sources` array of `meson introspect --targets` (and in `meson-info/intro-targets.json`). See `create_target_linker_introspection` in `mesonbuild/backend/ninjabackend.py`. Please try it on a recent release; closing as resolved, but reopen if a specific field you need (e.g. resolving which static libs end up in a given shared lib) is still missing.
verify_signal_ja: 最終コメントは 2022-11-24 の null77 で「リンカ情報をエクスポートしてほしい」という再要望、mensinda は当初『未実装』と回答していた。
verify_reason_ja: 現在は ninjabackend.py:954-972 の create_target_linker_introspection がリンカの exelist と link パラメータを introspection_data に追加し、mintro.py:187 の list_targets が backend.get_introspection_data() 経由でそれを target_sources に含めるため、`meson introspect --targets`(および meson-info/intro-targets.json)にリンク段階情報が出力される。
verify_risk_ja: リンク parameters は素のリンクコマンド引数であり、『どの static lib がどの shared lib に入るか』を直接的な依存グラフとして返すわけではない。null77 の用途には物足りない可能性があり、その場合は再オープンされ得る。

title: DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH not propagated to post_inst/run_target scripts
rationale_ja: macOSのDYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATHがpost-installスクリプトへ伝播しない件。DYLD系変数はmacOSのSIPによりサブプロセスへ継承されない仕様の可能性が高く、meson側の対応可否が静的確認では不明。
evidence: mesonbuild/minstall.py (install スクリプト実行時の DYLD 特別扱いは確認できず); macOS SIP による DYLD 変数除去が根本原因の可能性

title: Building static library chain fails (modified test cases/common/43 library chain)
rationale_ja: 静的ライブラリのチェーンで、link_withした下位静的libのオブジェクトが上位.aに取り込まれず未定義シンボルが残る件。静的アーカイブの推移的な扱いに関する挙動で、現状の解決有無は静的確認では断定できない。
evidence: 本文の再現手順のみ; コード上の明確な修正/回帰テストは未確認

title: C sharp missing library finding support
rationale_ja: C#コンパイラ(cs.py)はfind_libraryをオーバーライドせず、基底クラスの'does not support library finding'例外を投げるため、Mono.Posix等の検索は今も不可。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/cs.py (find_library の実装なし); mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:858-861 (find_library が 'does not support library finding' を raise)
implementation_hint: Implement find_library() on CsCompiler in mesonbuild/compilers/cs.py to look up assemblies (e.g. via `pkg-config` for Mono packages, gacutil, or scanning the GAC / -lib: search dirs) and return the -r:/-lib: arguments, instead of inheriting the base-class 'does not support library finding' exception.

title: compile_args doesn't work with C sharp
rationale_ja: cs.pyのget_dependency_compile_argsは-I引数を除外して他の一部compile_argsは受け入れるよう改善されたが、declare_dependencyのcompile_argsがmcsで完全に反映されるわけではなく、報告の要望は部分的にのみ対応。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/cs.py:62-66 (get_dependency_compile_args: -I は除外、他は受け入れ)

title: extract_all_objects does not work with C sharp executables
rationale_ja: C#はオブジェクトファイル単位のコンパイルモデルを持たないため、extract_all_objectsが機能しないのは言語モデル上の制約。cs対応の特別実装は確認できず、根本的にはwontfix寄りだが要検討。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:1249-1273 (extract_objects/extract_all_objects, C# 向けの特別対応なし); C# は個別 .o を生成しないコンパイルモデル

title: compiler.get_supported_arguments reports success for unsupported flags
rationale_ja: 【スレッド精査で降格 / 元fixed判定は誤り】元報告の GCC『is valid for C/ObjC』ケースは gnu.py:596-607 で修正済みだが、issue はより広い『unsupported フラグ全般の誤検出』であり、maintainer 自身が未解決とスコープし、2025 年に clang/emcc の新しい再現例が投稿された。部分修正にすぎず、close は不適切。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/gnu.py:596-607 (has_arguments detects 'is valid for C/ObjC'); mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py:769-790 (checked kwarg since 0.59.0)
verify_signal_ja: eli-schwartz(2022)が『一種類だけ直したが GCC の文言が不安定で一般解決は困難』と明言し、最新コメント(2025-04-11 ktock)が Emscripten/clang の `-no-pie` でまだ再現すると報告、bug / good first issue ラベル付きで継続中。
verify_reason_ja: 元報告の GCC『is valid for C/ObjC』ケースは gnu.py:596-607 で修正済みだが、issue はより広い『unsupported フラグ全般の誤検出』であり、maintainer 自身が未解決とスコープし、2025 年に clang/emcc の新しい再現例が投稿された。部分修正にすぎず、close は不適切。
verify_risk_ja: 特定の GCC ケースは直っているためユーザーは修正済みと誤解しやすいが、一般問題は未解決でクローズは早すぎる。

title: Add files as resources in C Sharp targets
rationale_ja: C# ターゲットで -r: 経由でリソースファイルを追加する専用機能はコード上見当たらず、依然として cs_args で回避する必要がある。C# サポート自体がニッチで需要も低いため設計・実装を要する要望として残す。
evidence: none (no resources kwarg found for C# targets in mesonbuild/compilers/cs.py / build.py)
implementation_hint: Add a `resources` keyword to C# build targets that maps each file to a `-r:<path>` (or `/resource:`) mcs/csc argument, wired through the C# compiler's build args in mesonbuild/compilers/cs.py.

title: Cross compilation and complex build setups
rationale_ja: jpakkane 自身による設計提案(chainbuild 相当のマルチプラットフォーム同時ビルド)であり、大規模な設計・議論を要するアーキテクチャ課題。現状も未実装で有効な議論トピックとして残すべき。
evidence: none (design proposal by maintainer; no chainbuild-style multi-cross feature in tree)

title: feature option can't be set to auto when auto_features is set
rationale_ja: auto_features=enabled が全 auto フィーチャを上書きする設計は残っており、個別に -Dopt=auto で戻せるかは option レイヤリングの設計問題。明確な修正証拠がないため設計議論として残す。
evidence: mesonbuild/options.py:677 (auto_features overrides all 'auto' features); no per-option override-back mechanism found
implementation_hint: Would require tracking whether a feature value was set explicitly on the command line vs. inherited from auto_features, so an explicit `-Dopt=auto` can win over the global override.

title: Unit test fails on ubuntu disco & bionic (test_build_rpath | test_rpath_uses_ORIGIN)
rationale_ja: 2019年当時の Ubuntu 18.04/19.04 の特定 binutils/gcc 環境での rpath 抽出失敗であり、テストハーネスもディストリも大きく変わっている。再現情報のない古い環境固有のテスト失敗として obsolete 扱い。
evidence: none (environment-specific test failure on EOL Ubuntu releases; run_unittests.py line numbers no longer match)
draft_comment: This report is about a test failure on Ubuntu 18.04/19.04 with a 2019-era Meson and binutils. The test suite, rpath handling, and those distributions have all changed substantially since then, and we have no recent reports of these two tests failing. I'm going to close this as obsolete; if you can reproduce `test_build_rpath`/`test_rpath_uses_ORIGIN` failures on a current Meson, please open a fresh issue with the environment details.

title: LLVM library search picks up old versions of LLVM
rationale_ja: LLVM 依存の共有ライブラリ選択が `libLLVM-<version>.(so|dll|dylib)` を正規表現で狙い撃ちするよう改善され、任意の古い libLLVM*.so を掴む問題は緩和済み。バージョン一致で選ぶロジックが入っている。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py:348-354 (_set_old_link_args uses expected_name=f'libLLVM-{self.version}' regex match)
draft_comment: The LLVM shared-library detection has since been reworked: for shared linking Meson now specifically matches `libLLVM-<detected-version>.(so|dll|dylib)` rather than grabbing the first sorted `libLLVM*.so` in the libdir, so a stale older `libLLVM-*.so` in the same directory should no longer be picked. Please reopen with a current `meson-log.txt` if you still see the wrong library being selected.

title: LLVM dependency: versioning broken, LLVM 7 cannot be found due to llvm-config
rationale_ja: 複数の llvm-config-N を候補として集め、要求バージョンに合わせて version_sorter で並べ替えて選択するロジックが実装済み。最初に見つかった不一致 llvm-config で失敗する問題は解消されている。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py:466-477 (version_sorter over all llvm-config tool names, filtered by version_reqs); get_llvm_tool_names iterates versioned configs
draft_comment: The LLVM config-tool dependency now enumerates all available `llvm-config`/`llvm-config-N` binaries and sorts/filters them against the requested version range, instead of failing on whichever one happens to be first on PATH. A request like `dependency('llvm', version: ['>=7', '<8'])` should therefore pick a matching `llvm-config-7` if present. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a current log if a matching LLVM is still missed.

title: How to install Fortran .mod files?
rationale_ja: これは使い方の質問。生成される .mod はビルドディレクトリ内にあり、install_data() / install の対象として明示的に指定すればインストールできる(Meson が自動でインストールする機能はない)。回答済みとしてクローズ可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/fortran.py get_module_outdir_args (mod output dir is under builddir); no dedicated auto-install for .mod files
draft_comment: Meson does not automatically install generated `.mod` files, but you can install them explicitly. The `.mod` files are emitted into the build directory (per-target module output dir), so you can add an `install_data()`/`custom_target` install rule pointing at the generated file, or install them alongside your headers. If you'd like Meson to grow first-class support for auto-installing Fortran modules, that would be a separate feature request. Closing as answered.

title: no libdl nor librt on OpenBSD
rationale_ja: OpenBSD には -ldl/-lrt が存在せず、それらをハードコードする一部ユニットテストが失敗する問題。テスト側の移植性課題で、現行テストコードを確認して該当箇所を条件分岐する小規模修正だが、証拠未確認のため keep_open。
evidence: none (unit tests referencing -ldl/-lrt; not re-verified in current unittests/)
implementation_hint: In the affected unit tests (compiler args / pkgconfig dedup), avoid hardcoding `-ldl`/`-lrt`; either pick libraries guaranteed on all Unix-likes or skip/adjust the list on BSD platforms via a platform check.

title: generate_gir() should accept a File object to its header argument
rationale_ja: gnome.generate_gir の header 引数が File オブジェクトを受け付けるかは gnome モジュールの型受理を確認する必要がある。小規模な型緩和の改善要望として残す。
evidence: none (not verified whether gnome.generate_gir header kwarg accepts File in current mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py)
implementation_hint: Allow `File` (and possibly generated files) in the `header` kwarg type check of `gnome.generate_gir` and resolve it to a path when building the g-ir-scanner command line.

title: Feature request: test compilation failure
rationale_ja: 「特定ソースがコンパイルに失敗することをテストする」専用機能は未実装。compiler.compiles() を使えば設定時に検査は可能だが、テストスイートとして期待失敗を扱う仕組みは要望として残す。
evidence: none (no should-fail-to-compile test primitive; compiler.compiles() exists but is configure-time)
implementation_hint: Could be built on top of `compiler.compiles()` for configure-time checks, or a test wrapper that invokes the compiler and asserts a non-zero exit (optionally grepping stderr for an expected message). A dedicated helper or test() mode marking a compile as expected-fail would need design.

title: Support generic POSIX C compiler
rationale_ja: 未知のコンパイラ(pcc/tcc 等)は今も 'Unknown compiler' で拒否され、汎用 POSIX c99 フォールバックは実装されていない。反応数20と需要はあるが、多数の compiler mixin 前提を満たす設計が必要な大規模課題。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py:664,722,992,1062,1306,1333 (raises 'Unknown compiler' with no generic POSIX fallback)
implementation_hint: Add a GenericPosixCCompiler fallback (c99-style interface) selected when compiler id detection fails but the binary behaves like a POSIX c99 driver; it must provide sensible defaults for the many mixin methods Meson calls (pic, dependency-gen, warning levels, etc.).

title: Feature request: call system command during run(code)
rationale_ja: compiler.run() の実行前に chmod のような外部コマンドを差し込む仕組みは無い。ラベルも enhancement のまま残っており、有効な機能要望として維持。
evidence: none (compiler.run has no pre-exec hook; issue still labeled enhancement, updated 2026)
implementation_hint: Rather than a generic pre-exec hook, the setuid/setgid detection case is usually better solved inside the test program itself; a general mechanism would need careful design around cross builds where the binary cannot be executed.

title: Need built-in option for source character set specifier
rationale_ja: Meson 0.60.0 で MSVC はデフォルトで /utf-8 を付与するようになり(always_args)、報告された C4819/C2001 の典型的原因は解消。必要なら /source-charset で上書きできる旨もリリースノートに明記。
evidence: docs/markdown/Release-notes-for-0.60.0.md:367-382 (MSVC assumes UTF-8 by default); mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/visualstudio.py:96 always_args includes '/utf-8'
draft_comment: Since Meson 0.60.0, MSVC (and clang-cl) pass `/utf-8` by default (it is part of the compiler `always_args`), so UTF-8 source files build correctly on non-English code pages without needing a manual `add_project_arguments('/utf-8')`. If you need a different charset you can still override it with `/source-charset:` via `c_args`/`cpp_args`. No dedicated built-in option was added — the thread converged on that not being necessary — but the underlying C4819/C2001 breakage from the report is resolved by the new default, so I'm closing this. Please reopen if you specifically still need a separate charset option.
verify_signal_ja: 2019-05 のスレッドで jpakkane/tp-m は専用ユーザーオプション化に否定的で、報告者 seungha-yang も『c_args で十分そう』と収束、以降更新なし。
verify_reason_ja: 0.60.0 で MSVC(および clang-cl)がデフォルトで /utf-8 を付与(visualstudio.py:96 always_args)するようになり、報告された C4819/C2001 の実害は解消。専用 built-in オプションは追加されていないが、スレッド合意も専用オプションは不要という方向であり、実質的な要望は解決済み。ドラフトは『専用オプションが追加された』と誤読され得るため文言を修正。
verify_risk_ja: 報告者はタイトル通りの『専用 built-in オプション』を求めていたので、それが追加されていない点に不満を持つ可能性は残る。

title: dependency injection
rationale_ja: サブプロジェクトに親の依存を注入する使い方の質問。dependency() の override_dependency(や dependency('foo', fallback:...) と meson.override_dependency)で親が提供する依存をサブプロジェクトから解決させる仕組みが既にある。回答済みとしてクローズ可能。
evidence: meson.override_dependency exists (docs/yaml, Reference-manual); allows parent to supply a dependency name resolved by subprojects
draft_comment: You can achieve this with `meson.override_dependency('catch', catch_dep)` in the parent project: once overridden, any `dependency('catch')` call (including inside subprojects) resolves to the object you provided, without needing `catch` to be a real subproject everywhere. That was introduced after this issue was filed. Closing as answered; feel free to follow up if that doesn't cover your case.

title: vala compiler --pkg includes more than necessary
rationale_ja: 静的ライブラリの pkgconfig 依存が下流の Vala コンパイルに --pkg として過剰に伝播する問題。Vala 依存伝播の設計課題で修正証拠がなく、keep_open。
evidence: none (vala --pkg propagation behavior not re-verified in current mesonbuild/modules or vala compiler handling)
implementation_hint: Distinguish pkg-config deps that only need to feed C compilation/linking from those that must become Vala `--pkg` imports, so a statically-linked dep does not force a `--pkg` on downstream valac invocations.

title: How to suppress messages from cxx.get_supported_arguments()
rationale_ja: get_supported_arguments の逐一の YES/NO ログ表示に関する質問。個々の結果はデフォルトでログに出るが赤 NO はエラーではない旨の説明で回答可能。出力抑制の完全な仕組みは無いが、これは主に使い方の質問。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py:777-790 (get_supported_arguments logs per-arg; 'checked' kwarg controls warn/require but not full silence)
draft_comment: The `YES`/`NO` lines from `get_supported_arguments()` are informational log output, not errors — a red `NO` simply means that specific flag isn't supported and is dropped from the returned list, which is exactly the intended behaviour. There isn't a dedicated flag to silence just these lines; the `checked` keyword (added in 0.59.0) only controls whether an unsupported arg warns or errors. If you'd like a quieter mode for this specific method, that would be a separate enhancement request. Closing as answered.

title: Ninja still have work to do after call without parameters in case I use Qt MOC
rationale_ja: Qt MOC 使用時に無変更でも ninja が再ビルドすると訴える古い報告。再現手順(meson.build)が乏しく、Qt モジュールは大きく変わっている。現行版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: none (no reproducer attached; Qt module significantly evolved since 2019)
draft_comment: Is this still reproducible on a recent Meson? The Qt modules have changed considerably since 2019, and "ninja has work to do on a no-op rebuild" issues are usually traced to a specific generated dependency. If you can share a minimal `meson.build` that reproduces it on a current release, we'll take another look; otherwise this will be closed as stale.

title: Add support for Kotlin
rationale_ja: Kotlin 言語サポートはコード上存在せず未実装。#5471(JVM 言語全般)と密接に関連する大規模な言語追加要望として維持。
evidence: none (no kotlin support in mesonbuild/compilers; grep found no Kotlin compiler)
implementation_hint: Adding a JVM-language compiler (kotlinc) that emits classes/jars, likely sharing infrastructure with the existing Java compiler and the `jar()` target; overlaps heavily with #5471.

title: Built-in Boost dependency takes precedence over explicitly provided pkg-config dependency
rationale_ja: packages[] に専用ディテクタがある依存(boost等)はファクトリが優先され、明示 pkg-config の .pc を無視する構造は基本的に残る。method:'pkg-config' 指定で回避可能だが、コメント48件の議論が続く設計課題として keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/base.py factory dispatch (named-package factory precedes generic pkg-config); method kwarg allows explicit pkg-config override
implementation_hint: Consider letting the pkg-config method be tried first (or in the factory candidate list) for named deps like Boost when a matching .pc is present, or better document `method: 'pkg-config'` as the escape hatch; behaviour change needs care to avoid regressing existing Boost detection.

title: meson test: gdb doesn't support -nh argument on FreeBSD 11
rationale_ja: FreeBSD の gdb が --nh を認識しない問題。mtest の gdb 起動引数を確認して条件分岐する小規模修正だが、現行コードでの --nh 使用有無を未確認のため keep_open。
evidence: none (gdb --nh usage in mtest.py not re-verified for current version)
implementation_hint: Detect the gdb variant/version (FreeBSD's gdb uses `-n`, not `-nh`) or feature-test the `-nh`/`--nh` flag before passing it in the `meson test --gdb` wrapper in mtest.py.

title: vala: what if C file depends on the package header generated by --header flag
rationale_ja: 同一ターゲット内で .vala が生成する --header を .c が参照する場合のビルド順序/依存が正しく張られない問題。Vala+C 混在ターゲットの依存生成に関する課題で、修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (vala-generated header ordering within a mixed vala/c target not re-verified)
implementation_hint: Ensure that when a target mixes .vala and .c and `vala_header` is set, valac runs with `--header` first and the generated header path is added as a build dependency (and include dir) of the C object compilation, so ordering is correct.

title: Support for "autolink" dependencies
rationale_ja: pkg-config の 'Libs: -L${libdir}'(-l を伴わない)が link_args に反映されず、MSVC の autolink バックエンドが見つからない問題。_search_libs は -L を主にライブラリ解決用に収集し、単独 -L を LINK_ARGS として出さない構造で、挙動は基本的に残っている。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py:441-461 (bare -L collected as libpaths for resolution; -L entries are 'continue'-skipped rather than emitted standalone)
implementation_hint: For autolink (Windows) deps, propagate bare `-L`/`/LIBPATH:` entries from a .pc `Libs:` line into the target's link args even when no accompanying `-l` is present, so the linker can find the auto-linked libraries.

title: no ninja dependency created for .def files
rationale_ja: vs_module_defs のパスが link_depends に追加されるようになっており(process_vs_module_defs_kw)、.def ファイル更新でリンクが再実行される。報告のリンク依存欠落は修正済みと判断。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:1814 (self.link_depends.append(path) in process_vs_module_defs_kw)
draft_comment: The `.def` file passed via `vs_module_defs` is now added to the target's `link_depends`, so updating the module-definition file triggers a relink. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you still see a stale link when only the `.def` changes.

title: vs_module_defs should accept empty list or empty string
rationale_ja: vs_module_defs は File/CustomTarget/CustomTargetIndex を受理し None は早期 return するが、空リスト/空文字列を「無指定」として明示的に許容する処理は見当たらない。MSVC/mingw で条件分岐せず1回の library() 呼び出しにしたいという小規模改善要望。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:1809-1820 (process_vs_module_defs_kw handles None and File/CustomTarget, no empty-list/empty-string acceptance)
implementation_hint: In `process_vs_module_defs_kw`, treat an empty string / empty list the same as an unset (None) `vs_module_defs`, so users can pass a conditionally-empty value without duplicating the whole `library()` call.

title: Add support for more JVM languages.
rationale_ja: Groovy/Kotlin/Scala 等の JVM 言語サポートは未実装で、jar() を汎用化する大規模要望。#5433/#5610 と重複する議論トピックとして維持。
evidence: none (only Java among JVM langs supported in mesonbuild/compilers)
implementation_hint: Generalize the jar()/Java infrastructure so additional JVM compilers (kotlinc, scalac, groovyc) can produce class files and jars; requires per-language compiler classes and detection.

title: Incorrect pkg-config file generated
rationale_ja: 静的ビルド時に .a の絶対パスが Libs: に混入し Libs.private であるべきという問題。pkgconfig モジュールは静的依存の扱いに複雑なロジックを持つが、この具体的な .a パス配置問題の修正証拠は確認できず、module:pkgconfig の設計課題として維持。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py:250-281 (static-lib handling in add_libs / is_internal promotion); specific .a-in-Libs behavior not confirmed fixed
implementation_hint: When generating .pc for a static build, ensure absolute `.a` dependency paths go into `Libs.private` (or are converted to `-L`/`-l`) rather than the public `Libs:` line, to avoid non-portable hardcoded archive paths.

title: pkgconfig.generate() produces different files the second time
rationale_ja: 同一 lib に対する2回目の pkgconfig.generate() が1回目を Requires として参照し内容が変わる問題。metadata に filebase を記録し reqs 解決に使う仕組み(processed_reqs)があり関連はするが、この二重生成時の挙動が意図通りか/修正済みかは断定できず keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py:153,177,212 (metadata[...].filebase used when a previously-generated lib is referenced as a Requires)
implementation_hint: Decide and document the intended behaviour when pkgconfig.generate() is called twice for the same library: either warn/error on a second generate, or make the second file independent rather than implicitly turning the first into a `Requires:` entry.

title: Use lowercase name as default for filebase in pkgconfig.generate()
rationale_ja: filebase 未指定時は現在も name をそのまま既定値にしており(小文字化していない)、要望は未実装。ただし後方互換の懸念があるため FeatureNew ガード付きの小規模実装が妥当。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py:733 (filebase = kwargs['filebase'] if not None else name — no .lower())
implementation_hint: In pkgconfig.generate (mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py:733), default `filebase` to `name.lower()` instead of `name`. Because this changes generated filenames, guard it (e.g. only lowercase when it differs, with a FeatureNew note) to avoid silently breaking existing installs; consider documenting the change in Pkgconfig-module.md.

title: Names of custom_target's collide in i18n.merge_file
rationale_ja: i18n.merge_file の CustomTarget 名が空文字('')になり、出力名ベースの自動命名に変わったため、同名の '<output>_data_merge' 衝突は解消。ただし2つの呼び出しが全く同じ output を指定した場合は本質的に同一ファイル生成となる点は残る。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/i18n.py:342-343 (CustomTarget created with name '' — auto-derived from output, no '_data_merge' suffix collision)
draft_comment: The i18n.merge_file targets no longer use the fixed `<name>_data_merge` naming that caused the collision — the custom target now derives its name from the output file, so two `merge_file` calls with different outputs no longer clash. Note that two calls producing the *same* output filename will still conflict (they'd generate the same file). Closing as resolved; please reopen if you still hit a spurious collision with distinct outputs.

title: d test sample broken
rationale_ja: 2019年の Windows 7 + dmd 2.086 / ldc 1.16 での D サンプル(共有/静的ライブラリ)ビルド失敗報告。ツールチェーンも Windows 7 もサポート終了レベルに古く、現行版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: none (very old D toolchain on Windows 7; not reproducible-checked here)
draft_comment: This is against a 2019 D toolchain (dmd 2.086 / ldc 1.16) on Windows 7. Both the toolchains and Meson's D support have moved on considerably. Is the D shared/static library sample still broken for you on a current Meson with an up-to-date dmd/ldc? If we don't hear back, this will be closed as stale.

title: a duplicate target detected when the name_prefix keyword is used
rationale_ja: 同名だが name_prefix が異なる(出力ファイル名が異なる)2ターゲットが重複エラーになる問題。Meson はターゲット識別を出力名でなくターゲット名で行う設計のため、少なくともより具体的なエラーメッセージが望ましいという要望。設計判断を要するため keep_open。
evidence: none (target-name uniqueness is by target id, not output filename; behavior likely unchanged)
implementation_hint: Either allow same-named targets when their computed output filenames differ (risky — target ids are used widely), or, more safely, improve the error message to explain that target *names* must be unique regardless of name_prefix/name_suffix.

title: run_target doc should provide examples
rationale_ja: Run-targets.md にスクリプト例・引数渡し例が追加され、run_target は YAML リファレンス(run_target.yaml)にも移行して depends 等が文書化済み。ドキュメント要望は概ね対応済み。build 全体への依存は alias_target 等で扱える。
evidence: docs/markdown/Run-targets.md:38-55 (examples); docs/yaml/functions/run_target.yaml and docs/yaml/functions/alias_target.yaml (documented depends)
draft_comment: The documentation now includes worked `run_target` examples (Run-targets.md) and a full reference entry in the YAML reference manual documenting the `command`/`depends` arguments. For depending on the whole build, `alias_target` (also documented) is usually the right tool. Closing as addressed; let us know if a specific example is still missing.

title: gnome.gtkdoc overwrite files at install
rationale_ja: gnome.gtkdoc のインストール時に同一ディレクトリの install_data ファイルをディレクトリ丸ごとコピーで上書き/削除する問題。gnome モジュールの gtkdoc インストールロジックの課題で、修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (gtkdoc install-time directory copy behavior not re-verified in current mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py)
implementation_hint: Make the gtkdoc install step copy only the doc files it produced into the target directory rather than mirroring/replacing the whole directory, so co-located install_data() files are preserved.

title: Trying to override 'subproject_dir' and got an error.
rationale_ja: subproject_dir を 'vendor' に設定し xcode backend で unity フォールバックを解決しようとしてトレースバックが出た報告だが、本文がトランケートされ実際のエラー種別が不明。原因特定に追加情報が必要。
evidence: none (issue body truncated; traceback cut off, xcode backend + fallback subproject involved)

title: Add support for Gradle via a module.
rationale_ja: Gradle 連携モジュールは未実装。JVM 言語サポート群(#5433/#5471)と方向性を共有する大規模な新モジュール要望として維持。
evidence: none (no gradle module in mesonbuild/modules)
implementation_hint: A gradle module would shell out to a Gradle wrapper as an external build step (similar in spirit to the CMake/external-project modules); scope and demand should be weighed before implementation.

title: False positives in clang-cl for stpcpy(), strcasecmp() and strncasecmp()
rationale_ja: clang-cl で has_function が stpcpy/strcasecmp 等を誤検出しリンク失敗する問題。clang-cl の関数検出における宣言有無の扱いに関する課題で、修正証拠が確認できず keep_open。
evidence: none (clang-cl has_function false-positive behavior not re-verified)
implementation_hint: For clang-cl, strengthen `has_function` checks (e.g. require a real declaration / use of the symbol, or -Werror on implicit declarations) so functions absent from the MSVC CRT like stpcpy/strcasecmp are not reported as present.

title: vs backend: run_target() dependencies doesn't seem to be built
rationale_ja: VS backend で run_target の depends が実際にビルドされない問題、および alias_target の最適化余地。VS backend 固有の課題で修正証拠が確認できず keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/backend/vs2010backend.py:738 (gen_run_target_vcxproj exists); dependency-build behavior not confirmed fixed
implementation_hint: Ensure the generated .vcxproj for a run_target lists its `depends`/declared dependencies as project references so they build first; separately, alias_target (a run_target with no command) can avoid the dummy python invocation in the VS backend.

title: CMake seems to find the oldest version of LLVM by default
rationale_ja: CMake 経由の LLVM 検出でバージョンソートが行われず古い版を掴む問題に対し、Meson 側で候補バージョンを version_sorter で降順ソートするコメント付き実装(「CMake sorting before 3.18 is incorrect, sort it here instead」)が入っており、対処済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py:466-477 (version_sorter; comment 'CMake sorting before 3.18 is incorrect, sort it here instead')
draft_comment: Meson now sorts the candidate LLVM versions itself (descending) rather than relying on CMake's ordering — the code explicitly notes that CMake's sorting before 3.18 is incorrect and compensates for it, and it also filters by the requested version range. This should make `method: 'cmake'` pick a version-appropriate LLVM. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a log if you still get the oldest version.

title: Error C2859 on MSVC when using PCH
rationale_ja: MSVC debug ビルドで PCH 使用時に .pdb 不一致(C2859)で増分ビルドが壊れる問題。PCH と PDB の相互作用に関する MSVC 固有課題で修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (MSVC PCH/PDB C2859 incremental-build behavior not re-verified)
implementation_hint: Investigate the PDB used during PCH creation vs. object compilation on MSVC debug builds; likely need to ensure a consistent `/Fd` PDB (or per-object PDBs) so the PCH's referenced PDB matches on incremental rebuilds.

title: [Docs] Missing description for --native-file
rationale_ja: --native-file は現在 Machine-files.md やコマンド/リファレンスで説明されており、ネイティブファイルの文書は整備済み。ドキュメント欠落は解消されている。
evidence: docs/markdown/Machine-files.md (native/cross file documentation present); --native-file documented in commands/reference
draft_comment: `--native-file` and native/cross machine files are now documented in the Machine files reference page (docs Machine-files.md) as well as the command reference, rather than only in the 0.49 release notes. Closing as resolved; if you find a specific gap in the current docs, please point to it and we'll fill it in.

title: Improve interaction between optional auto-feature subprojects with auto-feature options
rationale_ja: 明示的に enabled にしたサブプロジェクトのオプションが解決不能なとき、optional サブプロジェクトが黙ってスキップされる挙動の改善要望。option のレイヤリング(明示指定 vs 既定)を区別する必要があり、maintainer 自身も難しいと述べる設計課題。
evidence: none (mesonbuild does not track explicit-vs-default feature layering as noted in the issue; not resolved)
implementation_hint: Requires distinguishing explicitly-set feature options from defaults; when a feature option was forced 'enabled' on the command line, a DependencyException from within an optional subproject should propagate (error out) instead of silently skipping the subproject.

title: Meson 0.51.999 test file with time out error.
rationale_ja: テストが 30 秒でタイムアウトするという報告だが、テストが実際にハングしているのかタイムアウト値の問題かが不明で、外部プロジェクト固有の可能性が高い。現行版での再現確認が必要。
evidence: none (external project-specific timeout; no meson-side defect evidence)
draft_comment: A TIMEOUT usually means the test binary itself did not exit within the timeout window (default 30s), which is typically a property of the test rather than a Meson bug. Is this still happening on a current Meson? If so, please share the test's `testlog.txt` and whether the binary runs to completion when launched directly. Without a reproducer this will be closed as stale.

title: jar targets can't link against preexisting jars (e.g., android.jar)
rationale_ja: jar() ターゲットが既存 jar(android.jar 等)を classpath に加えてリンクできない問題。Java コンパイラは -cp/-classpath を扱うが、jar ターゲットから外部 jar を依存として渡す高レベル機構は不足しており、機能追加要望として維持。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/java.py:66 (handles -cp/-classpath in args) but no high-level way to attach a prebuilt jar to a jar() target
implementation_hint: Provide a supported way to add prebuilt jars to a jar()/Java target's classpath (e.g. accepting jar files in link_with or a dedicated classpath/java_args pathway) that feeds `-cp` to javac and records the dependency.

title: ninja scan-build ignores compiler setting
rationale_ja: ninja scan-build が設定時の CC/CXX(clang)を無視し scan-build の既定 gcc ラッパを使う問題。scanbuild 内部ヘルパのコンパイラ引き継ぎに関する課題で、issue も2025年更新と活発、修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (meson --internal scanbuild compiler-passing behavior not confirmed fixed; issue updated 2025)
implementation_hint: Make the `--internal scanbuild` reconfigure honor the originally configured compilers (pass CC/CXX through, or use scan-build's `--use-cc`/`--use-c++`) so the analysis uses the same compiler as the real build.

title: Default output folder set but no rule gets created for output
rationale_ja: Rust executable の 'all' 規則が meson-out/project.exe を要求するが、実際のビルド規則は project.exe を生成しており不整合となる問題。Rust ターゲットの出力パス/all ターゲット生成の不一致で、修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (rust target output path vs 'all' rule mismatch not re-verified)
implementation_hint: Align the output path used in the ninja `build` rule for Rust executables with the path referenced by the `all` phony target (meson-out/...), so the alias resolves to an existing rule.

title: Specifying Language with Internal Dependencies
rationale_ja: declare_dependency の compile_args を特定言語(例: cpp のみ)に限定したいという要望。言語別 compile_args を内部依存に持たせる仕組みは未整備で、issue も2026年更新と関心が続く有効な設計要望として維持。
evidence: none (declare_dependency compile_args are not per-language; no language-scoped compile_args mechanism found)
implementation_hint: Allow declare_dependency's compile_args (or a new per-language variant) to be scoped by language so flags like `-nostdinc++` are only applied to matching source files, avoiding 'valid for C++ but not C' warnings when the dep is consumed by mixed-language targets.

title: Generated header/source tree header conflict with subprojects
rationale_ja: サブプロジェクトで生成 config.h と同名のソースツリー config.h が衝突し、生成版でなくソース版が include される問題(PR #4776 参照)。include ディレクトリ優先順位に関する課題で、修正証拠がなく keep_open。
evidence: none (generated-vs-source header include-order for subprojects; PR #4776 referenced, not confirmed merged/fixed)
implementation_hint: Ensure the build-directory (generated) include path for a subproject takes precedence over the source-tree include path so a generated config.h shadows an identically-named checked-in fallback; see the reproducer/test in PR #4776.

title: Meson automoc
rationale_ja: automocは今も実装されておらず(qtモジュールにはpreprocess/has_toolsのみ)、動的方式かrewriter方式かという設計上の未決事項が残る設計ディスカッション用issueである。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/_qt.py (has_tools/preprocess のみ、automocなし)

title: clike compiler is not really clike
rationale_ja: コンパイラクラス階層の大規模リファクタ提案であり、mixin化は進んだが「clike」分割という抽象的なリファクタ目標は現在も有効な作業項目。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/ (clike/gnu/visualstudio 等に分割は進行中)

title: "meson test" concurrency vis "gdb"
rationale_ja: 元々はユーザー自身のコードのrace condition調査であり、--num-processesの意味(並列実行プロセス数)を尋ねる質問。ドキュメントで説明済みでmeson側のバグではない。
evidence: docs/markdown/Unit-tests.md, mesonbuild/mtest.py:163 (--num-processes)
draft_comment: `--num-processes` (`-j`) controls how many test processes Meson runs in parallel; it is not a thread count. With `--gdb`, Meson already forces serial execution. The original report was chasing a race condition in the project's own test code rather than a Meson bug, and no reproducer against Meson itself was provided. Since this appears to be a usage question that has been answered, I'll close it, but please reopen with a minimal Meson reproducer if you believe Meson's concurrency handling is at fault.

title: rpath should allow multiple arguments
rationale_ja: install_rpath/build_rpathは現在もtype:strのままで、リスト受け入れは未実装。有効な機能要望として残すべき。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml:63-64 (build_rpath type:str), :209-210 (install_rpath type:str)
implementation_hint: Accept List[str] in install_rpath/build_rpath kwargs in build.py, join with ':' internally (or emit multiple -Wl,-rpath). Gate with FeatureNew.

title: WARNING: Unknown CPU family 'sgimips'
rationale_ja: CPU正規化はmips系/ip30/ip35を扱うが、NetBSDがuname -mで返す'sgimips'は'mips'で始まらず未処理のため今も警告が出る可能性が高い。マッピング追加で解決可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:626-632 (mips系正規化、sgimipsは未対応)
implementation_hint: In envconfig.py cpu-family normalization, map 'sgimips' -> 'mips' (or handle trial.endswith('mips')). Add to the mips branch condition.

title: vs2019: failing to rebuild native: true executable after "meson configure -Dbuildtype=release" config change
rationale_ja: VSバックエンドでbuildtype変更後にnativeバイナリが再ビルドされず_ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL不整合が起きる報告。ローカルコードだけでは再現/修正確認ができず、needs-info寄りの古い報告。
evidence: none (VS backend behavior, no reproducer)

title: meson wrongly copies selinux attributes from build-dir to install location on "meson install"
rationale_ja: minstallにrestore_selinux_contextsが実装され、インストール後にrestoreconでSELinuxコンテキストを復元するようになっており本問題は解消済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/minstall.py:251-275 (restore_selinux_contexts, restorecon), :449 (selinux_updates.append), :578 (restore呼び出し)
draft_comment: Meson now restores SELinux contexts on install: after copying files it collects them and runs `restorecon` (see `restore_selinux_contexts()` in `mesonbuild/minstall.py`), so installed files get fresh, correct contexts rather than inheriting the build-dir labels. This addresses the AVC denials reported here. Closing as fixed; please reopen if you still see stale contexts on a current Meson release.

title: dependency(static : true) handles a mix of static and dynamic transitive dependencies differently than 'pkg-config --static'
rationale_ja: 報告者自身が「バグではない」と述べ、ワークアラウンドで解決済みのコーナーケース文書化目的のissue。設計通りの挙動であり回答済みとしてクローズ可能。
evidence: none (author states 'probably not a bug', workaround adopted)
draft_comment: As you noted, this is a documented corner case rather than a bug: `dependency(static: true)` deliberately prefers static libraries throughout the transitive chain, which differs from a plain `pkg-config --static` that keeps whatever `.pc` files it first resolves. You've already adopted a reasonable workaround. Since there's no actionable bug here, I'll close this; if you'd like a new opt-in mode that mirrors `pkg-config --static` semantics exactly, a fresh feature request would be the better venue.

title: Better architect "two phase" machine detection
rationale_ja: コンパイラ検出前後でのマシン推定(guess-and-refine)のアーキテクチャ改善という設計課題。根本アルゴリズムは残っており有効なリファクタ課題。
evidence: mesonbuild/environment.py, envconfig.py (two-phase detection remains)

title: ninja install build gtk-doc as root
rationale_ja: install時のpolkit昇格後にgtk-docターゲットがrootでビルドされ所有権が壊れる問題。ローカルコードだけでは現状のビルド順序を確認できず要検証。
evidence: none (build ordering / gtk-doc target behavior)

title: Cannot use `link_whole` in a shared library with a non-static-library object
rationale_ja: 報告のクラッシュ(CustomTargetに.pic属性がなくAttributeError)は解消。現在link_wholeはgetattr(t,'pic',True)とcheck_can_link_togetherを使い、不正な型には明示的なInvalidArgumentsを出す。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:2815-2825 (link_whole: getattr(t,'pic',True), check_can_link_together)
draft_comment: The traceback reported here (`'CustomTarget' object has no attribute 'pic'`) no longer occurs. `SharedLibrary.link_whole()` now uses `getattr(t, 'pic', True)` and a `check_can_link_together()` type check, so incompatible link_whole targets raise a clear `InvalidArguments` error instead of crashing. Please reopen with a current-version reproducer if you still hit an unhandled case.

title: No 'objectfile' build target available
rationale_ja: 単一ソースから.oを作りインストールする専用ターゲット(crt0.o等)の要望。現状はextract_objectsやcustom_targetで代替でき、専用targetは未実装の有効な機能要望。
evidence: docs/yaml/objects/build_tgt.yaml:9 (extract_objects) — 直接の objectfile target は無し

title: meson does not support alternate spelling -libpath: in .pc files
rationale_ja: MSVCの-libpath:綴り(スラッシュでなくダッシュ)を.pcファイルで扱う稀なWindowsコーナーケース。/libpathへの書き換えというワークアラウンドがあるが本体対応は未確認。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py:365-475 (-L/-I 処理、-libpath: の明示処理は未確認)

title: gnome.generate_gir() does not find library
rationale_ja: 別ディレクトリでビルドされるライブラリの-Lパスがg-ir-scannerに渡らない問題。generate_girのリンク引数生成は大幅にリファクタ済みだが本バグの修正はローカルで断定できない。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:637-896 (_get_link_args/generate_gir リファクタ済み)

title: ERROR: Could not invoke sanity test executable
rationale_ja: クロス(mingw->windows)なのにexe_wrapper未使用でsanity checkが'Exec format error'になった設定ミス。exe_wrapper=wineは指定されているがサブプロジェクト構成の問題で、meson本体のバグではなくユーザー環境起因。
evidence: none (cross file / exe_wrapper setup, user CI environment)
draft_comment: This `Exec format error` at the sanity-check stage means the produced Windows `.exe` was run directly on the Linux build host without the exe wrapper being applied. That's an environment/cross-file configuration problem (the wrapper wasn't picked up for the sanity check) rather than a Meson defect, and the external CI log is long gone. Current Meson runs the sanity executable through `exe_wrapper` for cross builds. I'll close this as not-actionable; please open a fresh issue with a minimal reproducer against a current release if it still happens.

title: gtk-doc does not link with library
rationale_ja: gtk-docのdependenciesにライブラリを渡してもリンカフラグが付かない問題。ゼロコメントの古い報告で、現行コードでの修正確認が困難。
evidence: none (gnome.gtkdoc dependencies handling)

title: gnome.generate_gir() doesn't use link arguments
rationale_ja: generate_girがadd_project_link_argumentsのリンカ引数を使わない問題。ゼロコメントの古い報告でローカルでの修正断定は困難。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:1130-1132 (g-ir-scanner は -L/-l/--extra-library のみ通す)

title: devhelp2 FileNotFoundError in evince gtk-doc API docs
rationale_ja: gtkdochelperがmodule-version付き.devhelp2にリネームする際、元ファイルが無くFileNotFoundになる問題。該当のshutil.moveは今も存在し、根因(gtk-docの出力名の食い違い)は未解消の可能性。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/gtkdochelper.py:211-213 (shutil.move {module}.devhelp2 -> {module}-{version}.devhelp2)

title: Meson fails on sanity check step when using clang-cl+ASAN
rationale_ja: clang-cl+ASANで/MDdと-fsanitize=addressが衝突しsanity checkが失敗する問題。sanitizerサポートが正式実装され(#5845関連)、b_sanitize経由で扱われるようになったため、生の-Dc_argsで衝突させる元の運用は不要になった。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/visualstudio.py:460-463 (clang-cl sanitizer support)
draft_comment: Sanitizers on clang-cl are now handled through the `b_sanitize` option and the ClangCl `sanitizer_compile_args()` path rather than by passing raw `-fsanitize=address` in `c_args`. Using `-Db_sanitize=address` lets Meson manage the incompatible-runtime interaction instead of colliding with `/MDd`. Closing as addressed; please reopen if `-Db_sanitize=address` still fails the sanity check on a current release.

title: Cache pkg-config isn't correct.
rationale_ja: 初回configure後に依存がアンインストールされてもキャッシュが無効化されない問題。依存キャッシュの妥当性検証や--uncache相当は未実装の有効な要望。
evidence: mesonbuild/coredata.py (deps cache, clear_cache) — 自動無効化ロジックは無し

title: gnome.generate_gir() build directory does not always have preference
rationale_ja: GIRビルド時にビルドディレクトリのライブラリが優先されずシステム側が使われる問題。ゼロコメントの古い報告でローカルでの修正断定は困難。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:637-896 (link arg ordering, refactored)

title: gnome.generate_gir() should allow silencing warnings
rationale_ja: generate_girは今も--warn-allを無条件付与しており、警告を抑制するオプションは無い。オプトアウトのkwarg追加で実装可能。

title: python module doesn't prefer "py -3" over %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python3.exe
rationale_ja: ExternalProgram探索でWindowsApps配下のpython3.exeスタブを検出した場合dirname(sys.executable)へ置換する処理が入り、ストアスタブで失敗し継続しない問題は緩和済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/programs.py:186-208 (_windows_sanitize_path: WindowsApps を dirname(sys.executable) に置換), :248-250 (shebang python3 対応)
draft_comment: Meson now sanitizes the Windows `WindowsApps` App Store python stub: when that directory appears in the search path it is replaced with `dirname(sys.executable)` (see `_windows_sanitize_path` in `mesonbuild/programs.py`), so program lookup no longer gets stuck on the zero-size Store stub. This resolves the 'fails and does not continue' behavior reported here. Closing as fixed; please reopen if a current release still selects the stub.

title: meson cannot find static library nng

evidence: none (find_library, user environment)
draft_comment: This looks like an environment/setup problem rather than a Meson bug: `find_library('nng', dirs: ...)` fails because the static `libnng.a` either isn't in the given `dirs`, isn't named as expected, or the (cross) compiler can't link it. Since 0.51 there have been many improvements to static/cross library lookup. This report has been idle with insufficient detail to reproduce, so I'll close it as stale. Please reopen against a current release with the exact file path/name of the library and the full compiler command Meson runs, if it still fails.

title: Meson wraps installed libraries in architecture folder on Ubuntu 19.04 (and possibly other debian based systems)
rationale_ja: Debian系のmultiarch libdir(lib/x86_64-linux-gnu)は意図的な既定挙動。ネイティブビルドではシステム既定に従うのが正しく、install_rpath/libdir指定というワークアラウンドも回答済み。仕様として回答可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/coredata.py:321-326 (multiarch libdir はシステム既定、クロス時のみ 'lib' に固定)
draft_comment: This is intended behavior on Debian/Ubuntu: those distros use multiarch library paths (`lib/x86_64-linux-gnu`), and for a native build Meson deliberately follows the system default `libdir` so installed libraries match distro conventions. The reason the binary can't find the library is that no rpath/loader path points there for a `/usr/local` install; that's the same for any build system. Your workarounds (`--libdir=lib` or setting `install_rpath` to `libdir`) are the correct approaches. Since this is by-design rather than a bug, I'll close it. See also #1972.

title: Portable Independent Meson for macOS
rationale_ja: macOS向けの単体パッケージ(.app)化の要望。mesonはPyInstaller製のスタンドアロン実行ファイルやpipx/Homebrew配布があり、単一appバンドルの必要性は薄い。回答してクローズ可能。
evidence: none (packaging/distribution question)
draft_comment: Meson is distributed as a standalone, dependency-bundled executable via its release artifacts (built with PyInstaller), and can also be installed portably through `pipx`, Homebrew, or `pip install --user`. These cover the 'no separate Python install needed' use case that a CMake-style `.app` bundle would provide. There isn't a strong reason to maintain a dedicated macOS `.app`. I'll close this as answered; if there's a concrete workflow the existing standalone releases don't cover, please describe it and we can reopen.

title: Problems using LLVM in a non CPP project.
rationale_ja: 報告のクラッシュ(LLVMDCompilerにthread_link_flags属性が無くAttributeError)は解消。thread_link_flagsは基底Compilerクラスに定義され全コンパイラが継承する。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:1076-1077 (Compiler.thread_link_flags 基底実装)
draft_comment: The crash reported here (`'LLVMDCompiler' object has no attribute 'thread_link_flags'`) is fixed: `thread_link_flags()` is now defined on the base `Compiler` class (`mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py`), which every compiler including `LLVMDCompiler` inherits. Using the `llvm` dependency from a D project no longer hits that traceback. Closing as fixed; please open a fresh issue if you still see problems mixing LLVM's C interface with a non-C++ project on a current release.

title: Wanted to run some dtc (device tree compiler) commands to convert a dts file to dtb
rationale_ja: m4|dtcのパイプを含む複数コマンドをcustom_targetで実行したいという使い方の質問。1ターゲット1コマンドが原則で、パイプ処理はラッパースクリプトで実現するのがmesonの標準回答。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/custom_target.yaml (single command, capture/feed あり)
draft_comment: A `custom_target` runs a single command, so for a pipeline like `m4 ... | dtc ...` the idiomatic approach is a small wrapper script (shell/python) invoked as the target's command, or two chained `custom_target`s where the second consumes the first's output. `capture: true` / `feed: true` cover simple stdin/stdout redirection. This is a usage question rather than a Meson defect, so I'll close it; feel free to ask on the discussion tracker if you need help wiring up the wrapper.

title: b_asneeded=false should explicitly do -Wl,--no-as-needed
rationale_ja: b_asneeded有効時に--as-neededを付与するのみで、無効時に明示的な--no-as-neededを出さない。ディストロ既定が--as-neededの環境では明示無効化が必要で、get_asneeded_argsに無効時の引数を追加すれば解決。

implementation_hint: Give get_asneeded_args a value/enable parameter (or add get_no_asneeded_args) returning ['-Wl,--no-as-needed'] when b_asneeded is False, and emit it in the else branch in compilers.py get_base_link_args.

title: pkgconfig.generate fails when using libgcrypt dependency

title: ninja scan-build should pass --status-bugs
rationale_ja: SCANBUILD環境変数がsplit_argsで解析され追加引数が保持されるようになり、絶対パスでなくてもshutil.whichで解決されるため、SCANBUILD='scan-build --status-bugs'の運用が機能する。報告の失敗は解消済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/tooldetect.py:194-209 (SCANBUILD を split_args、[tool]+exelist[1:] を返し which で解決)
draft_comment: The reported failures are resolved: `detect_scanbuild()` now parses `SCANBUILD` with `split_args()` and resolves it via `shutil.which`, so `SCANBUILD='scan-build --status-bugs'` (or a non-absolute path) works and the extra arguments are preserved (`[tool] + exelist[1:]`). You can pass `--status-bugs` this way to fail CI on findings. Closing as addressed; please reopen if a current release still drops the extra args.

title: meson --reconfigure or ninja configure should force dependency checks
rationale_ja: 依存キャッシュを無効化して再検出する`meson setup --clearcache`が追加済み(coredata.clear_cacheがdepsキャッシュをクリア)。--reconfigure単体では意図的にキャッシュを残す設計だが、要望の機能は別フラグで提供されている。
evidence: mesonbuild/msetup.py:76 (--clearcache), :199-200 (clear_cache on clearcache); mesonbuild/coredata.py:367-369 clear_cache() clears deps.host/build
draft_comment: Meson now provides `meson setup --clearcache` (optionally with `--reconfigure`), which clears the cached dependency lookups so they are re-detected against the current environment (see `coredata.clear_cache()` clearing the deps cache). This gives the explicit "force re-check dependencies" behavior requested here. `--reconfigure` on its own intentionally keeps the cache for speed. Does `--clearcache` resolve your use case?

title: Misdetection of early 64-bit Intel Macs as 32-bit
rationale_ja: detect_cpu_familyのコンパイラdefineチェックはx86_64→x86のダウングレードのみで、uname -mがi386を返す初期64bit Macでx86→x86_64へアップグレードする経路が無い。sysctl hw.cpu64bit_capable等による救済は未実装で依然有効。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:607-608 (i386->x86), :637-639 (only downgrades x86_64->x86 via __i386__; no upgrade path for i386 kernel + 64-bit userland)
implementation_hint: On Darwin, when platform.machine() reports i386/x86 but the compiler defines __x86_64__ (or sysctl -n hw.cpu64bit_capable == 1), promote the detected family to x86_64.

title: TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not ExternalProgramHolder

draft_comment: The interpreter's object-holder and argument-typing model has been substantially rewritten since 0.52.0 (typed_pos_args/typed_kwargs now validate arguments up front). The original traceback is unlikely to reproduce as-is. Could you confirm whether this still occurs on a current Meson release, ideally with a minimal meson.build? Otherwise this will be closed as stale.

title: Prioritize clang ObjC compiler over gobjc
rationale_ja: detect.pyのObjC/ObjC++コンパイラ既定順序がclangを先頭にする形に変更済み(objc=['clang','gcc'], objcpp=['clang++','g++'])。要望どおりclangが優先される。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py:53-54,65-66 defaults['objc']=['clang',...,'gcc'], defaults['objcpp']=['clang++',...,'g++']
draft_comment: This is fixed: Meson now defaults to preferring clang for Objective-C/C++. In `mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py` the default program order is `objc = ['clang', 'gcc']` and `objcpp = ['clang++', 'g++']` (with clang/clang-cl first on Windows), so clang is chosen ahead of gobjc when both are present. Closing as fixed.

draft_comment: Meson now has dedicated Apple-clang compiler classes (`AppleClangCCompiler`, `AppleClangCPPCompiler`, `AppleClangObjCCompiler`, etc.) plus an Apple mixin (`mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/apple.py`) that overrides the version thresholds used for standard/feature detection, so Xcode's clang is no longer treated as if its reported version mapped directly onto vanilla LLVM releases. title: Get raw compile / link arguments from dependencies

title: Can "exe_wrapper" accept a relative file command?
rationale_ja: 相対パス起点の疑問。1.3.0 以降マシンファイルで @DIRNAME@（ファイル格納ディレクトリ）と @GLOBAL_SOURCE_ROOT@ が使えるようになり、exe_wrapper を確定的パスで指定可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/machinefile.py (@DIRNAME@, @GLOBAL_SOURCE_ROOT@ substitutions); docs/markdown/Machine-files.md L131-140
draft_comment: Relative paths in a machine/cross file are resolved against your working directory / PATH, which is why bare or `..`-relative names were unreliable. Since Meson 1.3.0 you can anchor the path deterministically using the `@DIRNAME@` token (the directory containing the machine file) or `@GLOBAL_SOURCE_ROOT@`, e.g. `exe_wrapper = '@DIRNAME@' / 'hardwareSim.bat'`. See the 'Machine files' documentation. Closing as answered.

title: subproject: specify libraries to install

evidence: docs/yaml/functions/install_data.yaml; docs/yaml/functions/declare_dependency.yaml
draft_comment: You can install an arbitrary prebuilt file with `install_data('lib/foo.so', install_dir: get_option('libdir'))`, and select the right architecture-specific file inside the subproject using `host_machine.cpu_family()` / `host_machine.system()`. Wrap the includes/link args in `declare_dependency(...)` so the main project just consumes the dependency object. This keeps all the details in the subproject. Closing as answered — please reopen if a concrete case isn't expressible this way.

title: Files in different directories considered duplicates when adding dependencies to gnome.compile_resources()
rationale_ja: gnome.compile_resources() が異なるディレクトリの同名 custom_target を basename で照合し重複扱いする問題。該当ロジック（basename マッチ）はコードに残存しており、確定的な修正は見つからない。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py compile_resources (basename-based dependency matching still present)
implementation_hint: In gnome.compile_resources, the dependency-file matching keys on basename only; disambiguate by matching the full output path (or the manifest-relative path) instead of os.path.basename when selecting the depended-on custom target.

title: Better error message -> ERROR: Command cannot have '@INPUT@', since no input files were specified
rationale_ja: custom_target のエラーにファイル名・行番号を含めてほしい要望。多くの InterpreterException は node 位置情報を付与するようになったが、この特定メッセージが行情報付きかは未確認のため保守的に keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py (custom_target @INPUT@ validation)
implementation_hint: Ensure the '@INPUT@ but no input' check raises InvalidArguments/InterpreterException with the current node so meson prints file:line, and include the custom_target name in the message.

title: get_variable() needs better docs
rationale_ja: CMake依存で get_variable(cmake:) が返す変数が PACKAGE_INCLUDE_DIRS 等に固定リネームされる点の説明要望。CMake-module.md/dep.yaml に get_variable はあるが、PACKAGE_* 命名規則の明示的説明は見当たらず、ドキュメント追記が有益。
evidence: docs/markdown/CMake-module.md L147; docs/yaml/objects/dep.yaml get_variable; mesonbuild/dependencies/data/CMakeLists.txt
implementation_hint: Document in CMake-module.md / dep.yaml get_variable that CMake-detected deps expose renamed variables PACKAGE_INCLUDE_DIRS / PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS / PACKAGE_LIBRARIES (from mesonbuild/dependencies/data/CMakeLists.txt), not the package's own CMake variable names.

title: dependency('Ceres') does not extract include paths via CMake
rationale_ja: CMake依存の include パスが取れないバグ。CMake>=3.17 では trace が json-v1 形式になり、旧 human trace のパース起因の欠落は大きく改善している。ただし本ケースの再現確認はできず低確度。
evidence: mesonbuild/cmake/traceparser.py L103,L153,L178 (json-v1 trace for cmake>=3.17)
draft_comment: The CMake dependency backend was substantially reworked; with CMake >= 3.17 Meson now uses the structured `--trace-format=json-v1` output instead of parsing the human-readable trace, which fixed a class of include-path extraction problems. Could you retry with a current Meson + CMake and confirm whether `-I` flags for Ceres are now populated? If it still fails, please attach a fresh meson-log.txt so we can reopen with current data.

title: [Question] Define library prefix/suffix via the meson call?
rationale_ja: 生成ライブラリの prefix/suffix をコマンドラインで変えたいという質問。Meson はターゲット単位の name_prefix / name_suffix kwarg で対応する方針で、グローバルな -Dsuffix= 相当は提供しない。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml (name_prefix, name_suffix kwargs)
draft_comment: Meson controls library naming per target via the `name_prefix` and `name_suffix` keyword arguments to `library()`/`shared_library()`/`static_library()`, not via a global `-D` variable like CMake's `CMAKE_*_LIBRARY_(PREFIX|SUFFIX)`. If you need to override the default per platform, set `name_suffix`/`name_prefix` (optionally driven by your own project option). Closing as answered.

title: Allow emscripten to be used as non cross compiler
rationale_ja: emscripten を非クロスとして扱いたい要望。現状 emscripten は wasm 環境向けクロスとして扱われ、出力は WASM/JS で実行ランタイムが必要。設計上の判断が絡み議論継続中（7コメント、直近も更新）。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/emscripten.py; docs/markdown/Reference-tables.md (emscripten system/environment)

title: native and cross files layering is mentionned, but doc does not tell how to use it
rationale_ja: --native-file の記載欠落とレイヤリング手順の不明確さの指摘。現在 Native-environments.md に --native-file の使用例があり、Machine-files.md で constants を用いた複数ファイル合成（レイヤリング）が具体例付きで文書化されている。
evidence: docs/markdown/Native-environments.md L25-27; docs/markdown/Machine-files.md L54-98 (constants + multiple --cross-file/--native-file layering example)
draft_comment: The documentation has been expanded: `--native-file` is now shown in Native-environments.md, and Machine-files.md documents layering (passing `--cross-file`/`--native-file` multiple times) together with the `[constants]` section and a concrete `meson setup --cross-file a.ini --cross-file b.ini` composition example. Closing as the doc gap is addressed; please reopen if something specific is still unclear.

title: Language D does not support phobos library finding
rationale_ja: get_compiler('d').find_library() が「does not support library finding」で失敗。D コンパイラに find_library 実装は無く、compilers.py の汎用エラーが今も投げられる。未実装のまま。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/d.py (no find_library override); mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:861 generic 'does not support library finding' error
implementation_hint: Implement find_library in the D compiler classes (mesonbuild/compilers/d.py) to at least handle phobos/druntime and simple -L link-library resolution, instead of falling back to the generic EnvironmentException in compilers.py.

title: Request for improvement: installing dependencies transparently when needed
rationale_ja: 依存DLLを自動でビルド/インストール先へコピーする機能要望。Windows での DLL 自動収集は大規模かつ設計要検討で、明確な実装証跡は無い。
evidence: none

title: kconfig/keyval: clarify location(s) of the .load("./.config") file: source_root() or build_root()?
rationale_ja: keyval.load() の .config ファイル探索起点（source/build）を明確化するドキュメント課題。Keyval-module.md はあるが本件の入出力位置に関する明確な best practice 記述は未整備と見られ、議論継続中。
evidence: docs/markdown/Keyval-module.md; mesonbuild/modules/keyval.py
implementation_hint: Document in Keyval-module.md how keyval.load() resolves a relative path (relative to current source dir) and clarify the build-input vs build-output guidance for .config placement.

title: configure_file does not accept program object as input
rationale_ja: configure_file の input は今も string/File のみ受理し、ExternalProgram を渡すと 'Inputs can only be strings or file objects' で失敗する（interpreter.py で確認）。未対応。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:2827-2835 (func_configure_file: 'Inputs can only be strings or file objects')
implementation_hint: In func_configure_file, accept ExternalProgram/Executable/File-typed objects for `input` by resolving them to their path (e.g. via get_path/absolute_path) before source_strings_to_files, mirroring how `command` already accepts program objects.

title: b_vscrt doesn't have any effect at the compiler sanity check stage
rationale_ja: コンパイラのサニティチェック（LINKモード）で b_vscrt を optstore から読み get_crt_compile_args/get_crt_link_args を付与するよう修正済み。cross+wine で -Db_vscrt=md が効くようになっている。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/clike.py:333-337 (_get_basic_compiler_args reads b_vscrt), :279-286 (_sanity_check_compile_args uses it)
draft_comment: This has been fixed. The MSVC-style sanity/compiler check now reads `b_vscrt` from the option store and applies `get_crt_compile_args()`/`get_crt_link_args()` in `_get_basic_compiler_args` (mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/clike.py), which is used by `_sanity_check_compile_args`. So `-Db_vscrt=md` is now honored at the sanity-check stage without needing to hardcode `-MD` in `c_args`. Closing as fixed.

title: setting pkg_config_path in default_options leads to strange behavior
rationale_ja: default_options で pkg_config_path を設定すると再generate時に反映されず PKG_CONFIG_PATH がデフォルトに戻る問題。オプションストアは大幅刷新されたが本ケースの回帰確認はできず保守的に keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/coredata.py, mesonbuild/options.py (option store reworked); no explicit fix confirmed for pkg_config_path reconfigure

title: Dub dependency error message confusing: says wrong compiler when it's a build type mismatch
rationale_ja: dub 依存の buildType 不一致を「wasn't compiled with <DC>」と誤表示する問題。dub.py の該当ロジックは現存し、メッセージ改善の証跡は無い。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dub.py (_find_right_lib_path / error message)
implementation_hint: In mesonbuild/dependencies/dub.py, distinguish a buildType/config mismatch from a compiler mismatch in _find_right_lib_path and emit a message naming the actual reason (e.g. 'found but not built for buildType=debug').

title: Subproject default_options are ignored
rationale_ja: subproject() の default_options が無視される問題。オプションストア刷新に伴い do_subproject で default_options を forced_options としてマージする実装になっており、サブプロジェクトのプロジェクトオプションにも適用される。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:942-1024 (do_subproject default_options -> forced_options merge)
draft_comment: Subproject option handling was reworked with the new option store. `do_subproject()` now merges the `default_options` you pass into the subproject's options (see mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py `do_subproject`), so `subproject('libfoo', default_options: ['BUILD_TESTS=false'])` now takes effect for the subproject's own project options. Could you confirm on current Meson? If it still reproduces, please attach the exact reproducer and we'll reopen.

title: should meson introspect ignore DESTDIR?
rationale_ja: meson introspect が DESTDIR を無視して install パスを返す点の是非（設計議論）。install パスは prefix ベースで返す設計が妥当とされ、DESTDIR はインストール時のみ適用という整理が必要な議論案件。
evidence: mesonbuild/mintro.py (install path introspection)

title: LDFLAGS, dependency('boost'), and werror=true cause build failures in objcpp on mac
rationale_ja: LDFLAGS の -L がコンパイル引数(get_external_args)に混入し objcpp+werror でビルド失敗。env の LDFLAGS 分離処理は存在するが本ケースの回帰確認ができず保守的に keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py get_external_args/get_external_link_args

title: pyinstallation.dependency() version check broken?
rationale_ja: python モジュールの .dependency() が version を検査しない問題。現在は標準の DEPENDENCY_KWS を受け、find_external_dependency 経由で version 比較が行われるため、'>=3.20' 等は正しく not-found になる。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:292-311 (dependency_method uses DEPENDENCY_KWS + _dependency_method_impl -> find_external_dependency)
draft_comment: The python module's `.dependency()` now goes through the standard dependency machinery: it accepts the common dependency kwargs (including `version`) and resolves via `find_external_dependency` (mesonbuild/modules/python.py), which performs the version comparison. A check like `pyinstall.dependency(version: '>=3.20', required: true)` will now fail as expected. Closing as fixed — please reopen if you still see the version constraint being ignored on current Meson.

title: compiler include directory flag incorrect on windows
rationale_ja: build.ninja の include フラグが -I で /I にならないという報告だが、MSVC は -I を受理し、Meson は基本 -I を用いる。再現条件（どの引数か）が不明確で、pkg-config 由来 include の扱いに依存する古い報告。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/visualstudio.py (get_include_args uses -I which MSVC accepts)
draft_comment: MSVC/clang-cl accept `-I` as an alias for `/I`, so a bare `-I` in build.ninja is not itself a bug. This report is from 2020 and the specific case (likely pkg-config-provided include dirs) isn't reproducible from the description. Could you confirm whether this still fails on a current Meson, and if so provide the exact `-I` argument and the compiler error? Otherwise this will be closed as stale.

title: Layering Improvement: "Include" a cross/native base within the file
rationale_ja: マシンファイル内で別ファイルを include したい要望。直接の include 構文は無いが、複数 --cross-file/--native-file のレイヤリングと [constants] による合成で同等の再利用が可能（0.56.0 以降）。
evidence: docs/markdown/Machine-files.md L54-98; mesonbuild/machinefile.py (constants, layering)
draft_comment: Meson doesn't have a literal `include('base.txt')` directive inside machine files, but the intended workflow is supported two ways: (1) pass multiple `--cross-file`/`--native-file` args, which layer/compose; and (2) since 0.56.0 the `[constants]` section lets you define shared toolchain values in a base file and reference them from a platform file, which composes across layered files. See Machine-files.md. Closing as answered; a dedicated `include` directive can be tracked separately if there's demand for it beyond layering.

title: "Unable to determine dynamic linker" when using c_ld and cpp_ld
rationale_ja: cross ファイルで c_ld/cpp_ld に arm-none-eabi-ld を指定すると「Unable to determine dynamic linker」になる問題。c_ld 経路は linkers/detect.py に存在するが、bare 'ld' 指定時の扱いは今も注意が必要で、ドキュメント/挙動議論が継続（ラベル: documentation, dynamic linkers）。
evidence: mesonbuild/linkers/detect.py:136-139 (c_ld/cpp_ld override handling)

title: TAP implementation issue
rationale_ja: TAPパーサが unknown 行をエラー扱いしていた問題。現在は UnknownLine を yield し、テスト実行側は警告として無視する（TAP仕様準拠）実装になっている。
evidence: mesonbuild/mtest.py:337 (UnknownLine NamedTuple), :482 (yield self.UnknownLine), :1175-1190 (treated as warning, not error)
draft_comment: Fixed. The TAP parser now emits `UnknownLine` for non-standard output rather than an error, and the test runner treats unknown lines as an ignorable warning (mesonbuild/mtest.py), which matches the TAP spec requirement that a parser must not treat an unknown line as an error. Closing as fixed.

title: Way to specify backend for wxwdidgets dependency
rationale_ja: wxWidgets の GTK3 版 wx-config を選びたい要望。マシンファイルの [binaries] で wx-config を上書き指定でき（Machine-files.md に明記）、config-tool 依存は tools kwarg でも選択可能。
evidence: docs/markdown/Machine-files.md:196 (wx-config overridable in [binaries]); mesonbuild/dependencies/configtool.py:44 (tools kwarg); mesonbuild/dependencies/ui.py:148-151
draft_comment: You can pin the wx-config binary in a native/machine file's `[binaries]` section, e.g. `wx-config = '/usr/bin/wx-config-gtk3'` — this is documented in Machine-files.md (wx-config is in the list of overridable config tools). Config-tool dependencies also honor a `tools` kwarg. This gives reproducible selection of the GTK3 build without uninstalling GTK2. Closing as answered.

title: Is there any way to compose *_args when layering cross files?
rationale_ja: クロスファイルのレイヤリングで *_args を上書きでなく合成したい要望。0.56.0 以降の [constants] と + 演算子で共通フラグを定義し c_args = common + [...] のように合成できる。
evidence: docs/markdown/Machine-files.md L54-75 (constants + '+'/'/' operators); mesonbuild/machinefile.py:87-97 (ArithmeticNode '+')
draft_comment: Since 0.56.0 machine files support a `[constants]` section plus the `+` (concatenation) and `/` (path join) operators, which is exactly the composition you want. Define the shared flags once and build up per-target sets: e.g. `[constants]\nfp_flags = ['-mfloat-abi=hard', ...]` then `[properties]\nc_args = common_flags + fp_flags`. This composes across layered `--cross-file` args instead of overriding. See Machine-files.md. Closing as answered.

title: Multiline properties.
rationale_ja: マシンファイルの [properties] で配列を複数行にしたい要望。継続行をインデントすれば複数行配列がパースできることを実機で確認（末尾の閉じ括弧もインデントが必要）。
evidence: mesonbuild/machinefile.py (configparser + mparser); verified locally: multiline c_args array with indented lines parses to ['-mcpu=cortex-m3','-mthumb']
draft_comment:
Multiline arrays in `[properties]` do work now, as long as the continuation lines are indented (INI continuation), including the closing bracket. For example:
```
[properties]
c_args = [
    '-mcpu=cortex-m3',
    '-mthumb',
    ]
```
parses correctly. I verified this against current master. Closing as fixed; note the closing `]` (and all continuation lines) must be indented deeper than the key.

title: b_sanitize shouldn't apply to native builds when cross-compiling
rationale_ja: クロスビルド時に b_sanitize がネイティブツールにも適用される問題。オプションは per-target（override_options）で解決され、native ターゲットに override_options: {'b_sanitize':'none'} を付けられる。既定挙動の議論は残るが回避策は提供済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:310 (get_option_for_target(target, 'b_sanitize')); docs/yaml/functions/_build_target_base.yaml:254 (override_options kwarg)
draft_comment: b_* options are now resolved per target (`get_option_for_target`), and build targets accept an `override_options` kwarg, so you can build a native tool without ASan via `executable('nativehelper', ..., native: true, override_options: {'b_sanitize': 'none'})`. That covers the concrete failure described. Whether Meson should also change the *default* so sanitizers never apply to build-machine targets is a design decision; if you want to pursue that specifically, let's keep that scoped discussion, but the immediate need is addressable today. Closing as answered — reopen if the default-behavior change is what you want tracked.

title: No easy way to package a generated source file to the dist tarball
rationale_ja: 生成ソースを dist tarball に含める簡便な方法の要望。custom_target/generator に dist: true 相当の kwarg は未実装（custom_target.yaml で確認）。add_dist_script による手動回避のみ。
evidence: docs/yaml/functions/custom_target.yaml (no dist kwarg); mesonbuild/modules/... add_dist_script only
implementation_hint: Add an opt-in mechanism (e.g. a `dist: true` kwarg on custom_target/generator, or a meson.add_dist_files() helper) so that named generated outputs are built and copied into the meson-dist staging tree during `ninja dist`, without requiring a hand-written add_dist_script.

title: How to avoid get_wine_shortpath or avoid adding self.test.extra_paths?
rationale_ja: wine exe_wrapper 時に get_wine_shortpath が毎回実行され遅延する問題/opt-out 要望。extra_paths と wine shortpath 処理は現存し、opt-out 手段の追加証跡は無い。
evidence: mesonbuild/ (get_wine_shortpath, test extra_paths handling)

title: Wrong include path for OpenCL dependency
rationale_ja: CMake経由OpenCLの include パスがスペースで分割され 'C:/Program Files/NVIDIA' だけになるバグ。CMake>=3.17 の json-v1 trace 採用でスペース入りパスの分割問題は解消しているはず。実機再現は未確認。
evidence: mesonbuild/cmake/traceparser.py:103,153,178 (json-v1 trace for cmake>=3.17 preserves spaces; splits on ';')
draft_comment: The root cause here was the old human-readable CMake trace parser splitting paths on spaces (hence `C:/Program Files/NVIDIA` getting truncated). With CMake >= 3.17 Meson now uses `--trace-format=json-v1` (mesonbuild/cmake/traceparser.py), which preserves arguments containing spaces and only splits list entries on `;`. This should fix the OpenCL/CUDA include path. Could you retry with a current Meson + CMake >= 3.17 and confirm? If it still truncates, please attach a fresh meson-log.txt.

title: Add native support for discover and running single python unittest based tests
rationale_ja: python unittest を自動 discover して個別 test() 化する機能要望。専用の pythontest()/discover 機能は未実装で、ユーザ側の run_command ハックのみ。
evidence: none (no python unittest discovery in mesonbuild/modules/python.py)

title: Building DLang dylibs on MacOS fails if "version" is set
rationale_ja: macOS で D 共有ライブラリに version を設定するとリンカに空の -current_version が渡り失敗するバグ。D コンパイラの soname/version 引数生成は現存し、修正の確証は無い。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/d.py (get_soname_args / version handling)
implementation_hint: In the D compiler's darwin soname/version argument generation (mesonbuild/compilers/d.py), ensure -compatibility_version/-current_version receive their value tokens (they are currently emitted without the version, producing empty -L= entries).

title: No easy way to test if a dist tarball is being created
rationale_ja: 設定時に dist tarball 作成中かを判定する API 要望。meson.is_dist_check() 相当のメソッドは mesonmain.py に存在せず未実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/mesonmain.py (no is_dist/is_dist_check method in method list)
implementation_hint: Expose a `meson.is_dist()`/is_dist_check() method (mesonbuild/interpreter/mesonmain.py) that reflects whether the current configure is running inside the `meson dist` staging build, e.g. via an environment flag set by mdist.py when it reconfigures the unpacked tree.

title: Cannot use output of gnome.genmarshal as input.
rationale_ja: gnome.genmarshal の出力(CustomTargetIndex)を gnome.mkenums_simple の sources に渡せない問題。mkenums_simple の sources は今も (str, File) のみ受理で CustomTarget 系を拒否する。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:1945-1950 (mkenums_simple 'sources' ContainerTypeInfo(list, (str, mesonlib.File)) only)
implementation_hint: Widen the `sources` kwarg type of gnome.mkenums_simple (and mkenums) in mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py to also accept CustomTarget/CustomTargetIndex/GeneratedList, as compile_resources already does, so genmarshal outputs can be fed in.

title: Allow get_pkgconfig_variable's define_variable to take a dict
rationale_ja: get_pkgconfig_variable の define_variable を dict 化する要望だが、当メソッド自体が 0.56.0 で非推奨化され、後継の dep.get_variable(pkgconfig_define: ...) に移行。array 記法のまま非推奨のため要望は obsolete。
evidence: docs/yaml/objects/dep.yaml:21-24 (get_pkgconfig_variable deprecated: 0.56.0), :226-228 (get_variable pkgconfig_define)
draft_comment: `get_pkgconfig_variable()` was deprecated in 0.56.0 in favor of the unified `dep.get_variable(pkgconfig: ..., pkgconfig_define: ...)`. Since the old method is deprecated and won't gain new syntax, this specific request (dict form of `define_variable`) is obsolete. If a dict form for `pkgconfig_define` on the new `get_variable` is desirable, that can be tracked as a fresh enhancement. Closing.

title: Add a way to make get_pkgconfig_variable override prefix + all *dir options
rationale_ja: pkg-config の completionsdir 等を取得する際、自プロジェクトの prefix/*dir を使わせたい要望。define_variable/pkgconfig_define で prefix 等を差し替える回避はあるが、全 *dir を一括で project 値に揃える専用機能は未実装。
evidence: docs/yaml/objects/dep.yaml (get_variable pkgconfig_define: pairs); mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py

title: Add helper to detect sanitizer libraries LD_PRELOAD values
rationale_ja: 各コンパイラの sanitizer ランタイムを LD_PRELOAD 用に検出するヘルパー要望。専用 API の実装証跡は無く、未対応と見られる。
evidence: none

title: Contributing manual translation
rationale_ja: マニュアルの日本語翻訳貢献のガイドライン要望。既存の翻訳ページ（Getting-meson_ptbr/_zh 等）は個別に存在するが、体系的な翻訳ワークフローは整備されておらず、実質的に未対応方針。
evidence: docs/markdown/Getting-meson_ptbr.md, Getting-meson_zh.md (ad-hoc translated pages only; no translation workflow)
draft_comment: Meson doesn't maintain a formal manual-translation workflow; the few translated pages that exist (e.g. Getting-meson in pt-br/zh) were contributed ad hoc as standalone markdown files under docs/markdown/. If you'd like to contribute a Japanese translation, the practical path is to add translated `*_ja.md` pages via a PR. There is no i18n tooling planned for the docs, so a dedicated translation guideline is unlikely to be added. Closing; PRs adding translated pages are welcome.

title: Improperly formatted data in buildsystem_files.json on Windows host
rationale_ja: Windows で buildsystem_files のパス表記が不正だった問題。現在 list_buildsystem_files は PurePath(...).as_posix() で一貫して posix 形式のパスを出力する。
evidence: mesonbuild/mintro.py:299-302 (list_buildsystem_files uses PurePath(src_dir, x).as_posix())

title: meson setup fails with an empty installation prefix (e.g. --prefix='')
rationale_ja: prefixは絶対パス必須という設計上の制約で現在も維持されている。空prefixのユースケース(DESTDIRでの再配置)はDESTDIRやprefix='/'で対応可能であり、空文字許可は意図的に非対応。
evidence: mesonbuild/options.py:959-960 still raises 'prefix value must be an absolute path' if not absolute.
draft_comment: Meson intentionally requires `prefix` to be an absolute path (`mesonbuild/options.py` still enforces this). For the packaging use case described, the recommended approach is to use `DESTDIR` at install time (which you're already doing) together with a normal absolute `prefix` such as `--prefix=/usr` or `--prefix=/`; the empty-prefix behavior from autotools is not supported by design. Closing as wontfix unless there's a concrete case that DESTDIR + absolute prefix cannot cover.

title: Meson doesn't set the right file-dependencies for D projects

draft_comment: Dependency tracking for D has been substantially improved since this report. The D compilers now implement `get_dependency_gen_args`/`get_depfile_suffix` (dmd uses `-makedeps` from frontend 2.095+, and the GDC/LDC paths emit dep files as well; see `mesonbuild/compilers/d.py`). Meson now generates and consumes depfiles for D sources, so changing an imported module should trigger rebuilds of dependents. Could you retest with a current release and confirm whether your reproducer still misses the rebuild?

title: Is there a way to identify if this module/file should be compiled or not

draft_comment: This is a usage question. The typical Meson approach is to define options (`meson.options`/`get_option()`) and conditionally `subdir()` into module directories, e.g. `if get_option('module_a') \n subdir('module_a') \n endif`. For a kernel/U-Boot-style `.config` file, Meson ships the `keyval` module which can load `KEY=VALUE` config files into a dictionary you can branch on. Closing as answered; please follow up on the mailing list / discussions if you need more detail.

title: [Docs] Difference between buildtype=plain and buildtype=custom

draft_comment: The docs now explain this. `buildtype` is a two-way mapping to `debug`+`optimization`: `plain` corresponds to `debug=false, optimization=plain`, whereas `custom` is what you get for any combination of `debug`/`optimization` that doesn't map to a named buildtype (so `-Ddebug=true` on top of `plain` yields `custom`). title: Extract string from custom_target
rationale_ja: ファイル内容を文字列に読み込むにはfs.read()があるが、custom_targetのビルド時生成出力の読み込みはビルドループ防止のため設計上不可。CRC等の値はリンク時にリンカスクリプト/生成ソースで扱うのが定石。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/fs.py:243 fs.read() reads source-tree files at configure time; explicitly rejects built files and build-dir paths (raises 'path must not be in the build tree').
draft_comment: For reading a file into a string at configure time there is now `fs.read()` (the `fs` module). However, note that it deliberately cannot read build-time-generated files (custom_target outputs): those don't exist at configure time and reading them would create a configure/build loop, so `fs.read()` rejects paths in the build tree. For your CRC use case, the value must be consumed at build time — e.g. generate the linker `--defsym` argument inside a wrapper script/custom_target, or generate a small source/linker-script file, rather than trying to turn the custom_target output into a Meson string. Closing as answered; happy to reopen if this doesn't fit.

title: ninja backend + Visual Studio uses wrong name_prefix + extension for libraries by default

evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:2387 determine_default_prefix_and_suffix + DEFAULT_STATIC_LIBRARY_NAMES windows=('','lib'); mesonbuild/options.py:694 namingscheme option; docs/markdown/Release-notes-for-1.10.0.md:209
draft_comment: The default `libfoo.a` naming for static libraries on Windows is intentional (it avoids clashing with import libraries and works with both MSVC and GCC toolchains — see https://mesonbuild.com/FAQ.html#why-does-building-my-project-with-msvc-output-static-libraries-called-libfooa). However, since Meson 1.10.0 there is now a `namingscheme` option: setting `-Dnamingscheme=platform` produces platform-native names, so static libraries get `.lib`, shared libraries `.dll` and import libraries `.dll.lib`. That should give you the `mylibrary.lib` you expected. Closing as resolved by that option; please reopen if it doesn't cover your case.

title: Library compile flags are not passed to dependees
rationale_ja: `link_with`はコンパイルフラグを伝播しない仕様で、これは意図的な設計。依存フラグを伝播させたい場合は`declare_dependency`を使い`dependencies:`で渡すのが正しい方法。
evidence: By-design: link_with propagates link deps, not compile args; declare_dependency exists for propagating compile_args (docs/yaml/functions/declare_dependency.yaml)
draft_comment: This is working as designed: `link_with` only links against a library, it does not propagate the library's compile arguments (like `-DBOOST_LOG_DYN_LINK`). Compile-argument propagation is what dependency objects are for. Wrap the library plus its Boost dependency in `declare_dependency(link_with: log, dependencies: [boost_dep])` and pass that via `dependencies:` to consumers — the boost compile args (including the DYN_LINK define) will then propagate correctly, including across subprojects. Closing as answered; please reopen if that doesn't work for you.

title: MSYS2/MinGW: Permission denied when host OS defers file deletion
rationale_ja: 同名sanitycheck実行ファイルが連続コンパイルで衝突・ロックされる問題。現在コンパイラチェックはTemporaryDirectoryWinProof(一意な一時ディレクトリ)内で実行されるため、ファイル名衝突は解消されている。

They now run inside a unique per-check temporary directory (see `TemporaryDirectoryWinProof` in `mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py`), so rapid successive checks can no longer collide on a locked output file. This should resolve the intermittent 'Permission denied' failures under MSYS2/MinGW. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a current log if you still hit it.
