title: Issue to generate .so file with linking .a file
rationale_ja: 静的ライブラリ(.a)をshared_libraryにlink_withした際にシンボルが取り込まれずサイズが小さくなる問題。これはリンカのアーカイブ挙動(未参照シンボルを除去)であり、link_whole:を使えば解決するユーザ設定の問題。
evidence: link_whole kwarg exists for pulling whole archives into shared libs (build target keyword)
draft_comment: This is the standard linker behaviour: when you link a static library (`.a`) into a shared library with `link_with`, the linker only pulls in object files that resolve an already-referenced symbol, so unreferenced symbols (like your DPI exports) are dropped — hence the small `.so`. Use `link_whole:` instead of `link_with:` to force the entire archive (all object files/symbols) into the shared library. That produces the full-size, working `.so` you get from manually linking the `.o` files. Closing as answered; please reopen if `link_whole` doesn't solve it.

title: dlang: multiple problems with dub dependencies

draft_comment: The DUB backend referenced here (including the `base.py` line you linked) has been completely rewritten since 0.55; it now delegates to `dub describe` and lets DUB resolve subdependencies, import paths and the target triple rather than reconstructing them in Meson. Several of the listed problems (having to list every subdependency, duplicate `-I` flags, missing triple handling) are likely addressed by that rewrite. Since this is a multi-part 2020 report, could you re-test with current Meson + Dub >= 1.35 and open focused issues for anything that still fails? Closing as stale.

title: Support compile-only dependencies
rationale_ja: ヘッダのみ(リンク無し)で依存を使いたい要望。`partial_dependency(compile_args: true, includes: true)`が0.46.0から存在し、依存のコンパイル/インクルード情報だけを取り出せるため解決済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreterobjects.py:562 dependency.partial_dependency (since 0.46.0); docs/yaml/objects/dep.yaml:111 partial_dependency with compile_args/includes
draft_comment:
Meson supports this via `partial_dependency()` (available since 0.46.0). For a pkg-config dependency where you only want headers and no linking, use:
```meson
libfuse_dep = dependency('fuse3', version: '>=3.5.0')
fuse_headers_dep = libfuse_dep.partial_dependency(compile_args: true, includes: true)
executable('foo', 'foo.c', dependencies: [fuse_headers_dep])
```
This gives you the include directories and compile args without pulling in the link libraries. Closing as resolved.

title: Attempt to write to the source directory when running compiler/linker tests
rationale_ja: リンカ引数チェック時に`-o a.out`がソースディレクトリに書き込もうとしサンドボックスで拒否される問題。コンパイラ/リンカチェックは現在TemporaryDirectoryWinProof内でcwd=一時dirとして実行され、出力も一時dir内に置かれるため解消。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py:932,964,982 checks run in TemporaryDirectoryWinProof with cwd=tmpdirname and output in tmpdir
draft_comment: Compiler and linker capability checks now run inside a dedicated temporary directory: the check code creates a `TemporaryDirectoryWinProof` and runs the compiler/linker with `cwd=tmpdirname`, with any output file placed inside that temp dir (see `mesonbuild/compilers/compilers.py`). So a stray `a.out`/`a.out.tmp*` is no longer written into the source directory, and the portage/sandbox ACCESS DENIED you saw should not occur anymore. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a current log if a sandbox still catches a write to the source tree.

title: can't pass multiple @INPUT0@, @INPUT1@ etc. inside a single string inside a command
rationale_ja: @INPUT0@/@INPUT1@が単一文字列内に埋め込まれると置換されない問題。現在substitute_valuesは番号付きキー(@INPUT0@等)をvaluesに登録し、部分文字列も正規表現置換(value_rx.sub)するため、`'echo @INPUT0@ && echo @INPUT1@'`も正しく展開される。
evidence: mesonbuild/utils/universal.py:2178 values[f'@INPUT{ii}@']=vv registered; :2142 value_rx.sub(replace, vv) substitutes numbered keys inside larger strings
draft_comment: This is fixed. `get_filenames_templates_dict` now registers numbered keys `@INPUT0@`, `@INPUT1@`, ... in the substitution table, and `substitute_values` applies them via a regex substitution even when the token is embedded inside a larger string argument (not only when the whole argument equals the token). So your example — `command: ['bash', '-c', 'echo @INPUT0@ && echo @INPUT1@ && echo @OUTPUT@']` — now expands `@INPUT0@`/`@INPUT1@` correctly. Closing as fixed.

title: Change default pkg-config
rationale_ja: pkgconf等の別名pkg-config実装を使えない、PKG_CONFIG環境変数が効かない問題。現在envconfig.pyでpkg-configにPKG_CONFIG環境変数がマッピングされ、machine fileのbinariesでも指定可能なため解消済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:141 'pkg-config': ['PKG_CONFIG']; pkgconfig.py:235 find_external_program with cross/native/env lookup; envconfig.py:444 pkgconfig->pkg-config alias
draft_comment:
You can now point Meson at `pkgconf` (or any pkg-config implementation) in two supported ways:

1. Set the `PKG_CONFIG` environment variable — it is mapped to the `pkg-config` binary lookup (see `ENV_VAR_PROG_MAP` in `mesonbuild/envconfig.py`, `'pkg-config': ['PKG_CONFIG']`).
2. Specify it in the `[binaries]` section of a native/cross file, e.g. `pkg-config = 'pkgconf'`.

`find_external_program` consults the machine-file entry and the env var before falling back to the default `pkg-config` name. Closing as resolved.

title: Question, is there anything similar CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH in meson?

draft_comment: Meson does have equivalents depending on what you need. For CMake-based dependencies you can set `cmake_prefix_path` (in the `[properties]` section of a machine file, or via `-Dcmake_prefix_path=...`), which maps to CMake's `CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH`. For pkg-config based lookups, use `--pkg-config-path` / the `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` environment variable. Since this is a usage question rather than a bug, closing; please reopen or ask on the mailing list / Matrix channel if these don't cover your case.

draft_comment: The main item tracked here has landed: the CMake Server API code path has been removed entirely (only the File API remains under `mesonbuild/cmake/fileapi.py`), and CMake subprojects now go through the File API, effectively requiring CMake >= 3.14 (`CMakeExecutor(self.env, '>=3.14', ...)` in `mesonbuild/cmake/interpreter.py`). title: run_target calling gdb aborts
rationale_ja: run_target経由でgdbを呼ぶとstdinが接続されず中断する問題。run_targetは元々インタラクティブ用途を想定していない。1.5.0で `meson test --interactive` が追加され、stdin/stdout/stderrを直結してgdb等を対話実行できるようになったため、この用途は代替手段で解決可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/mtest.py:141 --interactive; docs/markdown/Release-notes-for-1.5.0.md:172 'The Meson test program supports a new --interactive argument'
draft_comment: `run_target` is designed for fire-and-forget commands and doesn't connect stdin, so interactive tools like gdb can't work through it. For running a debugger under Meson, Meson 1.5.0 added `meson test --interactive`, which invokes the test with stdin/stdout/stderr connected directly to the console (see the 1.5.0 release notes), making it usable for gdb-style interactive sessions. Given that, `run_target` is unlikely to be changed to support interactivity; closing, but please comment if `--interactive` doesn't cover your workflow.

title: The native parameter disables project arguments
rationale_ja: native:true の executable に add_project_arguments の引数が付かないという指摘。add_project_arguments は native: を省略するとhostマシンにのみ適用され、native:true(buildマシン)ターゲットには適用されないのが設計通り。build/host分離の仕様であり、バグではない。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:3102 func_add_project_arguments (NATIVE_KW, 既定はhost); _add_arguments で for_machine 別に適用
draft_comment: This is working as designed. `add_project_arguments(...)` without `native:` applies only to the *host* machine, while `executable(..., native: true)` builds for the *build* machine. Meson deliberately keeps build-machine and host-machine argument sets separate. To apply the arguments to build-machine targets as well, call `add_project_arguments(..., native: true)` (or add a second call), or omit `native: true` on the target if you want the host-machine args. Since the behavior is intentional, closing as wontfix; the docs for `add_project_arguments` describe the native/host split.

title: More granularity in Darwin OS flavors

draft_comment: Meson now distinguishes Apple platforms: `host_machine.system()` returns `ios`, `tvos`, `watchos`, or `visionos` (not just `darwin`) when targeting those, and there are additional `host_machine.subsystem()` and `host_machine.kernel()` methods for finer-grained detection (see `mesonbuild/envconfig.py` and the machine-info interpreter object). This covers the requested granularity, so the `cc.compiles(TARGET_OS_IPHONE)` workaround should no longer be needed. Closing as resolved; please open a focused issue if a specific flavor you need is still missing.

evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:2047 等 @BASENAME@ 置換は outputs/args向けで install_dir への展開処理は無し

title: Meson fails to build Qt-Advanced-Docking-System as a CMake subproject
rationale_ja: CMakeサブプロジェクトでQtのAUTOMOC生成物(mocs_compilation.cpp)が見つからずビルド失敗する問題。CMake File API移行後の挙動確認が必要でランタイム依存のため保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/cmake/ (autogen/AUTOMOC の特別対応は未確認)

title: Ability to run combined meson test suites
rationale_ja: `meson test --suite foo+bar` で複数suite全てに属するテストのみ実行する機能の要望。AND条件のsuite指定構文の実装証拠はなく未実装。エンハンスとして保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/mtest.py (suite の AND/'+' 構文の実装なし)

title: Meson find_library doesn't honor built-in visual studio search paths
rationale_ja: MSVCツールチェインの組込みライブラリ探索パス(Windows Kits等)を cc.find_library が参照せず OpenGL32 等を見つけられない問題。MSVC向けの探索パス取得実装の証拠はなく未対応で保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/clike.py / visualstudio.py (組込みLIBパス列挙の実装未確認)

title: extract_all_objects() with custom target results in invalid paths for subproject with Visual Studio backend
rationale_ja: vsバックエンドでサブプロジェクト内の extract_all_objects() のgenerator出力オブジェクトの相対パスが不正になるバグ。vcxproj生成のランタイム挙動依存で保留。2023年更新あり。
evidence: none

title: "fallthrough" incorrectly supported as a function attribute
rationale_ja: fallthrough はstatement attributeでありfunction attributeではないのに has_function_attribute() の対象に含まれている問題。c_function_attributes.py と Reference-tables.md に依然 fallthrough が残存し未修正。2026-03更新あり。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/c_function_attributes.py:52 'fallthrough'; docs/markdown/Reference-tables.md:320 fallthrough
implementation_hint: Either document `fallthrough` as a special-cased statement attribute (and keep the test snippet that already wraps it in a switch), or split statement attributes into a separate query API; at minimum add a note in Reference-tables.md that fallthrough is a statement attribute.

title: Meson tries to use install_name_tool and otools when install_name_tool exists on ninja install, even with native linux build and installation
rationale_ja: Linuxネイティブビルドなのに install_name_tool が存在するとdarwin用パスに入りotoolを呼ぶ問題。fix_rpath は system 引数を受け取るようになったが、install_name_tool へのフォールバックは fix_elf の例外時に依然到達し得る。system=='darwin' での明示ガードが無く不完全。good first issue。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/depfixer.py:808 fix_rpath(system引数あり) だが :839-844 で fix_elf 例外時に install_name_tool フォールバックが system非依存で発火し得る
implementation_hint: In depfixer.fix_rpath, gate the install_name_tool / fix_darwin fallback behind an explicit `system == 'darwin'` (or is_osx-of-host) check rather than reaching it via a SystemExit from fix_elf.

title: specifying cpp_eh=none on native msvc builds should also specify _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0
rationale_ja: MSVCで cpp_eh=none 指定時、/EHs-c- は付くが _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0 が付かず、STL使用時に警告が出る問題。cpp.pyのMSVC eh処理を確認したが _HAS_EXCEPTIONS の追加は無く未修正。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/cpp.py:844-845 eh=='none' で '/EHs-c-' のみ、_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0 の追加なし
implementation_hint: In the MSVC C++ mixin get_option_compile_args, when eh == 'none' also append `/D_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0` alongside `/EHs-c-`.

title: Feature request: add 'extra_depends' option to executable
rationale_ja: 生成ソースをimportするD等で、executable の全オブジェクトに対する順序依存を張る extra_depends 相当の要望。build_target/executable のkwarg(_BUILD_TARGET_KWS)に depends は含まれず未実装(link_depends はあるがオブジェクト生成順序は保証しない)。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/type_checking.py:780 _BUILD_TARGET_KWS に DEPENDS_KW 無し; :818 link_depends のみ
implementation_hint: Add a `depends` (DEPENDS_KW) kwarg to _BUILD_TARGET_KWS and wire it into BuildTarget.extra_depends so all object compilations order after the listed targets.

title: Feature request: Microchip XC8 compiler support
rationale_ja: Microchip XC8コンパイラのサポート要望。microchip.py には Xc16Compiler/Xc32Compiler は存在するが XC8 は未追加。XC16基盤があるので追加は現実的だが未実装のため保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/microchip.py (Xc16/Xc32のみ、XC8無し); detect.py:326 'xc16' のみ
implementation_hint: Add an Xc8Compiler mixin analogous to Xc16Compiler in mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/microchip.py and detect it in compilers/detect.py by the xc8 compiler/linker name.

title: Subproject links against dynamic library when building both despite -Ddefault_library=static
rationale_ja: サブプロジェクトが default_library=both のとき、親が -Ddefault_library=static でも共有版へリンクしてしまう問題。#7783と関連。リンク解決のランタイム挙動確認が必要で保留。2023年更新あり。
evidence: none

title: Missing or incorrect "WARNING: Unknown options" in native files for cross builds
rationale_ja: クロスビルド時、ネイティブファイルの build.c_args が誤って未知オプション警告され、逆に本当の未知オプションは警告されない問題。オプション処理は options.py 等で刷新されているが当該挙動の修正を断定できず保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/options.py / machinefile.py (刷新済みだが当該警告ロジックの検証未完)

title: Statically linking when using threads produces segfaulting executables
rationale_ja: linux+gccで pthread を静的リンクしたC++実行ファイルがsegfaultする既知問題(-Wl,--whole-archive 等が必要)。mesonがthreads依存の静的リンク時に自動対処するかは設計判断で、実装証拠なく保留。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/misc.py (threads依存に whole-archive 自動付与の実装未確認)

title: OpenMP dependency not found with Nvidia HPC SDK
rationale_ja: Nvidia HPC SDK(nvc)で _OPENMP マクロが定義されず OpenMP依存が検出されない問題。misc.pyのOpenMPには nagfor/pgi の特別処理はあるが nvidia_hpc/nvc の分岐は無く未対応。pgiと同様の分岐追加で対処可能。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/misc.py:133-144 nagfor/pgi の特別処理のみ、nvidia_hpc は無し
implementation_hint: In OpenMPDependency.__init__ (mesonbuild/dependencies/misc.py), add an early branch for compiler id 'nvidia_hpc' (nvc) mirroring the 'pgi' branch: set a supported version and use openmp_flags(), since nvc supports OpenMP 4.5 but does not define _OPENMP.

title: has_function check fails for overloaded functions in C++ code
rationale_ja: has_functionのプロトタイプ有テンプレート(clike.py:726-744)は現在も `void *a = (void*) &{func};` を使っており、C++でオーバーロードされた関数のアドレス取得は依然として失敗しうる。修正の証跡が見当たらないため未解決とみなす。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/clike.py:726-744 (_have_prototype_templ still uses &{func})

title: VS2019 C++17 support
rationale_ja: cpp_std=c++17はcl/MSVCで長年サポートされており、報告は古いVS2017/2019のツールセット固有の問題の可能性が高い。再現情報が乏しく5年以上更新もないため、追加情報を求めて整理すべき。
evidence: none (cpp_std=c++17 supported for MSVC generally)
draft_comment: This report is from 2020 with Meson 0.55 on an old MSVC toolset. Current Meson fully supports `cpp_std=c++17` with the MSVC/cl compiler and passes `/std:c++17` automatically. If you can still reproduce a case where `cpp_std=c++17` does not enable C++17 with a recent VS2019/2022 toolset, please share a minimal `meson.build` and the generated compile command; otherwise this can be closed.

title: pkg-config extra cflags don't apply to local executables
rationale_ja: 内部でlink_withしたライブラリの.pcのextra_cflagsが同一ビルド内の実行ファイルに適用されない点は設計上の課題で、ローカルターゲットに対しpkgconfig生成のcflagsを伝播する仕組みは見当たらない。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/pkgconfig.py (extra_cflags only emitted into generated .pc, not applied to in-tree link_with consumers)

title: cmake subproject dependencies not working
rationale_ja: CMakeサブプロジェクトへメソンで解決したglib-2.0依存を伝播できない問題。cmakeモジュールの複雑な相互運用であり、ローカルコードだけで解決済みか判断できないため据え置き。
evidence: none

title: Add library search paths
rationale_ja: find_libraryには追加検索パスを渡す `dirs` キーワードが存在する(compiler.py:672, find_library呼び出しでsearch_dirsを渡している)。要望2(既存パスへの追加)は満たされる。要望1(システム検索パスの取得)は別途だが、主要機能は実装済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py:672 KwargInfo('dirs',...), :699-710 extract_search_dirs -> compiler.find_library(libname, search_dirs, libtype)
draft_comment: `compiler.find_library()` accepts a `dirs` keyword argument for adding extra library search paths on top of the system defaults (see the `dirs` kwarg in the reference manual). This covers the main request of adding search paths to the existing ones. Querying the system's default library search paths is a separate, narrower feature request. Closing as the primary ask is implemented; feel free to open a focused issue for the path-query part if still needed.

title: Add _conditional_ defaults for warnings/optimizations, or remove warnings about them
rationale_ja: -O3/-Wall等を条件付きで設定したいが組込みオプションはmeson.build本体で条件分岐設定できないという課題。set_optionや条件付きdefaultは未実装で、設計議論が必要なため据え置き。
evidence: none (no set_option / conditional default_options mechanism found)

title: Qt5 module fails to find library files with debug build type using mingw

title: cc.get_define does not work when doing universal builds

title: [Feature Request] print arrays or dicts, that contain unprintable types and printable types
rationale_ja: message()はstringifyUserArgumentsを用いてリスト・辞書を再帰的に整形出力するようになっており、ネストした配列/辞書のprintが可能。要望は実装済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreterbase/helpers.py:54-71 stringifyUserArguments recurses into list (line 62) and dict (line 64-66); interpreter.py:1446 func_message uses it
draft_comment: `message()` now recursively formats nested arrays and dictionaries via `stringifyUserArguments` (see `mesonbuild/interpreterbase/helpers.py`), producing a Meson-syntax debug representation like `[..]` and `{k : v}`. This covers the requested recursive printing of arrays/dicts. Closing as implemented.

title: Non-actionable error message "ERROR: No host machine compiler for ..."

title: Add depend_files to generator() akin to custom_target()
rationale_ja: generator()にはdepfile/dependsはあるがdepend_filesキーワードは未実装(func_generatorのtyped_kwargsにdepend_files無し)。小規模実装で対応可能。

implementation_hint: Add a DEPEND_FILES_KW to func_generator's typed_kwargs and thread it through build.Generator so generator invocations gain implicit file dependencies, mirroring custom_target's depend_files.

title: error on debian: "TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class GnuDynamicLinker with abstract method id"
rationale_ja: 古いpickleされたcoredataを新しいmesonでロードした際の互換性エラー。ビルドディレクトリの再生成で解決する典型的な事象で、5年前の一時的な状況。再現不能な陳腐化案件。
evidence: none (stale coredata pickle load incompatibility; resolved by wiping build dir)
draft_comment: This error comes from loading an old pickled `coredata` (build directory) with a newer/mismatched Meson version, where the linker class hierarchy changed. The supported fix is to wipe and reconfigure the build directory (`meson setup --wipe builddir` or delete it). Meson also now detects a coredata version mismatch and asks you to reconfigure. Given this is 5 years old and environment-specific, closing as obsolete — please reopen if it reproduces with a clean build directory on a current release.

title: Native conan dependency support

draft_comment: Meson intentionally does not parse package-manager-specific formats like `conanbuildinfo.txt`. The recommended path is to have Conan emit standard `pkg-config` (`PkgConfigDeps`) or CMake (`CMakeDeps`) files, which Meson's `dependency()` already consumes natively; Conan supports both generators. A bespoke conan parser inside Meson would be a maintenance burden for a format Meson doesn't control. Closing as out of scope; the pkg-config/cmake generator route is the supported integration.

title: Compiler.check_header fails if the checked header includes a configure_file header

draft_comment: This is fixed. Compiler checks now expand `include_directories` to both the source and build directory paths: `_determine_args()` in `mesonbuild/interpreter/compiler.py` calls `IncludeDirs.abs_string_list(source_dir, build_dir)`, and `abs_string_list()` (in `mesonbuild/build.py`) appends both the source-tree and build-tree variants of each include dir. So a header pulled in via `check_header()`/`has_header()` that includes a `configure_file()`-generated header now resolves without the `-I@BUILD_DIR@` workaround. Closing as fixed.

draft_comment: This report is from Meson 0.56/0.58 and describes a clang++ (GNU-style driver) being paired with MSVC's `link.exe`, producing `-Wl,--subsystem,windows` that `link.exe` cannot understand. Since then the linker detection and `win_subsystem` handling have been substantially rewritten (per-linker `get_win_subsystem_args` now emits `/SUBSYSTEM:` for MSVC/lld-link and `--subsystem` only for GNU-style linkers). draft_comment: Meson does not build Linux kernel modules natively, and this is unlikely to change: `.ko` modules must be built through the kernel's own Kbuild system (which pulls in the running kernel's headers, config, and Makefile machinery). title: meson test with cross compile fails

draft_comment: The `exe_wrapper` should just be `wine` (or `['wine']`), not a string with an embedded `WINEPATH=...` prefix — Meson doesn't parse env-var assignments inside the wrapper string, which is why `meson test` fails to find it. For the sanity-check DLL problem, Meson already computes `WINEPATH` automatically for wine wrappers from the build's library/extra paths (see `mesonbuild/scripts/meson_exe.py`, where it sets `child_env['WINEPATH']` when the wrapper command contains `wine`). If a specific extra directory is still needed, add it via the toolchain library paths rather than the wrapper. This is really a documentation/usage matter; closing as answered — reopen if `meson test` still can't run wine tests with a plain `exe_wrapper = 'wine'` on a current release.

title: @SOURCE_ROOT@ doesn't work in custom_target
rationale_ja: @SOURCE_ROOT@ はcommandの引数では置換されるが、command先頭(実行プログラム)としては置換されず 'Program not found' になる(backends.py:1570 は引数を対象)。使い方の問題で、find_program や files() を使うべき。
evidence: mesonbuild/backend/backends.py:1569-1575 str引数に対してのみ @SOURCE_ROOT@ 等を置換。command先頭要素はプログラム解決(find_program)経路を通る
draft_comment: `@SOURCE_ROOT@` is substituted in command *arguments*, not in the command's first element (the program). In your example `command : ['@SOURCE_ROOT@', '/foo.sh']`, Meson tries to resolve `@SOURCE_ROOT@` as a program to run, hence `Program '@SOURCE_ROOT@' not found`. To run a script from the source tree, pass the script via `find_program()` or `files()` as the program, e.g. `command : [find_program('foo.sh')]`, or use `@SOURCE_ROOT@` only inside later arguments. The substitution machinery is in `mesonbuild/backend/backends.py` (`eval_custom_target_command`), which only rewrites string *arguments*. Closing as answered.

title: include_directories(..., is_system: true) appears to be ignored (at least for GCC & Clang)
rationale_ja: 報告者の誤解。is_system:true は -isystem を、is_system:false は -I を生成する(gnu.py:511-512)。Mesonは -iquote を用いない。期待(-iquote)自体が誤りで、挙動は設計通り正しい。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/gnu.py:508-512 get_include_args: is_system なら ['-isystem'+path] を返す; docs/yaml/functions/include_directories.yaml:23 is_system:true の説明あり
draft_comment: This works as designed, and the expectation in the report is incorrect. Meson never emits `-iquote`. With `is_system: false` (the default) Meson uses `-I`, and with `is_system: true` it uses `-isystem` — see `get_include_args` in `mesonbuild/compilers/mixins/gnu.py`, which returns `['-isystem' + path]` only when `is_system` is true. So `is_system` is honored; it simply controls `-I` vs `-isystem` (which suppresses warnings and changes search order), not `-iquote`. Closing as invalid.

title: link_with to shared_library on windows can not work as expected (LNK1181)
rationale_ja: Windowsでshared_libraryにlink_withすると.lib(インポートライブラリ)経由でリンクするのは正常動作で、LNK1181は通常DLLがsymbolをexportしておらずインポートライブラリが生成されない等の別要因。再現用の最小例と完全ログが無く古いため、追加情報待ちでstale close候補。
evidence: none (linking a shared_library via its import .lib is expected MSVC behavior)
draft_comment: On Windows, linking against a shared_library correctly goes through its generated import library (.lib) - that's expected MSVC behavior, not a bug. LNK1181 'cannot open input file' usually means the import lib wasn't produced (e.g. the DLL exports no symbols, so no .lib is generated) or a path issue. Without a minimal reproducer and full build log we can't diagnose further. Closing as needs-info/stale; please reopen with a minimal example if this still happens on current Meson.

title: Adding numpy as a dependency with custom lookup
rationale_ja: dependency('numpy')がPKGCONFIG+CONFIG_TOOL(numpy-config)でサポートされるようになった(python.py:618 numpy_factory)。1.4.0でnumpy対応が入っており、要望は実現済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/python.py:618-620 numpy_factory (DependencyMethods.PKGCONFIG, CONFIG_TOOL via numpy-config); docs/markdown/Release-notes-for-1.4.0.md mentions numpy
draft_comment: `dependency('numpy')` is now supported via a dedicated DependencyFactory using pkg-config and the numpy-config config-tool (mesonbuild/dependencies/python.py, numpy_factory), added around Meson 1.4. The include dir/npymath handling that previously required run_command hacks is now covered. Closing as implemented; open a new issue for any missing sub-module (e.g. f2py) support you still need.

title: dependency('Intl', method: 'cmake') has no method 'cmake'
rationale_ja: intlはBUILTIN/SYSTEMのみのDependencyFactoryで登録されており(misc.py:672-676)、method:'cmake'は今も使えない。CMakeで探したいユースケースは未解決のまま。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/misc.py:672-676 intl_factory = DependencyFactory('intl', [BUILTIN, SYSTEM]) - no CMAKE
implementation_hint: Add DependencyMethods.CMAKE to the intl DependencyFactory (mesonbuild/dependencies/misc.py) with a CMake candidate (e.g. Intl module), so `dependency('intl', method: 'cmake')` works again.

title: When compiling a windows resource file, meson fails to invoke windres.EXE ('C:\Program' is not recognized)
rationale_ja: 'C:\Program is not recognized'は空白入りパスのwindres呼び出しがシェル経由で分割された症状。windowsモジュールのcompile_resourcesは@INPUT@/@OUTPUT@でcustom_targetを生成する実装だが、当該環境固有の空白パス問題の修正確証はローカルで取れず、再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/windows.py:118-160 compile_resources builds windres command; no clear space-in-path fix confirmable locally

title: Allow specifying which Python interpreter to use
rationale_ja: python.find_installation(name_or_path)で使用するインタプリタ指定は可能(python.py:526)だが、要望のmeson configure --python/--python2 のようなCLIフラグは存在しない。CLIレベルの指定手段は未実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:517-526 find_installation accepts optional name/path; no --python CLI option in msetup/mconf

title: pkg-config versus pkgconfig behavior (PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR not exposed)
rationale_ja: cross時にPKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIRはsys_rootがあれば設定される(pkgconfig.py:280-282)。ただしget_pkgconfig_variable('includedir')がsysrootを反映しない件はpkg-config側の挙動に依存し、ローカルで完全解消の確証は取れない。keep_open。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py:280-282 sets PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR when sys_root property present

title: unknown compiler error for SHARC DSP (cc21k)
rationale_ja: Analog Devices SHARC用cc21kコンパイラはdetect.pyで認識されず'Unknown compiler'のまま。専用コンパイラサポートの新規追加が必要で未実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py raises 'Unknown compiler' (lines 664/992 etc.); no cc21k/SHARC handling
implementation_hint: Add a Compiler subclass and detection branch for the Analog Devices SHARC cc21k toolchain (recognize its --version banner in detect_c_compiler and map its argument syntax).

title: Unknown compilers goto-cc
rationale_ja: CBMCのgoto-ccはgcc互換だがdetect.pyで判別されず'Unknown compiler'になる。--version出力からのGCC互換判定/専用対応は未実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py raises 'Unknown compiler'; no goto-cc detection
implementation_hint: Detect goto-cc (its --version output) in detect_c_compiler and treat it as a GCC-compatible compiler, or provide a compiler override mechanism in the machine file for gcc-compatible wrappers.

title: rpath not fully stripped on install
rationale_ja: depfixerはinstall_rpath>build_rpathならエラー、短ければ差分をパディングして書き込む方式(depfixer.py:262-272)で、報告のbuild_rpath残存/部分置換の挙動は本質的に同じ。cross(Win10ホスト→ARM)でのrpath完全除去問題は残存とみられる。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/depfixer.py:262-272 pads install_rpath with ':' to build_rpath length; errors if longer

title: Grouping the tutorials under Tutorials
rationale_ja: docs/sitemap.txtではTutorial.md/GuiTutorial.md等がフラットに並んでおり、'Tutorials'親配下へのグループ化はまだされていない。作者もPR実施の意向あり。小さなドキュメント整理タスク。
evidence: docs/sitemap.txt:7-8 Tutorial.md, GuiTutorial.md listed flat (not nested under a Tutorials parent); IndepthTutorial.md at line 144
implementation_hint: In docs/sitemap.txt, nest Tutorial.md / GuiTutorial.md / IndepthTutorial.md (and related) under a new Tutorials.md index page.

title: Generated PKG_CONFIG_PATH and PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR use hard-coded ':' as a path separator
rationale_ja: 旧来の':'.join()ハードコードは廃止され、EnvironmentVariables.set(separator=os.pathsep)経由でPKG_CONFIG_PATH/LIBDIR/SYSROOT_DIRを設定するようになった(pkgconfig.py:279-285、core.py:107)。Windowsでの区切り文字問題は解消。1.4.0リリースノート言及あり。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py:279 env.set('PKG_CONFIG_PATH', extra_paths); mesonbuild/utils/core.py:107 def set(..., separator=os.pathsep); Release-notes-for-1.4.0.md
draft_comment: Fixed: Meson no longer hard-codes ':' for these variables. The pkg-config dependency now sets PKG_CONFIG_PATH/PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR/PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR via EnvironmentVariables.set() (mesonbuild/dependencies/pkgconfig.py), which uses os.pathsep as the default separator (mesonbuild/utils/core.py). So on Windows the native ';' separator is used. Closing as fixed.

title: CMake dependency fails to find vulkan when invoked through meson
rationale_ja: cmake_module_path kwargで-DCMAKE_MODULE_PATH指定は可能(cmake.py:131-133)だが、報告はCMAKE_MODULE_PATH環境変数と*Config.cmake検出の相互作用。ローカルで完全解消の確証は取れず、再現確認が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/cmake.py:131-133 supports cmake_module_path kwarg -> -DCMAKE_MODULE_PATH

title: Add ability to override build_machine.cpu() in host == build configurations
rationale_ja: native fileの[build_machine]セクションやCLIでbuild_machine.cpu()を上書きする仕組みはローカルに見当たらず(update_build_machineは再検出のみ)、未実装の機能要望。
evidence: mesonbuild/environment.py:658 update_build_machine only re-detects; no [build_machine] machine-file section support found
implementation_hint: Support a [build_machine] section in the native file (parsed like [host_machine]) or a CLI override so build_machine.cpu()/cpu_family() can be pinned in native builds.

title: Generator.process crashes when using results of another generator
rationale_ja: generator.process_filesはGeneratedList入力を明示的に処理するようになり(build.py:2080-2086、depends追加+FileInTargetPrivateDir使用)、チェーン時のAssertionErrorは解消しているとみられる。generator.processにdependsも追加された。
evidence: mesonbuild/build.py:2080-2086 process_files handles isinstance(e, GeneratedList); docs/markdown/snippets/generator_process_depends.md
draft_comment: Chaining generators is now handled: Generator.process_files explicitly accepts GeneratedList inputs, registering the dependency and referencing the upstream outputs in the target private dir (mesonbuild/build.py). The previous AssertionError in generate_genlist_for_target no longer applies. Closing as fixed; please reopen with a reproducer if you still see a crash or invalid ninja file on current Meson.

title: Allow to generate and install .deps files for Vala libraries
rationale_ja: gnome.generate_vapiは_generate_depsで.depsファイルを生成しinstall_dirへインストールする(gnome.py:2237-2242、install_tag='devel')。packagesに列挙したVAPI依存が.depsに書き出され、Valaライブラリの.deps生成/インストール要望に対応している。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:2237-2242 _generate_deps writes '<pkg>\n' lines and returns build.Data installed to install_dir; called from generate_vapi at line 2304
draft_comment: gnome.generate_vapi already generates and installs a `.deps` file next to the `.vapi`: the packages passed to generate_vapi are written one-per-line into `<library>.deps` and installed alongside the vapi (mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py, _generate_deps). List the interface packages in the `packages` argument to control its contents. Closing as answered; please reopen if you need a way to specify a deps list distinct from the compile-time depends.

title: Cross building GLib tests for Windows fails ('libgio-2.0-0.dll failed to initialize') - WINEPATH order
rationale_ja: environmentはライブラリパスをWINEPATHへprepend(先頭挿入)するようになっており(environment.py:606 env.prepend('WINEPATH', ...))、ビルドディレクトリのDLLがシステムパスより優先される。報告の『システムDLLが先に使われる』問題に対応。
evidence: mesonbuild/environment.py:599-606 prepend build library_paths to WINEPATH (separator=';')
draft_comment: Meson now prepends the build library paths to WINEPATH rather than appending (mesonbuild/environment.py, env.prepend('WINEPATH', ...)), so the freshly built DLLs take precedence over system/prefix ones when running cross-compiled Windows binaries under wine. This addresses the 'inappropriate DLL from system path' problem. Closing as fixed; reopen with a current log if it still misbehaves.

title: mpv Build issue (Unhandled python exception in 0.61.0)
rationale_ja: 0.61.0でmpvビルドが未処理例外という報告だが、詳細なトレースバックが本文に無く(ログ添付のみ)、Mesonは既に1.11相当。当時の一時的な不具合の可能性が高く、現行での再現情報が必要。stale close候補。
evidence: none (only an attached log referenced; Meson is now 1.11.99, far past 0.61.0)
draft_comment: This was reported against Meson 0.61.0 and the issue body doesn't include the actual traceback (only an attached log). Meson has since advanced many major releases. If mpv still fails to configure on a current Meson, please reopen with the full `meson setup` traceback (MESON_FORCE_BACKTRACE=1) so it can be diagnosed. Closing as stale pending info.

title: No way to turn meson install warnings into errors
rationale_ja: meson installの警告(例のsymlinkコピー警告)をエラー化する仕組みは無く、minstall.pyには--fatal相当の機構が見当たらない。symlink警告自体はfollow_symlinks kwargで回避可能になったが、install全般の警告→エラー化要望は未対応。
evidence: mesonbuild/minstall.py:445 prints symlink_warning; no fatal/werror option for install
implementation_hint: Add a --fatal-warnings (or reuse fatal-meson-warnings) flag to `meson install` that makes minstall warnings raise/exit non-zero.

title: meson seems to ignore custom targets when it generates compile_commands.json
rationale_ja: generate_compdbはコンパイラ/PCH(とtasking MIL)ルールのみをninja -t compdbに渡し、CUSTOM_COMMANDは含めない(ninjabackend.py:807-823)。custom_target由来のコンパイル(systemdのbpf等)がcompile_commands.jsonに現れないのは設計上そのまま。
evidence: mesonbuild/backend/ninjabackend.py:807-823 generate_compdb collects only compiler/PCH (+ tasking) rules, not CUSTOM_COMMAND
implementation_hint: Optionally include CUSTOM_COMMAND rules (or a curated subset that runs real compilers) in generate_compdb, perhaps behind an opt-in, so custom-target compilation shows up in compile_commands.json.

title: meson wrongly assumes that x86_64-linux-gnu can run x86_64-linux-gnux32
rationale_ja: machine_info_can_runはcpu_family比較のみのヒューリスティックのままで(envconfig.py:761-779)、x32はx86_64と同じcpu_familyになるためTrueを返す。x86_64→x32やarmv8→armv7の誤検出は未解決。実際にhost実行を試す等の改善は未実装。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:761-779 machine_info_can_run compares cpu_family only; x32 shares x86_64 cpu_family
implementation_hint: Make machine_info_can_run more precise (e.g. account for the x32/gnux32 ABI and armv7 vs armv8), or optionally verify by actually running a small host executable before declaring exe_wrapper unnecessary.

title: depfiles not working for incbin asm statements
rationale_ja: アセンブラの.incbin/.includeが取り込むファイルは依存追跡されず(GCCが生成するdepfileに含まれない)、Meson側にそれを補うescape-hatch(手動depend_files)も無い。ローカルに該当対応は見当たらず未解決。
evidence: none (no incbin/.include dependency handling in mesonbuild/; no per-source depend_files escape hatch for compiled sources)
implementation_hint: Provide a way to attach extra depend_files to a compiled source (or a target-level extra-deps hook) so .incbin/.include inputs can be tracked despite GCC not emitting them in the depfile.

title: configure_file argument depfile broken
rationale_ja: configure_fileのcommandはconfigure時に実行され、depfileはscratch_dir(interpreter.py:2906)に生成されるだけでbuild.ninjaのビルド依存として伝播しないため、再configure後に依存追跡が失われる問題は現行masterでも残存している。設計的な限界に近く修正には工夫が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/interpreter.py:2905-2907 (depfile is placed in scratch_dir, not propagated to ninja build deps)

title: Allow setting name_suffix via cross file
rationale_ja: cross/machineファイルでexecutable_suffixを既定値として設定する機能は現行masterに実装されていない(envconfig.pyのget_exe_suffixはmachine情報由来で、[properties]からの上書きは無い)。妥当な機能要望だが設計判断が必要。
evidence: mesonbuild/envconfig.py:416 get_exe_suffix (no [properties] executable_suffix override)

title: [Documentation] Explain the differences to cmake, ideally a HTML table
rationale_ja: meson vs cmake比較表をFAQに追加する提案。ドキュメント追加の要望で妥当だが主観性が強く、メンテナの方針判断とコミュニティ執筆が必要なため保留。
evidence: none

title: Despite --vsenv command meson doesn't seem to recognize Visual Studio environment
rationale_ja: MinGWのgccがPATH上で検出されVS環境を使わない、mediasoupのビルドスクリプト由来の環境問題。--vsenvのgcc検出ロジックは_setup_vsenvに既に存在し、報告は2022年(0.61.1)で追加情報なく再現不能。
evidence: mesonbuild/utils/vsenv.py:41-49 (--vsenv/force logic checks cc/gcc/clang in PATH)
draft_comment: Thanks for the report. This looks like an environment-specific interaction where a MinGW `gcc` on `PATH` was picked up ahead of the requested MSVC toolchain. `--vsenv` behaviour and compiler detection have changed substantially since 0.61. Could you re-test with a current Meson release and, if it still fails, share a minimal reproducer (the exact `meson setup` invocation plus your `PATH`/environment) so we can look into it? Without further information from a current version we'll close this as stale, but please comment and we'll reopen.

title: Compiler arguments are not properly ignored during checks
rationale_ja: compilerチェックがadd_*_arguments由来の引数のみ無視し、環境のCFLAGS/LDFLAGSやコマンドラインの-Dlang_args等は無視しないというドキュメントとの不一致は現行masterでも解消されていない。振る舞い変更かドキュメント修正かの判断が必要(documentationラベル済)。

title: Generator process() with preserve_path_from keyword argument bug

title: Built-in support for pre-processing + compiling assembly with MSVC
rationale_ja: masm(ml/ml64/armasm)言語サポートは追加済(asm.py, 1.9.0リリースノート)だが、本issueが求めるGCC流の.SファイルをC等と並べてcl /Pで自動前処理する統合は未実装(masmは別途.masmファイルが必要)。部分的進捗はあるが要望の中核は残る。
evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/asm.py:191-250 (masm/ml64/armasm); docs/markdown/Release-notes-for-1.9.0.md:124 (MASM support is for .masm files, not auto-preprocessed .S)

title: [dlang] [dub] Plain library references should try <name> and lib<name>
rationale_ja: dub経由のCライブラリ参照で<name>とlib<name>両方を試す挙動は現行dub.pyに見当たらない。ニッチなD/dub依存解決の機能要望で保留が妥当。

title: Meson test -C doesn't find targets when pointing a bound mount

rationale_ja: 現行masterでもMSVCのcpp_std選択肢はc++*/vc++*のみでgnu++*を受け付けず(cpp.py get_optionsのcpp_stds、VC_VERSION_MAPにgnu++キー無し)、gnu++14をvc++14へマップする挙動は未実装。#7611のC相当の対応がC++には入っておらず、要望は依然有効。

title: Specify default_options for cpp_eh only on Windows

title: How to install relocatable shared lib on macOS (install_name set to @rpath)?
rationale_ja: macOSで再配置可能な共有ライブラリ(install_name=@rpath)をどう作るかという質問。install_rpath/build_rpathやinstall_name mappingの仕組みがあり、質問として回答してクローズ可能。バグではない。
evidence: mesonbuild/backend/backends.py:146-148 (install_name_mappings, install_rpath); docs Creating-OSX-packages.md
draft_comment: This is a usage question rather than a bug. Meson relinks at install time and rewrites the `install_name`/rpaths of installed macOS libraries; you can control the runtime search path with the `install_rpath` kwarg on the library target, and Meson already remaps dependency install names for installed binaries. If a specific project still ends up with an absolute `install_name`, please open a new issue with a minimal reproducer. Closing as answered; the mailing list / Matrix room is also a good place for how-to questions.

draft_comment: Your mental model is essentially correct: "build options" is the umbrella that includes built-in options (universal/base/compiler/etc.) and per-project options, and machine files can set both via `[project options]` and `[built-in options]`. The Machine-files and Build-options pages could cross-reference each other more clearly. A small docs PR linking the two sections would be very welcome. Closing as answered; please reopen or file a focused docs issue if a specific passage is still misleading.

title: Unhandled Python exception on meson build (MSYS2 vsenv)

draft_comment: The traceback bottoms out in the Visual Studio `vcvars` batch file failing under MSYS2 (`...dd_vsdevcmd16_preinit_env.log was unexpected at this time`), which is an environment/batch-parsing interaction rather than a plain Meson bug. vsenv handling has changed since 0.61.2. Could you re-test on a current Meson release from a clean shell and, if it still fails, attach the full log plus your shell/PATH details? Closing as stale/needs-info; comment to reopen.

title: How to add a new language for projects in 2022?
rationale_ja: 新言語(Antlr4等)サポートの追加方法についての質問。開発者向け手引きへの問い合わせで、コントリビュートガイドを案内し、Antlrはコードジェネレータのためgenerator()/custom_target()が適切と回答してクローズ可能。
evidence: contributing.md (compiler/language addition), mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py
draft_comment: This is a how-to/contribution question rather than a bug. Adding a first-class language means implementing a `Compiler` subclass under `mesonbuild/compilers/`, wiring it into `mesonbuild/compilers/detect.py`, and adding backend/test support; existing compilers (e.g. `nasm`/`cython`/`swift`) are good templates. Note that Antlr specifically is a code generator, which is usually better handled via `generator()`/`custom_target()` than as a project language. For design help, the Matrix room / mailing list is the best venue. Closing as answered; please reopen if you hit a concrete blocker while implementing.

title: run_target can't take files() dependencies

title: Building DLang shared library on MacOS ARM64 fails (-undefined,dynamic_lookup)

evidence: mesonbuild/compilers/d.py / linkers (D linker passes '-undefined,dynamic_lookup' as one comma-joined -L arg, rejected by modern Apple ld)
implementation_hint: In the D compiler/linker arg translation (mesonbuild/compilers/d.py, the code that wraps linker args as '-L=<arg>' for ldc2/dmd), split combined options like '-undefined,dynamic_lookup' into two separate '-L=-undefined' and '-L=dynamic_lookup' entries, since modern Apple ld no longer accepts the comma-joined form. Verify against the reproducer repo (ErnyTech/MacOS_ARM_Meson_Issue) and add a unit test for the D linker arg translation.

title: Meson sets PATH rather than WINEPATH in run_exe()
rationale_ja: meson_exe.pyはexe_wrapperがwineの場合、extra_pathsからWINEPATH（Z:プレフィックス付き）を設定する処理を実装済み。報告の未設定問題は修正されている。
evidence: mesonbuild/scripts/meson_exe.py:39-45 if exe.exe_wrapper and any('wine' in i ...): child_env['WINEPATH']=get_wine_shortpath([...Z:...])
draft_comment: This should be fixed in current Meson. `mesonbuild/scripts/meson_exe.py` now detects when the exe wrapper is Wine and sets `WINEPATH` (with `Z:` prefixes and shortpath handling) from the target's `extra_paths`, instead of only `PATH`. Could you retest with a recent release? If you still hit this, please reopen with an updated reproducer. Closing as fixed.

title: not found: mesonbuild.dependencies.data
rationale_ja: mesonbuild/dependencies/data/に__init__.pyが存在し、importlib.resources.read_text('mesonbuild.dependencies.data', ...)がパッケージとして解決できる。当時のパッケージング欠落は解消済み。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/data/__init__.py 存在。cmake.py:580 read_text('mesonbuild.dependencies.data', cmake_file)
draft_comment: This was a packaging issue where `mesonbuild.dependencies.data` was not importable as a resource package. Current Meson ships `mesonbuild/dependencies/data/__init__.py` and loads the CMake templates via `importlib.resources.read_text('mesonbuild.dependencies.data', ...)`, so this should no longer occur. Please retest with a recent release and reopen if it still happens. Closing as fixed.

title: Add str.to_quoted

title: Unhandled exception during install with -Dstrip=true for Python extension module on Windows 10

evidence: mesonbuild/minstall.py:624 do_strip は Popen_safe(strip_bin+[outname]) を直接呼び、strip_bin不在時の例外処理なし

title: test cases/frameworks/4 qt/meson.build:48:4: ERROR: Unhandled python exception
rationale_ja: Xcode 3.2 / gcc-4.2 / 10.6 PPC という極めて古く未サポートの環境でのテストスイート失敗。現行mesonの最低要件(Python 3.7+等)を満たさず、この環境の追跡は不能。
evidence: 本文環境: 10.6 PPC, Xcode 3.2, gcc-4.2.1, meson 0.62.1
draft_comment: This was reported on Mac OS X 10.6 PPC with Xcode 3.2 / gcc-4.2 and Meson 0.62.1 — an environment far outside Meson's supported platforms and toolchains today. Both the Qt framework test and Meson itself have changed substantially since then. Without a reproducer on a currently supported platform this can't be acted on. If you can reproduce a Qt test failure on a supported OS/toolchain with a recent Meson, please open a fresh issue with the full log. Closing as obsolete.

title: python install_sources() does not accept "rename" as kwarg
rationale_ja: python_installation.install_sourcesは今もrenameを受け付けず、install_data_implへrename=None固定で渡している。install_dataと引数が揃っておらず、rename対応かドキュメント修正が妥当。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:315-332 typed_kwargsに_PURE_KW/_SUBDIR_KW/PRESERVE_PATH_KW/install_tagのみ、install_data_impl(...rename=None...)
implementation_hint: install_sources_methodのtyped_kwargsにinstall_dataと同じrename KwargInfoを追加し、install_data_impl呼び出しでrename=kwargs['rename']を渡す。source数とrename数の一致検証も踏襲する。

title: With llvm 14 and llvm 15 co-installed, meson doesn't pick llvm 15 using native-file
rationale_ja: native-fileでllvm-configを指定してもバージョン選択が意図通りにならない件。dev.pyのllvm-config探索とnative bin指定の優先関係を実機で調査する必要があり、単純判定不可。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py:190-204 tool_name='llvm-config' 探索名リストにfallback追加あり

title: `gnome.compile_resources` building before dependencies
rationale_ja: blueprint等のcustom targetをdependencies指定してもcompile_resourcesが先行する順序問題。gnomeモジュールのdepends/dependencies伝播の再現確認が必要で、blueprint-compiler側要因の可能性もある。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/gnome.py:205 depends kwarg, 393 compile_resources定義（依存順序の実挙動は要確認）

title: Add a CMake-Targets-File generator.
rationale_ja: cmakeモジュールはwrite_basic_package_version_file/configure_package_config_fileは持つが、ターゲット情報から*Targets.cmakeを自動生成する機能は未実装。中規模の機能追加で設計判断を要する。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/cmake.py:250,307,368 version_file/package_config_fileのみ、Targets file生成メソッドなし

title: Subproject I18N support
rationale_ja: サブプロジェクトでのI18Nベストプラクティスに関する質問で、バグ要素はない。各サブプロジェクトが自身のi18n.gettext/po_dirを持つ通常運用で対応可能なため、Q&Aとしてclose相当。
evidence: none
draft_comment: This is a usage question rather than a bug. Each (sub)project can call `i18n.gettext()` with its own `po` directory and translation domain independently; the main project and subprojects manage their own `LINGUAS`/`.po` files and gettext domains. Meson does not merge translation catalogs across subproject boundaries automatically — the recommended approach is a separate domain per component. For usage help, the Meson discussions/matrix channels are a better venue than the issue tracker. Closing as answered; feel free to follow up if there's a concrete missing capability.

title: Qt6: the shaders precompilation support to qsb
rationale_ja: Qt6のqsbシェーダプリコンパイル（qt6_add_shaders相当）はqtモジュールに未実装。Qtモジュールへの機能追加で妥当な要望。

evidence: none

title: Meson does not allow strings like `X.Y.Z+META` to be used as the library version
rationale_ja: 共有ライブラリversionの検証は今もr'[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}'でSemVerの+METAを拒否する。soname生成の妥当性やABI互換の観点があり、単純に緩和してよいか設計判断が要る。
evidence: mesonbuild/interpreter/type_checking.py:128-131 _validate_shlib_version の正規表現がX.Y.Zのみ許可

title: i18n.merge_file() doesn't support depend_files
rationale_ja: i18n.merge_fileのMergeFile kwargsにdepend_filesは無く、内部でdepend_filesはpo_dir由来のsource_filesに固定されている。ユーザ指定のdepend_files受け入れかドキュメント修正が妥当。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/i18n.py:35 MergeFile TypedDict/302 merge_file、170-186でdepend_filesは内部生成のみ。ユーザkwargとして受けていない
implementation_hint: MergeFile TypedDictとtyped_kwargsにdepend_files (ContainerTypeInfo(list, (str, File)))を追加し、merge_file内でユーザ指定分を内部source_filesに連結してCustomTargetのdepend_filesへ渡す。あるいはドキュメントで非対応を明記。

title: python.find_installation() does not distinguish between ModuleNotFoundError and other errors
rationale_ja: find_installationのモジュール判定は今も`import {mod}`のreturncode非ゼロを一律にmissingとして扱い、ModuleNotFoundErrorと他の例外を区別せずログにも詳細を残さない。区別と詳細ログ出力は妥当な改善。
evidence: mesonbuild/modules/python.py:560-586 p=['-c', f'import {mod}']; returncode!=0→missing_modules。例外種別の判別なし
implementation_hint: モジュール検査スクリプトを importlib.import_module(mod) をtry/exceptで包み、ModuleNotFoundError時とその他例外時で終了コード/出力を分け、後者はトレースバックをmeson-log.txtへ記録。find_installation側でメッセージを『missing』と『failed to import』に分岐。

title: Incorrect path for precompiled headers in `compile_commands.json`
rationale_ja: compile_commands.jsonの-includeにpchの親ディレクトリが欠ける件。ninjabackendのpch引数生成の実挙動確認が必要で、clangd向けの正確なパス生成という調査項目が残る。
evidence: none

title: Add libpcre2 as a dependency class
rationale_ja: libpcre2専用のdependency classは未実装（dependencies内にpcreのヒットなし）。zlib等と同様のシステムライブラリ検出クラス追加として妥当。
evidence: mesonbuild/dependencies/*.py にpcre/pcre2のヒットなし
implementation_hint: mesonbuild/dependencies/dev.py等にzlib(dev.py:459付近)を参考にPcre2SystemDependencyを追加し、pkg-config('libpcre2-8')優先＋Windowsのpcre2-8/pcre2-8d等のライブラリ名フォールバックとpcre2.hヘッダ探索を実装。packages辞書に'pcre2'として登録。

title: Compilation fail with obs-nvfbc
rationale_ja: 『cannot find Scrt1.o / crti.o』はCランタイム(glibc-devel/gcc)の未導入によるツールチェーン環境問題で、meson側のバグではない。ユーザ環境のセットアップ不足。
evidence: 本文ログ: /usr/bin/ld: cannot find Scrt1.o / crti.o; ERROR: Compiler cc can not compile programs
draft_comment: This is an environment/toolchain problem, not a Meson bug. The error `/usr/bin/ld: cannot find Scrt1.o` and `crti.o` means your C runtime startup objects are missing — i.e. the C development libraries aren't installed. On most distros installing the build essentials fixes it (e.g. `glibc-devel`/`libc6-dev` and `gcc`, or your distro's `base-devel`/`build-essential` group). Once `cc` can compile a trivial program, Meson will configure fine. Closing as this isn't actionable in Meson; please reach out to your distro's support channels if the toolchain still won't link.

title: Request for interest: server for binary artifacts from wrap files

title: Improving Qt moc cross platform support
rationale_ja: cmake automoc相当のmoc_predefs.h自動生成(コンパイラ定義済みマクロをdumpして--includeで渡す)は未実装。extra_argsで手動対応は可能だが自動化機能は残すべき要望。
